================================================================================
FILE: social-media-mcp/src/auth/app-credentials.ts
================================================================================

import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { config } from "../config/env.js";
import { databasePool } from "../database.js";
import { ensureDatabaseMigrations } from "../database-migrations.js";
import type { Platform } from "../platforms/types.js";

// User-owned Developer App credentials. Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn each
// issue their own app/client id and secret, so a user configures one record per
// provider. Secrets are encrypted at rest; the client id is public (it appears in
// the provider consent URL) but is only exposed for the user's own record.
export const appCredentialProviders: readonly Platform[] = ["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"];

export interface AppCredentialStatus {
  provider: Platform;
  // True when the user stored their own app credentials; false when the shared
  // environment credentials are used as a fallback.
  configured: boolean;
  source: "user" | "shared";
  clientId?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
}

export interface ResolvedAppCredentials {
  provider: Platform;
  source: "user" | "shared";
  clientId: string;
  // Only present when the caller asked for the secret. Local (stdio) callers and
  // request paths that only build an authorization URL never decrypt it.
  clientSecret?: string;
  // Opaque, non-reversible identifier of the exact credential version. It is
  // stored with the authorization session so a mid-flow edit cannot silently
  // swap the app that finishes the exchange.
  fingerprint: string;
}

export interface SaveAppCredentialsInput {
  clientId: string;
  // When omitted or blank on an update, the existing secret is preserved.
  clientSecret?: string | null;
}

interface EncryptedAppSecret {
  version: 1;
  iv: string;
  tag: string;
  ciphertext: string;
}

interface AppCredentialRow {
  provider: Platform;
  client_id: string;
  client_secret_ciphertext: EncryptedAppSecret;
  updated_at: Date;
}

// User-owned credentials live in the shared cloud database, next to the OAuth
// tokens. A local (stdio) MCP install uses TOKEN_STORE_BACKEND=local and keeps
// resolving the shared environment credentials, so nothing changes for it.
export function userAppCredentialsActive(): boolean {
  return config.tokenStoreBackend === "supabase";
}

function encryptionKey(): Buffer {
  const value = config.appCredentialEncryptionKey;
  if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error("Set APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY to a randomly generated 64-character hex key (see .env.example).");
  }
  return Buffer.from(value, "hex");
}

function appSecretAad(userId: string, provider: Platform): Buffer {
  // Bind the ciphertext to the owning user and provider so a record can never be
  // replayed as another user's or another provider's secret.
  return Buffer.from(`social-media-mcp:app-credential:${userId}:${provider}:v1`, "utf8");
}

export function encryptAppSecret(userId: string, provider: Platform, clientSecret: string): EncryptedAppSecret {
  const iv = randomBytes(12);
  const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", encryptionKey(), iv);
  cipher.setAAD(appSecretAad(userId, provider));
  const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(clientSecret, "utf8"), cipher.final()]);
  return {
    version: 1,
    iv: iv.toString("hex"),
    tag: cipher.getAuthTag().toString("hex"),
    ciphertext: ciphertext.toString("hex"),
  };
}

export function decryptAppSecret(userId: string, provider: Platform, envelope: EncryptedAppSecret): string {
  if (!envelope || envelope.version !== 1) {
    throw new Error("Unsupported developer app credential record version.");
  }
  const decipher = createDecipheriv("aes-256-gcm", encryptionKey(), Buffer.from(envelope.iv, "hex"));
  decipher.setAAD(appSecretAad(userId, provider));
  decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(envelope.tag, "hex"));
  try {
    return Buffer.concat([
      decipher.update(Buffer.from(envelope.ciphertext, "hex")),
      decipher.final(),
    ]).toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    // Never surface the ciphertext or the key. A failed tag check means the
    // record was tampered with or the key changed; fail instead of guessing.
    throw new Error("Could not decrypt the stored developer app secret. Check APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY or re-save the credentials.");
  }
}

export function appCredentialFingerprint(
  source: "user" | "shared",
  provider: Platform,
  clientId: string,
  version: string,
): string {
  // Hashes only non-secret inputs, so it cannot be brute-forced into the secret.
  return createHash("sha256").update(`${source}:${provider}:${clientId}:${version}`, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

// Fails when the credential version stored at authorization start no longer
// matches the configured one, so an in-flight flow never exchanges a code with a
// different app. A missing expected value (legacy session) is tolerated.
export function assertAppCredentialFingerprint(expected: string | undefined, current: string): void {
  if (expected && expected !== current) {
    throw new Error("The developer app credentials changed while this authorization was in progress. Start the connection again from the Accounts page.");
  }
}

function sharedClientCredentials(provider: Platform): { clientId: string; clientSecret: string } {
  if (provider === "linkedin") {
    return { clientId: config.linkedinClientId, clientSecret: config.linkedinClientSecret };
  }
  if (provider === "instagram") {
    return { clientId: config.instagramAppId, clientSecret: config.instagramAppSecret };
  }
  return { clientId: config.metaAppId, clientSecret: config.metaAppSecret };
}

export function resolveSharedAppCredentials(
  provider: Platform,
  includeSecret = true,
): ResolvedAppCredentials {
  const { clientId, clientSecret } = sharedClientCredentials(provider);
  return {
    provider,
    source: "shared",
    clientId,
    ...(includeSecret ? { clientSecret } : {}),
    fingerprint: appCredentialFingerprint("shared", provider, clientId, "shared"),
  };
}

async function readAppCredential(userId: string, provider: Platform): Promise<AppCredentialRow | undefined> {
  // The table is created by migration 009. Ensure it exists before the first read
  // (the runner is idempotent and memoized per process).
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<AppCredentialRow>(
    `SELECT provider, client_id, client_secret_ciphertext, updated_at
       FROM public.oauth_app_credentials
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND provider = $2`,
    [userId, provider],
  );
  return rows[0];
}

export async function resolveAppCredentials(
  userId: string,
  provider: Platform,
  options: { includeSecret?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<ResolvedAppCredentials> {
  const includeSecret = options.includeSecret ?? true;
  if (!userAppCredentialsActive()) return resolveSharedAppCredentials(provider, includeSecret);
  const row = await readAppCredential(userId, provider);
  if (!row) return resolveSharedAppCredentials(provider, includeSecret);
  return {
    provider,
    source: "user",
    clientId: row.client_id,
    ...(includeSecret ? { clientSecret: decryptAppSecret(userId, provider, row.client_secret_ciphertext) } : {}),
    fingerprint: appCredentialFingerprint("user", provider, row.client_id, row.updated_at.toISOString()),
  };
}

export async function appCredentialStatuses(userId: string): Promise<AppCredentialStatus[]> {
  if (!userAppCredentialsActive()) {
    return appCredentialProviders.map((provider) => ({ provider, configured: false, source: "shared" as const }));
  }
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<{ provider: Platform; client_id: string; updated_at: Date }>(
    "SELECT provider, client_id, updated_at FROM public.oauth_app_credentials WHERE user_id = $1",
    [userId],
  );
  const byProvider = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.provider, row]));
  return appCredentialProviders.map((provider) => {
    const row = byProvider.get(provider);
    if (row) {
      return {
        provider,
        configured: true,
        source: "user" as const,
        clientId: row.client_id,
        updatedAt: row.updated_at.toISOString(),
      };
    }
    return { provider, configured: false, source: "shared" as const };
  });
}

export async function saveAppCredentials(
  userId: string,
  provider: Platform,
  input: SaveAppCredentialsInput,
): Promise<void> {
  const clientId = input.clientId.trim();
  const clientSecret = input.clientSecret?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!clientId) throw new Error("Enter the app/client ID.");
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  if (clientSecret) {
    const envelope = encryptAppSecret(userId, provider, clientSecret);
    await databasePool().query(
      `INSERT INTO public.oauth_app_credentials
         (user_id, provider, client_id, client_secret_ciphertext, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, NOW(), NOW())
       ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider) DO UPDATE
         SET client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id,
             client_secret_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.client_secret_ciphertext,
             updated_at = NOW()`,
      [userId, provider, clientId, JSON.stringify(envelope)],
    );
    return;
  }
  // A blank secret preserves the stored one. Only an update can omit it; a new
  // credential must always include the secret.
  const { rowCount } = await databasePool().query(
    "UPDATE public.oauth_app_credentials SET client_id = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = $1 AND provider = $2",
    [userId, provider, clientId],
  );
  if (rowCount !== 1) throw new Error("Enter the app/client secret to save this credential.");
}

export async function deleteAppCredentials(userId: string, provider: Platform): Promise<boolean> {
  // Deleting credentials only removes the app configuration. Stored social
  // tokens and scheduled posts are intentionally untouched.
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rowCount } = await databasePool().query(
    "DELETE FROM public.oauth_app_credentials WHERE user_id = $1 AND provider = $2",
    [userId, provider],
  );
  return (rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
}

export function isAppCredentialProvider(value: unknown): value is Platform {
  return typeof value === "string" && (appCredentialProviders as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export function validateAppCredentialInput(
  provider: unknown,
  clientId: unknown,
  clientSecret: unknown,
  requireSecret: boolean,
): string | null {
  if (!isAppCredentialProvider(provider)) return "Unknown provider.";
  const id = typeof clientId === "string" ? clientId.trim() : "";
  if (!id) return "Enter the app/client ID.";
  if (id.length > 255 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/.test(id)) {
    return "The app/client ID may only contain letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores.";
  }
  const secret = typeof clientSecret === "string" ? clientSecret.trim() : "";
  if (requireSecret && !secret) return "Enter the app/client secret.";
  if (secret && (secret.length > 1024 || /[\s\0]/.test(secret))) {
    return "The app/client secret contains invalid characters.";
  }
  return null;
}

FILE: social-media-mcp/src/auth/mcp-oauth.ts

import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import type { AuthInfo, OAuthMetadata, OAuthProtectedResourceMetadata } from "@modelcontextprotocol/server";
import { OAuthError, OAuthErrorCode } from "@modelcontextprotocol/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { config } from "../config/env.js";
import { databasePool } from "../database.js";
import { ensureDatabaseMigrations } from "../database-migrations.js";

// Remote MCP OAuth 2.1 authorization server and resource-server verifier.
//
// The cloud worker serves the authorization, token, registration, and revocation
// endpoints. The Vercel frontend renders consent and creates the one-time code,
// which binds the code to the signed-in better-auth user. Only SHA-256 digests
// of codes, access tokens, refresh tokens, and client secrets are persisted.

export type McpClientAuthMethod = "none" | "client_secret_basic" | "client_secret_post";

export interface McpOAuthClient {
  clientId: string;
  redirectUris: string[];
  grantTypes: string[];
  responseTypes: string[];
  tokenEndpointAuthMethod: McpClientAuthMethod;
  clientName?: string;
  scope?: string;
}

export interface McpClientRegistrationResponse {
  client_id: string;
  client_secret?: string;
  client_id_issued_at: number;
  redirect_uris: string[];
  token_endpoint_auth_method: McpClientAuthMethod;
  grant_types: string[];
  response_types: string[];
  client_name?: string;
  scope?: string;
}

export interface McpTokenResponse {
  access_token: string;
  token_type: "Bearer";
  expires_in: number;
  refresh_token?: string;
  scope: string;
}

export interface McpAuthorizationValidation {
  client: McpOAuthClient;
  scope: string;
  resource: string;
}

export class McpOAuthError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly status: number;

  constructor(code: string, message: string, status = 400) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "McpOAuthError";
    this.code = code;
    this.status = status;
  }
}

const clientSecretPattern = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,256}$/;
const codeVerifierPattern = /^[A-Za-z0-9\-._~]{43,128}$/;
const codeChallengePattern = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/;

interface ClientRow {
  client_id: string;
  client_name: string | null;
  redirect_uris: string[];
  grant_types: string[];
  response_types: string[];
  token_endpoint_auth_method: McpClientAuthMethod;
  scope: string | null;
}

interface ClientSecretRow {
  client_secret_hash: string | null;
  token_endpoint_auth_method: McpClientAuthMethod;
}

function clientFromRow(row: ClientRow): McpOAuthClient {
  return {
    clientId: row.client_id,
    redirectUris: row.redirect_uris,
    grantTypes: row.grant_types,
    responseTypes: row.response_types,
    tokenEndpointAuthMethod: row.token_endpoint_auth_method,
    ...(row.client_name ? { clientName: row.client_name } : {}),
    ...(row.scope ? { scope: row.scope } : {}),
  };
}

export function hashMcpSecret(value: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(value, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

function safeHashEqual(left: string, right: string): boolean {
  const a = Buffer.from(left, "utf8");
  const b = Buffer.from(right, "utf8");
  return a.byteLength === b.byteLength && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

export function normalizeMcpScope(requested?: string, fallback?: string): string {
  const raw = (requested ?? fallback ?? config.mcpOauthScope).trim();
  if (!raw) return config.mcpOauthScope;
  const scopes = [...new Set(raw.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean))];
  if (!scopes.length || scopes.some((scope) => scope !== config.mcpOauthScope)) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(
      OAuthErrorCode.InvalidScope,
      `Unsupported scope. This server supports only "${config.mcpOauthScope}".`,
    );
  }
  return config.mcpOauthScope;
}

export function normalizeMcpResource(value: string): string {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidTarget, "The resource parameter must be an absolute URL.");
  }
  if (url.username || url.password) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidTarget, "The resource parameter must not contain credentials.");
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url.toString().replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

export function mcpAuthorizationServerIssuer(): string {
  return new URL(config.mcpPublicUrl).origin;
}

export function mcpProtectedResourceMetadata(): OAuthProtectedResourceMetadata {
  return {
    resource: config.mcpPublicUrl,
    authorization_servers: [mcpAuthorizationServerIssuer()],
    scopes_supported: [config.mcpOauthScope],
    bearer_methods_supported: ["header"],
    resource_name: "Social Media MCP",
  };
}

export function mcpAuthorizationServerMetadata(): OAuthMetadata {
  const issuer = mcpAuthorizationServerIssuer();
  return {
    issuer,
    authorization_endpoint: new URL("/oauth/authorize", issuer).toString(),
    token_endpoint: new URL("/oauth/token", issuer).toString(),
    registration_endpoint: new URL("/oauth/register", issuer).toString(),
    revocation_endpoint: new URL("/oauth/revoke", issuer).toString(),
    scopes_supported: [config.mcpOauthScope],
    response_types_supported: ["code"],
    response_modes_supported: ["query"],
    grant_types_supported: ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"],
    token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: ["none", "client_secret_basic", "client_secret_post"],
    revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: ["none", "client_secret_basic", "client_secret_post"],
    code_challenge_methods_supported: ["S256"],
    authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported: false,
    client_id_metadata_document_supported: false,
  };
}

function isLoopbackHostname(hostname: string): boolean {
  return hostname === "localhost" || hostname === "127.0.0.1" || hostname === "[::1]" || hostname === "::1";
}

export function isAllowedMcpRedirectUri(value: string): boolean {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  if (url.username || url.password || url.hash) return false;
  if (url.protocol === "https:") {
    return config.mcpAllowedRedirectOrigins.some(
      (origin) => url.origin === origin.replace(/\/+$/, ""),
    );
  }
  return config.mcpAllowLoopbackRedirects
    && url.protocol === "http:"
    && isLoopbackHostname(url.hostname);
}

function redirectUriMatches(client: McpOAuthClient, redirectUri: string): boolean {
  if (!isAllowedMcpRedirectUri(redirectUri)) return false;
  return client.redirectUris.some((registered) => {
    if (registered === redirectUri) return true;
    try {
      return new URL(registered).toString() === new URL(redirectUri).toString();
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
}

export function isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri(client: McpOAuthClient, redirectUri: string): boolean {
  return redirectUriMatches(client, redirectUri);
}

export async function getMcpClient(clientId: string): Promise<McpOAuthClient | null> {
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<ClientRow>(
    `SELECT client_id, client_name, redirect_uris, grant_types, response_types,
            token_endpoint_auth_method, scope
       FROM public.mcp_oauth_clients
      WHERE client_id = $1`,
    [clientId],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  return row ? clientFromRow(row) : null;
}

export async function validateMcpAuthorizationRequest(input: {
  clientId?: string;
  redirectUri?: string;
  responseType?: string;
  scope?: string;
  resource?: string;
  codeChallenge?: string;
  codeChallengeMethod?: string;
}): Promise<McpAuthorizationValidation> {
  if (!input.clientId) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "client_id is required.");
  }
  if (!input.redirectUri) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "redirect_uri is required.");
  }
  if (input.responseType !== undefined && input.responseType !== "code") {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.UnsupportedResponseType, "Only response_type=code is supported.");
  }
  if (input.codeChallengeMethod !== undefined && input.codeChallengeMethod !== "S256") {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "PKCE code_challenge_method must be S256.");
  }
  if (!input.codeChallenge || !codeChallengePattern.test(input.codeChallenge)) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "A valid PKCE code_challenge is required.");
  }
  const client = await getMcpClient(input.clientId);
  if (!client) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Unknown OAuth client.", 401);
  }
  if (!redirectUriMatches(client, input.redirectUri)) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "The redirect_uri is not registered for this client.");
  }
  if (!client.responseTypes.includes("code")) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.UnauthorizedClient, "This client may not use the authorization-code grant.");
  }
  const scope = normalizeMcpScope(input.scope, client.scope);
  const expectedResource = normalizeMcpResource(config.mcpPublicUrl);
  const resource = input.resource ? normalizeMcpResource(input.resource) : expectedResource;
  if (resource !== expectedResource) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(
      OAuthErrorCode.InvalidTarget,
      "The requested resource does not match this server's MCP_PUBLIC_URL.",
    );
  }
  return { client, scope, resource };
}

const registrationSchema = z.object({
  redirect_uris: z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(1).max(10),
  token_endpoint_auth_method: z
    .enum(["none", "client_secret_basic", "client_secret_post"])
    .optional(),
  grant_types: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(5).optional(),
  response_types: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(5).optional(),
  client_name: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  scope: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
});

export async function registerMcpClient(input: unknown): Promise<McpClientRegistrationResponse> {
  const parsed = registrationSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(
      OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClientMetadata,
      parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid client metadata.",
    );
  }
  const metadata = parsed.data;
  const redirectUris = [...new Set(metadata.redirect_uris)];
  if (redirectUris.some((uri) => !isAllowedMcpRedirectUri(uri))) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(
      OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRedirectUri,
      "redirect_uris must be registered Claude origins or loopback HTTP callbacks.",
    );
  }
  const grantTypes = metadata.grant_types ?? ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"];
  if (!grantTypes.includes("authorization_code") || grantTypes.some(
    (grant) => grant !== "authorization_code" && grant !== "refresh_token",
  )) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(
      OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClientMetadata,
      "grant_types may contain only authorization_code and refresh_token.",
    );
  }
  const responseTypes = metadata.response_types ?? ["code"];
  if (responseTypes.length !== 1 || responseTypes[0] !== "code") {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClientMetadata, "Only response_types=[\"code\"] is supported.");
  }
  const scope = normalizeMcpScope(metadata.scope);
  const authMethod = metadata.token_endpoint_auth_method ?? "none";
  const clientId = `mcp_${randomBytes(16).toString("hex")}`;
  const clientSecret = authMethod === "none" ? undefined : randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  if (clientSecret && !clientSecretPattern.test(clientSecret)) {
    throw new Error("Generated client secret failed validation.");
  }
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  await databasePool().query(
    `INSERT INTO public.mcp_oauth_clients
       (client_id, client_secret_hash, client_name, redirect_uris, grant_types, response_types,
        token_endpoint_auth_method, scope)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)`,
    [
      clientId,
      clientSecret ? hashMcpSecret(clientSecret) : null,
      metadata.client_name ?? null,
      redirectUris,
      grantTypes,
      responseTypes,
      authMethod,
      scope,
    ],
  );
  void pruneMcpOAuthState().catch(() => undefined);
  return {
    client_id: clientId,
    ...(clientSecret ? { client_secret: clientSecret } : {}),
    client_id_issued_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    redirect_uris: redirectUris,
    token_endpoint_auth_method: authMethod,
    grant_types: grantTypes,
    response_types: responseTypes,
    ...(metadata.client_name ? { client_name: metadata.client_name } : {}),
    scope,
  };
}

export async function authenticateMcpClient(input: {
  authorizationHeader?: string;
  clientId?: string;
  clientSecret?: string;
}): Promise<McpOAuthClient> {
  let clientId = input.clientId;
  let clientSecret = input.clientSecret;
  const header = input.authorizationHeader?.trim();
  if (header) {
    if (clientId !== undefined || clientSecret !== undefined) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(
        OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest,
        "Use either HTTP Basic client authentication or body credentials, not both.",
      );
    }
    const match = /^Basic\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/i.exec(header);
    if (!match) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Unsupported client authentication method.", 401);
    }
    let decoded: string;
    try {
      decoded = Buffer.from(match[1]!, "base64").toString("utf8");
    } catch {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Malformed client authentication.", 401);
    }
    const separator = decoded.indexOf(":");
    if (separator < 0) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Malformed client authentication.", 401);
    }
    try {
      clientId = decodeURIComponent(decoded.slice(0, separator));
      clientSecret = decodeURIComponent(decoded.slice(separator + 1));
    } catch {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Malformed client authentication.", 401);
    }
  }
  if (!clientId) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Client authentication is required.", 401);
  }
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<ClientSecretRow>(
    `SELECT client_secret_hash, token_endpoint_auth_method
       FROM public.mcp_oauth_clients
      WHERE client_id = $1`,
    [clientId],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Unknown OAuth client.", 401);
  }
  if (row.token_endpoint_auth_method === "none") {
    if (clientSecret) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "This client does not use a client secret.", 401);
    }
  } else {
    if (!clientSecret || !row.client_secret_hash || !safeHashEqual(hashMcpSecret(clientSecret), row.client_secret_hash)) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Client authentication failed.", 401);
    }
  }
  const client = await getMcpClient(clientId);
  if (!client) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidClient, "Unknown OAuth client.", 401);
  }
  void databasePool().query(
    "UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_clients SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE client_id = $1",
    [clientId],
  ).catch(() => undefined);
  return client;
}

export async function createMcpAuthorizationCode(input: {
  clientId: string;
  userId: string;
  redirectUri: string;
  scope?: string;
  resource?: string;
  codeChallenge: string;
  codeChallengeMethod: string;
}): Promise<string> {
  if (!input.userId) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.ServerError, "The signed-in user is missing.", 500);
  }
  const validated = await validateMcpAuthorizationRequest(input);
  const code = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + config.mcpAuthorizationCodeTtlSeconds * 1000);
  await databasePool().query(
    `INSERT INTO public.mcp_oauth_authorization_codes
       (code_hash, client_id, user_id, redirect_uri, scope, resource,
        code_challenge, code_challenge_method, expires_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'S256', $8)`,
    [
      hashMcpSecret(code),
      validated.client.clientId,
      input.userId,
      input.redirectUri,
      validated.scope,
      validated.resource,
      input.codeChallenge,
      expiresAt,
    ],
  );
  void pruneMcpOAuthState().catch(() => undefined);
  return code;
}

interface AuthorizationCodeRow {
  user_id: string;
  scope: string;
  resource: string;
  code_challenge: string;
  code_challenge_method: string;
}

interface RefreshTokenRow {
  user_id: string;
  scope: string;
  resource: string;
  family_id: string;
}

interface TokenProbeRow {
  family_id: string;
  revoked_at: Date | null;
  rotated_at: Date | null;
  expires_at: Date;
}

async function issueMcpTokens(
  client: McpOAuthClient,
  userId: string,
  scope: string,
  resource: string,
  familyId = randomBytes(16).toString("hex"),
): Promise<McpTokenResponse> {
  if (!client.grantTypes.includes("authorization_code") && !client.grantTypes.includes("refresh_token")) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.UnauthorizedClient, "This client may not obtain tokens.");
  }
  const accessToken = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const refreshToken = client.grantTypes.includes("refresh_token")
    ? randomBytes(48).toString("base64url")
    : undefined;
  const accessExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + config.mcpAccessTokenTtlSeconds * 1000);
  const refreshExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + config.mcpRefreshTokenTtlSeconds * 1000);
  const db = await databasePool().connect();
  let transactionStarted = false;
  try {
    await db.query("BEGIN");
    transactionStarted = true;
    await db.query(
      `INSERT INTO public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens
         (token_hash, client_id, user_id, scope, resource, family_id, expires_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
      [hashMcpSecret(accessToken), client.clientId, userId, scope, resource, familyId, accessExpiresAt],
    );
    if (refreshToken) {
      await db.query(
        `INSERT INTO public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens
           (token_hash, client_id, user_id, scope, resource, family_id, expires_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
        [hashMcpSecret(refreshToken), client.clientId, userId, scope, resource, familyId, refreshExpiresAt],
      );
    }
    await db.query("COMMIT");
    transactionStarted = false;
  } catch (error) {
    if (transactionStarted) await db.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => undefined);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    db.release();
  }
  return {
    access_token: accessToken,
    token_type: "Bearer",
    expires_in: config.mcpAccessTokenTtlSeconds,
    ...(refreshToken ? { refresh_token: refreshToken } : {}),
    scope,
  };
}

export async function exchangeMcpAuthorizationCode(
  client: McpOAuthClient,
  input: {
    code?: string;
    redirectUri?: string;
    codeVerifier?: string;
    resource?: string;
  },
): Promise<McpTokenResponse> {
  if (!client.grantTypes.includes("authorization_code")) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.UnauthorizedClient, "This client may not use the authorization-code grant.");
  }
  if (!input.code) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "code is required.");
  }
  if (!input.redirectUri) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "redirect_uri is required.");
  }
  if (!input.codeVerifier || !codeVerifierPattern.test(input.codeVerifier)) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "A valid PKCE code_verifier is required.");
  }
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<AuthorizationCodeRow>(
    `UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_authorization_codes
        SET consumed_at = NOW()
      WHERE code_hash = $1
        AND client_id = $2
        AND redirect_uri = $3
        AND consumed_at IS NULL
        AND expires_at > NOW()
      RETURNING user_id, scope, resource, code_challenge, code_challenge_method`,
    [hashMcpSecret(input.code), client.clientId, input.redirectUri],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row || row.code_challenge_method !== "S256") {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidGrant, "The authorization code is invalid, expired, or already used.");
  }
  const expectedChallenge = createHash("sha256").update(input.codeVerifier, "utf8").digest("base64url");
  if (!safeHashEqual(expectedChallenge, row.code_challenge)) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidGrant, "PKCE verification failed.");
  }
  if (input.resource) {
    let requestedResource: string;
    try {
      requestedResource = normalizeMcpResource(input.resource);
    } catch {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidGrant, "The resource does not match the authorization request.");
    }
    if (requestedResource !== row.resource) {
      throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidGrant, "The resource does not match the authorization request.");
    }
  }
  return issueMcpTokens(client, row.user_id, row.scope, row.resource);
}

async function revokeMcpTokenFamily(familyId: string): Promise<void> {
  await databasePool().query(
    "UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE family_id = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL",
    [familyId],
  );
  await databasePool().query(
    "UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE family_id = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL",
    [familyId],
  );
}

export async function refreshMcpTokens(
  client: McpOAuthClient,
  refreshToken: string,
): Promise<McpTokenResponse> {
  if (!client.grantTypes.includes("refresh_token")) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.UnauthorizedClient, "This client may not use refresh tokens.");
  }
  if (!refreshToken) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "refresh_token is required.");
  }
  const tokenHash = hashMcpSecret(refreshToken);
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<RefreshTokenRow>(
    `UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens
        SET rotated_at = NOW()
      WHERE token_hash = $1
        AND client_id = $2
        AND revoked_at IS NULL
        AND rotated_at IS NULL
        AND expires_at > NOW()
      RETURNING user_id, scope, resource, family_id`,
    [tokenHash, client.clientId],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row) {
    return issueMcpTokens(client, row.user_id, row.scope, row.resource, row.family_id);
  }
  const { rows: probe } = await databasePool().query<TokenProbeRow>(
    `SELECT family_id, revoked_at, rotated_at, expires_at
       FROM public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens
      WHERE token_hash = $1 AND client_id = $2`,
    [tokenHash, client.clientId],
  );
  const existing = probe[0];
  if (existing?.rotated_at) {
    // Refresh-token reuse: assume the token family is compromised and revoke
    // every access and refresh token derived from the same authorization.
    await revokeMcpTokenFamily(existing.family_id);
  }
  throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidGrant, "The refresh token is invalid, expired, or revoked.");
}

export async function revokeMcpToken(client: McpOAuthClient, token: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!token) {
    throw new McpOAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidRequest, "token is required.");
  }
  const tokenHash = hashMcpSecret(token);
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<{ family_id: string }>(
    `SELECT family_id
       FROM public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens
      WHERE token_hash = $1 AND client_id = $2`,
    [tokenHash, client.clientId],
  );
  const refresh = rows[0];
  if (refresh) {
    await revokeMcpTokenFamily(refresh.family_id);
    return;
  }
  await databasePool().query(
    `UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens
        SET revoked_at = NOW()
      WHERE token_hash = $1 AND client_id = $2 AND revoked_at IS NULL`,
    [tokenHash, client.clientId],
  );
}

interface AccessTokenRow {
  user_id: string;
  client_id: string;
  scope: string;
  resource: string;
  expires_at: Date;
}

export async function verifyMcpAccessToken(token: string): Promise<AuthInfo> {
  if (!token) {
    throw new OAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidToken, "An access token is required.");
  }
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  const { rows } = await databasePool().query<AccessTokenRow>(
    `SELECT user_id, client_id, scope, resource, expires_at
       FROM public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens
      WHERE token_hash = $1
        AND revoked_at IS NULL
        AND expires_at > NOW()`,
    [hashMcpSecret(token)],
  );
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new OAuthError(OAuthErrorCode.InvalidToken, "The access token is invalid or expired.");
  }
  void databasePool().query(
    "UPDATE public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE token_hash = $1",
    [hashMcpSecret(token)],
  ).catch(() => undefined);
  return {
    token,
    clientId: row.client_id,
    scopes: row.scope.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean),
    expiresAt: Math.floor(row.expires_at.getTime() / 1000),
    resource: new URL(row.resource),
    extra: { userId: row.user_id },
  };
}

export async function pruneMcpOAuthState(): Promise<void> {
  await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
  await databasePool().query(
    "DELETE FROM public.mcp_oauth_authorization_codes WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'",
  );
  await databasePool().query(
    "DELETE FROM public.mcp_oauth_access_tokens WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'",
  );
  await databasePool().query(
    "DELETE FROM public.mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'",
  );
}

import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import { config } from "../config/env.js";
import { buildFrontendRedirectUrl, expectedPlatformsForCallbackPath } from "./oauth-sessions.js";
import { finishAuthorization, oauthPostgresSessionStore, processOAuthCallback } from "./oauth.js";

const resultMessages: Record<string, string> = {
  connected: "Authorization completed. You can close this tab.",
  cancelled: "Authorization was cancelled or denied. You can close this tab.",
  expired: "This authorization request expired. Start a new connection from the accounts page.",
  failed: "Authorization could not be completed. Return to the accounts page for details.",
};

function sendHtml(response: ServerResponse, message: string, status = 200): void {
  response.writeHead(status, {
    "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
    "cache-control": "no-store",
    "x-content-type-options": "nosniff",
  });
  response.end(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Authorization</title></head><body><p>${message}</p></body></html>`);
}

function redirect(response: ServerResponse, location: string): void {
  response.writeHead(302, {
    location,
    "cache-control": "no-store",
    "referrer-policy": "no-referrer",
  });
  response.end();
}

// Handles GET /oauth/meta/callback and GET /oauth/linkedin/callback on the
// public worker. It returns false for any other route so the worker can keep its
// own 404 behavior. The browser only ever learns a coarse outcome: the session
// status is read by the authenticated frontend, never from this response.
export async function handleOAuthCallback(request: IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse): Promise<boolean> {
  const url = new URL(request.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
  const expectedPlatforms = expectedPlatformsForCallbackPath(url.pathname);
  if (!expectedPlatforms) return false;

  let outcome;
  try {
    outcome = await processOAuthCallback(url.searchParams, expectedPlatforms, {
      store: oauthPostgresSessionStore(),
      finish: finishAuthorization,
    });
  } catch {
    // Database or unexpected failure: never surface internals to the browser.
    outcome = { result: "failed" as const };
  }

  const location = buildFrontendRedirectUrl(config.oauthFrontendBaseUrl, outcome.result, outcome.platform);
  if (location) {
    redirect(response, location);
    return true;
  }
  sendHtml(response, resultMessages[outcome.result] ?? resultMessages["failed"]!);
  return true;
}

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { databasePool } from "../database.js";
import { ensureDatabaseMigrations } from "../database-migrations.js";
import type { Platform } from "../platforms/types.js";

// Authorization sessions exist for the brief window between starting a provider
// OAuth flow and receiving the browser callback. In local mode they live in
// process memory (mirroring the original behavior); in cloud mode they are
// persisted in PostgreSQL so any Render instance can complete the callback.
export type OAuthSessionStatus = "pending" | "connected" | "cancelled" | "failed" | "expired";
// `processing` is an internal claim marker written atomically before the token
// exchange runs. The frontend still sees it as `pending`.
export type OAuthStoredStatus = OAuthSessionStatus | "processing";

export interface AuthorizationSessionStatus {
  sessionId: string;
  platform: Platform;
  status: OAuthSessionStatus;
  expiresAt: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface CreateOAuthSessionInput {
  sessionId: string;
  state: string;
  userId: string;
  platform: Platform;
  redirectUri: string;
  expiresAt: number;
  // Fingerprint of the Developer App credentials used to build the consent URL.
  // Optional so sessions created before the feature keep working.
  appCredentialFingerprint?: string;
}

export interface ClaimedOAuthSession {
  sessionId: string;
  userId: string;
  platform: Platform;
  redirectUri: string;
  expiresAt: number;
  appCredentialFingerprint?: string;
}

export type OAuthClaimFailure = "unknown" | "expired" | "used" | "wrong_platform";
export type OAuthClaimResult =
  | { claimed: true; session: ClaimedOAuthSession }
  | { claimed: false; reason: OAuthClaimFailure };

export interface OAuthSessionStore {
  create(input: CreateOAuthSessionInput): Promise<void>;
  claim(state: string, expectedPlatforms: readonly Platform[]): Promise<OAuthClaimResult>;
  getStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus>;
  updateStatus(sessionId: string, status: OAuthSessionStatus, error?: string): Promise<void>;
  waitForStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string, timeoutSeconds: number): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus>;
}

export const authorizationLifetimeMs = 15 * 60 * 1000;
const sessionRetentionMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const sessionMissingMessage = "Authorization session not found or expired. Start a new authorization request.";

// The raw state value is a bearer-style secret: whoever holds it can complete a
// pending authorization. Cloud persistence therefore stores only its SHA-256
// digest, which is enough for an exact-match lookup and never exposes the value.
export function hashOAuthState(state: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(state, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

export function expectedPlatformsForCallbackPath(pathname: string): readonly Platform[] | null {
  if (pathname === "/oauth/meta/callback") return ["facebook", "instagram"];
  if (pathname === "/oauth/linkedin/callback") return ["linkedin"];
  return null;
}

export function isOAuthCallbackPath(rawUrl: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (!rawUrl) return false;
  let pathname: string;
  try {
    pathname = new URL(rawUrl, "http://localhost").pathname;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  return expectedPlatformsForCallbackPath(pathname) !== null;
}

export type OAuthRedirectResult = "connected" | "cancelled" | "failed" | "expired";

// Builds the only browser redirect this app ever emits after a provider
// callback: a fixed `/accounts` path on the configured frontend origin. Because
// the origin comes from configuration (never the request) and the path is
// constant, there is no way for a caller to turn this into an open redirect.
export function buildFrontendRedirectUrl(
  frontendBaseUrl: string,
  result: OAuthRedirectResult,
  platform?: Platform,
): string | null {
  const base = frontendBaseUrl.trim();
  if (!base) return null;
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(base);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" && parsed.protocol !== "http:") return null;
  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return null;
  const redirect = new URL("/accounts", parsed);
  redirect.searchParams.set("oauth", result);
  if (platform) redirect.searchParams.set("platform", platform);
  return redirect.toString();
}

function redirectResultForClaimFailure(reason: OAuthClaimFailure): OAuthRedirectResult {
  return reason === "expired" ? "expired" : "failed";
}

export function claimFailureResult(reason: OAuthClaimFailure): "failed" | "expired" {
  return redirectResultForClaimFailure(reason) === "expired" ? "expired" : "failed";
}

interface MemoryRecord {
  sessionId: string;
  state: string;
  userId: string;
  platform: Platform;
  redirectUri: string;
  status: OAuthStoredStatus;
  error?: string;
  createdAt: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  appCredentialFingerprint?: string;
}

function isTerminal(status: OAuthStoredStatus): boolean {
  return status === "connected" || status === "cancelled" || status === "failed" || status === "expired";
}

function statusView(record: MemoryRecord): AuthorizationSessionStatus {
  const expiredByTime = record.expiresAt <= Date.now();
  const status: OAuthSessionStatus = record.status === "processing"
    ? "pending"
    : record.status;
  const resolved: OAuthSessionStatus = expiredByTime && status === "pending" ? "expired" : status;
  return {
    sessionId: record.sessionId,
    platform: record.platform,
    status: resolved,
    expiresAt: record.expiresAt,
    ...(record.error ? { error: record.error } : {}),
  };
}

export class InMemoryOAuthSessionStore implements OAuthSessionStore {
  private readonly byState = new Map<string, MemoryRecord>();
  private readonly byId = new Map<string, MemoryRecord>();
  private readonly waiters = new Map<string, Set<(status: AuthorizationSessionStatus) => void>>();
  private readonly timers = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>();

  async create(input: CreateOAuthSessionInput): Promise<void> {
    this.prune();
    const record: MemoryRecord = {
      sessionId: input.sessionId,
      state: input.state,
      userId: input.userId,
      platform: input.platform,
      redirectUri: input.redirectUri,
      status: "pending",
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      expiresAt: input.expiresAt,
      ...(input.appCredentialFingerprint ? { appCredentialFingerprint: input.appCredentialFingerprint } : {}),
    };
    this.byState.set(record.state, record);
    this.byId.set(record.sessionId, record);
    const delay = Math.max(0, record.expiresAt - Date.now());
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.timers.delete(record.sessionId);
      if (!isTerminal(record.status)) {
        this.applyStatus(record, "expired", "The authorization request expired before the provider callback arrived.");
      }
    }, delay);
    timer.unref();
    this.timers.set(record.sessionId, timer);
  }

  async claim(state: string, expectedPlatforms: readonly Platform[]): Promise<OAuthClaimResult> {
    const record = this.byState.get(state);
    if (!record) return { claimed: false, reason: "unknown" };
    // Reject a state presented on the wrong callback route before consuming it
    // so a legitimate callback on the correct route can still succeed.
    if (!expectedPlatforms.includes(record.platform)) return { claimed: false, reason: "wrong_platform" };
    if (record.expiresAt <= Date.now()) {
      if (!isTerminal(record.status)) {
        this.applyStatus(record, "expired", "The authorization request expired before the provider callback arrived.");
      }
      return { claimed: false, reason: "expired" };
    }
    if (record.status !== "pending") return { claimed: false, reason: "used" };
    record.status = "processing";
    return {
      claimed: true,
      session: {
        sessionId: record.sessionId,
        userId: record.userId,
        platform: record.platform,
        redirectUri: record.redirectUri,
        expiresAt: record.expiresAt,
        ...(record.appCredentialFingerprint ? { appCredentialFingerprint: record.appCredentialFingerprint } : {}),
      },
    };
  }

  async getStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus> {
    const record = this.requireOwned(sessionId, userId);
    this.expireIfNeeded(record);
    return statusView(record);
  }

  async updateStatus(sessionId: string, status: OAuthSessionStatus, error?: string): Promise<void> {
    const record = this.byId.get(sessionId);
    if (!record) return;
    this.applyStatus(record, status, error);
  }

  async waitForStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string, timeoutSeconds: number): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus> {
    const record = this.requireOwned(sessionId, userId);
    this.expireIfNeeded(record);
    if (record.status !== "pending" || timeoutSeconds === 0) return statusView(record);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const waiters = this.waiters.get(sessionId) ?? new Set<(status: AuthorizationSessionStatus) => void>();
      let timer: NodeJS.Timeout;
      const finish = (status: AuthorizationSessionStatus) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        waiters.delete(finish);
        resolve(status);
      };
      timer = setTimeout(() => finish(statusView(record)), timeoutSeconds * 1000);
      timer.unref();
      waiters.add(finish);
      this.waiters.set(sessionId, waiters);
    });
  }

  private requireOwned(sessionId: string, userId: string): MemoryRecord {
    const record = this.byId.get(sessionId);
    if (!record || record.userId !== userId) throw new Error(sessionMissingMessage);
    return record;
  }

  private expireIfNeeded(record: MemoryRecord): void {
    if (record.expiresAt <= Date.now() && !isTerminal(record.status)) {
      const timer = this.timers.get(record.sessionId);
      if (timer) this.timers.delete(record.sessionId);
      this.applyStatus(record, "expired", "The authorization request expired before the provider callback arrived.");
    }
  }

  private applyStatus(record: MemoryRecord, status: OAuthSessionStatus, error?: string): void {
    record.status = status;
    if (error) record.error = error;
    else delete record.error;
    record.completedAt = Date.now();
    const view = statusView(record);
    const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.sessionId);
    if (waiters) {
      for (const resolve of waiters) resolve(view);
      waiters.clear();
    }
    const timer = this.timers.get(record.sessionId);
    if (timer && isTerminal(status)) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      this.timers.delete(record.sessionId);
    }
  }

  private prune(): void {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - sessionRetentionMs;
    for (const [sessionId, record] of this.byId) {
      if (record.completedAt === undefined || record.completedAt >= cutoff) continue;
      this.byId.delete(sessionId);
      this.byState.delete(record.state);
      const timer = this.timers.get(sessionId);
      if (timer) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        this.timers.delete(sessionId);
      }
      this.waiters.delete(sessionId);
    }
  }
}

interface PostgresSessionRow {
  session_id: string;
  platform: Platform;
  status: OAuthStoredStatus;
  expires_at: Date;
  error: string | null;
}

function postgresStatus(row: { status: OAuthStoredStatus; expires_at: Date }): OAuthSessionStatus {
  const status: OAuthSessionStatus = row.status === "processing" ? "pending" : row.status;
  return row.expires_at.getTime() <= Date.now() && status === "pending" ? "expired" : status;
}

function delay(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds);
    timer.unref();
  });
}

export class PostgresOAuthSessionStore implements OAuthSessionStore {
  async create(input: CreateOAuthSessionInput): Promise<void> {
    // Ensure migration 009 (which adds app_credential_fingerprint) has run before
    // writing the session. The runner is idempotent and memoized, so this adds a
    // single check on the first session after a deploy.
    await ensureDatabaseMigrations();
    await databasePool().query(
      `INSERT INTO public.oauth_authorization_sessions
         (session_id, state_hash, user_id, platform, redirect_uri, status, expires_at, app_credential_fingerprint)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'pending', $6, $7)`,
      [
        input.sessionId,
        hashOAuthState(input.state),
        input.userId,
        input.platform,
        input.redirectUri,
        new Date(input.expiresAt),
        input.appCredentialFingerprint ?? null,
      ],
    );
  }

  async claim(state: string, expectedPlatforms: readonly Platform[]): Promise<OAuthClaimResult> {
    const stateHash = hashOAuthState(state);
    // A single conditional UPDATE is the atomic claim: only one caller can flip
    // `pending` to `processing`, and only for the expected callback platform.
    const { rows } = await databasePool().query<{
      session_id: string;
      user_id: string;
      platform: Platform;
      redirect_uri: string;
      expires_at: Date;
      app_credential_fingerprint: string | null;
    }>(
      `UPDATE public.oauth_authorization_sessions
          SET status = 'processing', claimed_at = NOW()
        WHERE state_hash = $1
          AND status = 'pending'
          AND expires_at > NOW()
          AND platform = ANY($2::text[])
        RETURNING session_id, user_id, platform, redirect_uri, expires_at, app_credential_fingerprint`,
      [stateHash, [...expectedPlatforms]],
    );
    const row = rows[0];
    if (row) {
      return {
        claimed: true,
        session: {
          sessionId: row.session_id,
          userId: row.user_id,
          platform: row.platform,
          redirectUri: row.redirect_uri,
          expiresAt: row.expires_at.getTime(),
          ...(row.app_credential_fingerprint ? { appCredentialFingerprint: row.app_credential_fingerprint } : {}),
        },
      };
    }

    // Nothing was claimed; determine why without mutating unrelated state.
    const { rows: probe } = await databasePool().query<{
      status: OAuthStoredStatus;
      expires_at: Date;
      platform: Platform;
    }>(
      `SELECT status, expires_at, platform
         FROM public.oauth_authorization_sessions
        WHERE state_hash = $1`,
      [stateHash],
    );
    const existing = probe[0];
    if (!existing) return { claimed: false, reason: "unknown" };
    if (!expectedPlatforms.includes(existing.platform)) return { claimed: false, reason: "wrong_platform" };
    if (existing.expires_at.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      await databasePool().query(
        `UPDATE public.oauth_authorization_sessions
            SET status = 'expired', completed_at = NOW()
          WHERE state_hash = $1 AND status = 'pending'`,
        [stateHash],
      );
      return { claimed: false, reason: "expired" };
    }
    return { claimed: false, reason: "used" };
  }

  async getStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus> {
    const { rows } = await databasePool().query<PostgresSessionRow>(
      `SELECT session_id, platform, status, expires_at, error
         FROM public.oauth_authorization_sessions
        WHERE session_id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
      [sessionId, userId],
    );
    const row = rows[0];
    if (!row) throw new Error(sessionMissingMessage);
    return {
      sessionId: row.session_id,
      platform: row.platform,
      status: postgresStatus(row),
      expiresAt: row.expires_at.getTime(),
      ...(row.error ? { error: row.error } : {}),
    };
  }

  async updateStatus(sessionId: string, status: OAuthSessionStatus, error?: string): Promise<void> {
    await databasePool().query(
      `UPDATE public.oauth_authorization_sessions
          SET status = $2,
              error = $3,
              completed_at = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('connected', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'expired')
                                  THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END
        WHERE session_id = $1`,
      [sessionId, status, error ?? null],
    );
  }

  async waitForStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string, timeoutSeconds: number): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutSeconds * 1000;
    for (;;) {
      const status = await this.getStatus(sessionId, userId);
      if (status.status !== "pending" || timeoutSeconds === 0) return status;
      if (Date.now() >= deadline) return status;
      await delay(Math.min(1000, Math.max(0, deadline - Date.now())));
    }
  }
}

const scheduledMedia = new Map<string, { imagePath: string; contentType: string }>();
const inMemoryOAuthSessionStore = new InMemoryOAuthSessionStore();
const postgresOAuthSessionStore = new PostgresOAuthSessionStore();
let callbackServer: ReturnType<typeof createServer> | undefined;

export function instagramPermissionScopes(permissions: string | string[] | undefined): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(permissions)) return permissions.flatMap((permission) => permission.split(/[,\s]+/)).filter(Boolean);
  return permissions?.split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean) ?? [];
}

// The exact callback URL registered with each provider. It is derived from the
// configured base URL (an ngrok tunnel locally, the Render worker in cloud mode)
// and is persisted with the authorization session so the token exchange reuses
// byte-identical `redirect_uri` values.
export function oauthCallbackUrl(platform: Platform): string {
  return `${config.redirectBaseUrl}/oauth/${platform === "linkedin" ? "linkedin" : "meta"}/callback`;
}

// Store selected by OAUTH_CALLBACK_MODE. Local mode keeps the original in-memory
// behavior; cloud mode persists sessions in PostgreSQL.
export function oauthSessionStore(): OAuthSessionStore {
  return config.oauthCallbackMode === "cloud" ? postgresOAuthSessionStore : inMemoryOAuthSessionStore;
}

// The public worker always completes callbacks against PostgreSQL, even if it is
// started without OAUTH_CALLBACK_MODE so an existing deployment cannot break.
export function oauthPostgresSessionStore(): OAuthSessionStore {
  return postgresOAuthSessionStore;
}

function html(response: ServerResponse, message: string, status = 200): void {
  response.writeHead(status, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" });
  response.end(`<!doctype html><html><body><p>${message}</p><p>You may close this tab.</p></body></html>`);
}

function safeErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown token exchange or storage error.";
  return message
    .replace(/(client_secret|access_token|refresh_token|authorization_code|code)=([^&\s]+)/gi, "$1=[redacted]")
    .slice(0, 700);
}

function requireClientSecret(credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials, provider: string): void {
  if (credentials.clientSecret) return;
  if (credentials.source === "user") {
    throw new Error(`Your saved ${provider} app secret could not be read on this server. Re-save it on the Accounts page, or check APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.`);
  }
  throw new Error(`Set the shared ${provider} app secret environment variable before completing this authorization.`);
}

async function handleCallback(request: IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
  const url = new URL(request.url ?? "/", `http://localhost:${config.imageServerPort}`);
  const mediaMatch = /^\/scheduled-media\/([a-f0-9]{64})$/.exec(url.pathname);
  if (mediaMatch && (request.method === "GET" || request.method === "HEAD")) {
    const media = scheduledMedia.get(mediaMatch[1]!);
    if (!media) {
      html(response, "Scheduled media was not found.", 404);
      return;
    }
    void readFile(media.imagePath).then(
      (image) => {
        response.writeHead(200, {
          "content-type": media.contentType,
          "content-length": image.byteLength,
          "cache-control": "no-store",
          "x-content-type-options": "nosniff",
        });
        response.end(request.method === "HEAD" ? undefined : image);
      },
      () => html(response, "Scheduled media is temporarily unavailable.", 503),
    );
    return;
  }
  const expectedPlatforms = expectedPlatformsForCallbackPath(url.pathname);
  if (!expectedPlatforms) {
    html(response, "This OAuth callback route does not exist.", 404);
    return;
  }
  // Claim from the same store the session was created in. `beginAuthorization`
  // persists sessions in PostgreSQL when OAUTH_CALLBACK_MODE=cloud, so a local
  // listener receiving tunneled callbacks in that mode must claim from the
  // Postgres store too; claiming from process memory would always fail.
  const outcome = await processOAuthCallback(url.searchParams, expectedPlatforms, {
    store: oauthSessionStore(),
    finish: finishAuthorization,
  });
  if (outcome.result === "connected") {
    html(response, "Authorization completed. Return to the MCP client and check the connection status.");
  } else if (outcome.result === "cancelled") {
    html(response, "Authorization was cancelled or denied. Return to the MCP client to start a new request.", 400);
  } else if (outcome.result === "expired") {
    html(response, "This authorization request is expired or invalid.", 400);
  } else {
    html(response, "Authorization could not be completed. Return to the MCP client for status and error details.", 400);
  }
}

export async function registerScheduledMedia(
  mediaToken: string,
  imagePath: string,
  contentType: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(mediaToken)) throw new Error("Scheduled media token is invalid.");
  await ensureCallbackServer();
  scheduledMedia.set(mediaToken, { imagePath, contentType });
}

export function unregisterScheduledMedia(mediaToken: string): void {
  scheduledMedia.delete(mediaToken);
}

async function ensureCallbackServer(): Promise<void> {
  if (callbackServer?.listening) return;
  if (callbackServerPromise) return callbackServerPromise;
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    void handleCallback(request, response).catch(() => {
      if (response.headersSent) {
        response.end();
        return;
      }
      response.writeHead(500, { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store" });
      response.end("OAuth callback failed.");
    });
  });
  callbackServer = server;
  callbackServerPromise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const onError = (error: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
      server.off("listening", onListening);
      if (callbackServer === server) callbackServer = undefined;
      callbackServerPromise = undefined;
      reject(new Error(`Could not start the local image/OAuth server on port ${config.imageServerPort}: ${error.message}`));
    };
    const onListening = () => {
      server.off("error", onError);
      callbackServerPromise = undefined;
      resolve();
    };
    server.once("error", onError);
    server.once("listening", onListening);
    server.listen(config.imageServerPort, "127.0.0.1");
  });
  return callbackServerPromise;
}

// Shared callback core used by both the local listener and the public worker
// callback handler. It claims the state atomically, handles provider
// cancellation, exchanges the code, and records the terminal status. It never
// logs or returns the state, code, tokens, or client secrets.
export async function processOAuthCallback(
  searchParams: URLSearchParams,
  expectedPlatforms: readonly Platform[],
  dependencies: OAuthCallbackDependencies,
): Promise<OAuthCallbackOutcome> {
  const state = searchParams.get("state");
  if (!state) return { result: "failed" };

  const claim = await dependencies.store.claim(state, expectedPlatforms);
  if (!claim.claimed) return { result: claimFailureResult(claim.reason) };
  const session = claim.session;

  const providerError = searchParams.get("error_description")
    ?? searchParams.get("error_reason")
    ?? searchParams.get("error");
  if (providerError) {
    await dependencies.store.updateStatus(session.sessionId, "cancelled", "The provider authorization was cancelled or denied.");
    await recordActivity({
      actorUserId: session.userId,
      targetUserId: session.userId,
      action: "social_account_connection_cancelled",
      resourceType: "social_account",
      resourceId: `${session.userId}:${session.platform}`,
      metadata: { platform: session.platform },
    });
    return { result: "cancelled", platform: session.platform, sessionId: session.sessionId };
  }

  const code = searchParams.get("code");
  if (!code) {
    await dependencies.store.updateStatus(session.sessionId, "failed", "The provider callback did not include an authorization code.");
    await recordActivity({
      actorUserId: session.userId,
      targetUserId: session.userId,
      action: "social_account_connection_failed",
      resourceType: "social_account",
      resourceId: `${session.userId}:${session.platform}`,
      metadata: { platform: session.platform, reason: "missing_authorization_code" },
    });
    return { result: "failed", platform: session.platform, sessionId: session.sessionId };
  }

  try {
    await dependencies.finish(session.platform, session.userId, code, session.redirectUri, session.appCredentialFingerprint);
    await dependencies.store.updateStatus(session.sessionId, "connected");
    await recordActivity({
      actorUserId: session.userId,
      targetUserId: session.userId,
      action: "social_account_connected",
      resourceType: "social_account",
      resourceId: `${session.userId}:${session.platform}`,
      metadata: { platform: session.platform },
    });
    return { result: "connected", platform: session.platform, sessionId: session.sessionId };
  } catch (error) {
    const failure = safeErrorMessage(error);
    await dependencies.store.updateStatus(session.sessionId, "failed", failure);
    await recordActivity({
      actorUserId: session.userId,
      targetUserId: session.userId,
      action: "social_account_connection_failed",
      resourceType: "social_account",
      resourceId: `${session.userId}:${session.platform}`,
      metadata: { platform: session.platform, error: failure },
    });
    return { result: "failed", platform: session.platform, sessionId: session.sessionId };
  }
}

export async function getAuthorizationStatus(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<AuthorizationSessionStatus> {
  return oauthSessionStore().getStatus(sessionId, userId);
}

function appLabel(platform: Platform): string {
  if (platform === "facebook") return "Facebook";
  if (platform === "instagram") return "Instagram";
  return "LinkedIn";
}

export function validateAuthorizationConfiguration(platform: Platform, credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials): void {
  const cloud = config.oauthCallbackMode === "cloud";
  if (!credentials.clientId) {
    throw new Error(credentials.source === "user"
      ? `Your saved ${appLabel(platform)} app/client ID is missing. Re-save it on the Accounts page.`
      : `Set the shared ${appLabel(platform)} app/client ID before connecting.`);
  }
  // In cloud mode the secret is only needed by the worker that runs the code
  // exchange, never by the request that builds the consent URL.
  if (!cloud && !credentials.clientSecret) {
    throw new Error(credentials.source === "user"
      ? `Your saved ${appLabel(platform)} app secret is not available on this server. Re-save it on the Accounts page.`
      : `Set the shared ${appLabel(platform)} app secret before connecting.`);
  }
  const redirectUri = oauthCallbackUrl(platform);
  if (cloud && !redirectUri.startsWith("https://")) {
    throw new Error("OAUTH_CALLBACK_MODE=cloud requires OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL to be a public HTTPS base URL (for example the deployed worker URL).");
  }
  if (platform === "linkedin" && !redirectUri.startsWith("https://")) {
    throw new Error("LinkedIn requires an HTTPS callback URL. Set OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL to an HTTPS tunnel URL and register the matching callback in your LinkedIn app.");
  }
  if (platform === "instagram" && !redirectUri.startsWith("https://")) {
    throw new Error("Instagram Login requires an HTTPS callback URL. Set OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL to an HTTPS tunnel URL and register the matching callback in your Instagram app.");
  }
}

export async function beginAuthorization(platform: Platform, userId: string): Promise<{
  authorizationUrl: string;
  sessionId: string;
  expiresAt: number;
}> {
  // Build the consent URL with the user's own Developer App when configured,
  // otherwise the shared environment app. The secret is only decrypted when this
  // process also runs the token exchange (local mode); a cloud request needs only
  // the public client id and the version fingerprint.
  const credentials = await resolveAppCredentials(userId, platform, {
    includeSecret: config.oauthCallbackMode !== "cloud",
  });
  validateAuthorizationConfiguration(platform, credentials);
  const redirectUri = oauthCallbackUrl(platform);
  // Only local development needs the localhost listener. A cloud worker or
  // Vercel request must not bind a local port to receive the callback.
  if (config.oauthCallbackMode !== "cloud") await ensureCallbackServer();
  const state = randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
  const sessionId = randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
  const expiresAt = Date.now() + authorizationLifetimeMs;
  await oauthSessionStore().create({
    sessionId,
    state,
    userId,
    platform,
    redirectUri,
    expiresAt,
    appCredentialFingerprint: credentials.fingerprint,
  });
  if (platform === "linkedin") {
    const url = new URL("https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization");
    url.search = new URLSearchParams({
      response_type: "code",
      client_id: credentials.clientId,
      redirect_uri: redirectUri,
      state,
      scope: config.linkedinScopes.join(" "),
    }).toString();
    return { authorizationUrl: url.toString(), sessionId, expiresAt };
  }
  if (platform === "instagram") {
    const url = new URL("https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize");
    url.search = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: credentials.clientId,
      redirect_uri: redirectUri,
      state,
      response_type: "code",
      scope: config.instagramScopes.join(","),
      enable_fb_login: "false",
    }).toString();
    return { authorizationUrl: url.toString(), sessionId, expiresAt };
  }
  const url = new URL(`https://www.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/dialog/oauth`);
  url.search = new URLSearchParams({
    client_id: credentials.clientId,
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
    state,
    response_type: "code",
    scope: ["pages_show_list", "pages_read_engagement", "pages_manage_posts"].join(","),
  }).toString();
  return { authorizationUrl: url.toString(), sessionId, expiresAt };
}

// Dispatches to the correct provider exchange. The platform stored in the
// authorization session decides which credentials and token slot are used, so a
// Facebook authorization can never overwrite an Instagram token. The optional
// fingerprint is the credential version recorded when the flow started; a
// mismatch means the user edited their app mid-flow, so the exchange is refused
// rather than run against a different app.
export async function finishAuthorization(
  platform: Platform,
  userId: string,
  code: string,
  redirectUri: string,
  appCredentialFingerprint?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const credentials = await resolveAppCredentials(userId, platform);
  assertAppCredentialFingerprint(appCredentialFingerprint, credentials.fingerprint);
  if (platform === "linkedin") {
    requireClientSecret(credentials, "LinkedIn");
    await finishLinkedInAuthorization(userId, code, redirectUri, credentials);
    return;
  }
  if (platform === "instagram") {
    requireClientSecret(credentials, "Instagram");
    await finishInstagramAuthorization(userId, code, redirectUri, credentials);
    return;
  }
  requireClientSecret(credentials, "Facebook");
  await finishMetaAuthorization(userId, code, redirectUri, platform, credentials);
}

async function finishInstagramAuthorization(
  userId: string,
  code: string,
  redirectUri: string,
  credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials,
): Promise<void> {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.set("client_id", credentials.clientId);
  form.set("client_secret", credentials.clientSecret ?? "");
  form.set("grant_type", "authorization_code");
  form.set("redirect_uri", redirectUri);
  form.set("code", code);
  const { data: shortResponse } = await apiRequest<InstagramTokenResponse>(
    "https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token",
    { method: "POST", body: form },
  );
  const shortToken = shortResponse.data?.[0] ?? shortResponse;
  if (!shortToken.access_token || shortToken.user_id === undefined) {
    throw new Error("Instagram did not return an access token and user ID.");
  }

  const longTokenUrl = new URL("https://graph.instagram.com/access_token");
  longTokenUrl.search = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: "ig_exchange_token",
    client_secret: credentials.clientSecret ?? "",
    access_token: shortToken.access_token,
  }).toString();
  const { data: longToken } = await apiRequest<TokenResponse>(longTokenUrl);
  const { data: profile } = await apiRequest<{ user_id?: string | number; id?: string; username?: string }>(
    `https://graph.instagram.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/me?fields=user_id,username`,
    { accessToken: longToken.access_token },
  );
  const accountId = profile.user_id ?? profile.id ?? shortToken.user_id;
  const scopes = instagramPermissionScopes(shortToken.permissions);
  const vault = await loadTokens(userId);
  vault.instagram = {
    accessToken: longToken.access_token,
    ...(longToken.expires_in ? { expiresAt: Date.now() + longToken.expires_in * 1000 } : {}),
    scopes,
    connectedAt: Date.now(),
    accountId: String(accountId),
    ...(profile.username ? { accountName: profile.username } : {}),
  };
  await saveTokens(userId, vault);
}

async function finishMetaAuthorization(
  userId: string,
  code: string,
  redirectUri: string,
  platform: MetaPlatform,
  credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials,
): Promise<void> {
  const shortToken = await exchangeMetaCode(code, redirectUri, credentials);
  const tokenUrl = new URL(`https://graph.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/oauth/access_token`);
  tokenUrl.search = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: "fb_exchange_token",
    client_id: credentials.clientId,
    client_secret: credentials.clientSecret ?? "",
    fb_exchange_token: shortToken,
  }).toString();
  const { data: longToken } = await apiRequest<TokenResponse>(tokenUrl);
  const { data: profile } = await apiRequest<{ id: string; name?: string }>(
    `https://graph.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/me?fields=id,name`,
    { accessToken: longToken.access_token },
  );
  let scopes: string[] = [];
  try {
    const { data } = await apiRequest<MetaPermissions>(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/me/permissions`,
      { accessToken: longToken.access_token },
    );
    scopes = (data.data ?? []).filter((entry) => entry.status === "granted").map((entry) => entry.permission);
  } catch {
    scopes = [];
  }
  let pages: MetaPage[] = [];
  try {
    const { data } = await apiRequest<MetaPagesResponse>(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/me/accounts?fields=id,name,access_token,tasks,instagram_business_account{id,username}`,
      { accessToken: longToken.access_token },
    );
    pages = (data.data ?? []).map((page) => ({
      id: page.id,
      name: page.name,
      accessToken: page.access_token,
      tasks: page.tasks ?? [],
      ...(page.instagram_business_account ? { instagramAccount: page.instagram_business_account } : {}),
    }));
  } catch {
    pages = [];
  }
  const vault = await loadTokens(userId);
  const record: StoredToken = {
    accessToken: longToken.access_token,
    ...(longToken.expires_in ? { expiresAt: Date.now() + longToken.expires_in * 1000 } : {}),
    scopes,
    connectedAt: Date.now(),
    accountId: profile.id,
    ...(profile.name ? { accountName: profile.name } : {}),
    pages,
  };
  vault[platform] = record;
  await saveTokens(userId, vault);
}

async function exchangeMetaCode(
  code: string,
  redirectUri: string,
  credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = new URL(`https://graph.facebook.com/${config.metaGraphVersion}/oauth/access_token`);
  url.search = new URLSearchParams({
    client_id: credentials.clientId,
    client_secret: credentials.clientSecret ?? "",
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
    code,
  }).toString();
  const { data } = await apiRequest<TokenResponse>(url);
  return data.access_token;
}

async function finishLinkedInAuthorization(
  userId: string,
  code: string,
  redirectUri: string,
  credentials: ResolvedAppCredentials,
): Promise<void> {
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: "authorization_code",
    code,
    client_id: credentials.clientId,
    client_secret: credentials.clientSecret ?? "",
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
  });
  const { data: token } = await apiRequest<TokenResponse>("https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body,
  });
  const { data: profile } = await apiRequest<{ sub: string; name?: string }>(
    "https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo",
    { accessToken: token.access_token },
  );
  const vault = await loadTokens(userId);
  vault.linkedin = {
    accessToken: token.access_token,
    ...(token.refresh_token ? { refreshToken: token.refresh_token } : {}),
    ...(token.expires_in ? { expiresAt: Date.now() + token.expires_in * 1000 } : {}),
    scopes: token.scope?.split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean) ?? config.linkedinScopes,
    connectedAt: Date.now(),
    accountId: profile.sub,
    ...(profile.name ? { accountName: profile.name } : {}),
  };
  await saveTokens(userId, vault);
}

FILE: social-media-mcp/src/auth/token-store.ts
