This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load [Geist](https://vercel.com/font), a new font family for Vercel.

## Environment

Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill in the values. In addition to the
auth variables, the OAuth/worker modules read `DATABASE_URL`,
`OAUTH_CALLBACK_MODE=cloud`, `OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL`, `OAUTH_FRONTEND_BASE_URL`,
and the public `META_APP_ID` / `INSTAGRAM_APP_ID` / `LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID` values from
the Vercel environment.

On Vercel, set `DATABASE_URL` to the Supabase **pooler** URL (transaction mode,
port 6543, with `?sslmode=require`); see `.env.example`. Serverless isolates
opening direct connections (`db.<ref>.supabase.co:5432`) can exhaust the
database's connection cap and intermittently break session verification with the
"Can't verify your session" screen. Keep the direct URL only for long-running
workers such as the Render backend.

`APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is also required on Vercel: `POST /api/credentials`
encrypts each signed-in user's Developer App secret before it is stored. Use the
same 64-character hex value as the Render worker, generate it with
`node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"`,
and never expose it through `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`, a client bundle, an API response, or
logs. Users can save, update, and delete their Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
app credentials from **Accounts → Developer App Settings**; deleting them never
disconnects an account or cancels a scheduled post.

## Authenticated media upload

Remote MCP tools (for example the Claude.ai connector) receive JSON arguments,
not uploaded files, so a local image, video, or PDF must first become a durable
media reference. Signed-in users can upload one from the **Media** page (which
posts to `POST /api/media/upload`, multipart `file` field). The endpoint
validates the type and signature, stores
the file under a per-user prefix in the private `social-media-images` Supabase
bucket, and returns:

- `storagePath` — the permanent object path. Pass this as `imageStoragePath`,
  `media[].storagePath`, or `documentStoragePath` when scheduling (or to
  `social_publish.imageStoragePath` for immediate publishing). It never
  expires and is what PostgreSQL records.
- `url` — a short-lived signed URL for an immediate publish only. Do not store
  it.

This page is also the browser fallback for Claude.ai: the MCP spec has no
client→server file-upload primitive, so when the in-chat upload tool
(`social_upload_media_intent` on the MCP server) cannot run in the model's
environment, the user uploads here and pastes the returned `storagePath` into
the Claude conversation.

At publish time the worker downloads `storagePath` with the server-side
service-role key and creates a fresh signed URL only for platforms that require
a public HTTPS URL (Instagram/Facebook). Platforms with direct upload (LinkedIn)
receive the bytes directly. Retries re-download the same original object, so a
post scheduled days ahead is unaffected by any earlier URL's expiry.

This route needs `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` on the server.
Keep the service-role key out of `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`, the browser, API responses, and
logs. The bucket stays private; the response never contains a storage
credential. `SCHEDULE_SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` (default `86400`) controls the
publish-time signed URL lifetime.

FILE: social-media-web/scripts/generate-security-guide.mjs

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generates public/Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf with zero dependencies.
//
// The PDF is hand-rolled from primitives: base-14 Helvetica fonts, uncompressed
// content streams (so the document is greppable in tests), A4 media box, a
// cover page, a table of contents, seven sections that each start on a fresh
// page, running headers/footers with "Page N of M", document metadata, and
// outline bookmarks. Every security statement in the copy is reviewed against
// the implemented application behavior; see tests/security-guide.test.ts.
//
// Layout engine rules (fixed after the v1 overlap/overflow bugs):
//   * Every text operation states its full text state explicitly (Tc is always
//     emitted, even when 0). PDF text state persists across BT/ET, so an op
//     that omits Tc would inherit letter spacing from an earlier op and render
//     wider than measured — the original right-margin overflow bug.
//   * Every block (paragraph, bullet, heading, callout) is measured before it
//     is drawn. `ensure(height)` starts a new page when the block does not fit,
//     so nothing can overlap the header, footer, or page bottom.
//   * Subheadings keep at least two lines of the following block on the same
//     page (keep-with-next); bullets are never split; paragraphs flow across
//     pages but never leave a single orphan line behind.
//   * Wrapping uses real font metrics with a small safety factor so viewers
//     that substitute Helvetica with slightly wider fonts (e.g. Arial) cannot
//     push a line past the right margin.
//
// Usage: node scripts/generate-security-guide.mjs
// Output: ../public/Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf (relative to scripts/).

import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const OUT = path.resolve(here, "../public/Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf");

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Geometry and palette
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const GEOM = {
  PAGE_W: 595.28, // A4 width in points
  PAGE_H: 841.89, // A4 height in points
  MARGIN: 64,
  TOP: 776, // first content baseline on a page
  BOTTOM: 76, // lowest allowed content baseline
  HEADER_BASELINE: 813,
  HEADER_RULE: 806,
  FOOTER_RULE: 54,
  FOOTER_BASELINE: 42,
};
const { PAGE_W, PAGE_H, MARGIN, TOP, BOTTOM } = GEOM;
const CONTENT_W = PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN;
// Extra headroom on every wrapped line: PDF viewers frequently substitute
// Helvetica with Arial, whose glyphs run slightly wider. 1.04 keeps such lines
// inside the margin; it only makes wraps marginally earlier.
const WRAP_SAFETY = 1.04;

const COLOR = {
  text: "0.067 0.094 0.153 rg", // near-black slate
  muted: "0.420 0.447 0.502 rg", // gray
  brand: "0.145 0.388 0.922 rg", // blue
  brandStroke: "0.145 0.388 0.922 RG",
  rule: "0.898 0.906 0.922 RG", // light gray line
  ruleFill: "0.898 0.906 0.922 rg",
  white: "1 1 1 rg",
  calloutEnforced: "0.937 0.965 1 rg", // light blue
  calloutAdvice: "0.965 0.973 0.980 rg", // light gray
  slate: "0.200 0.251 0.325 RG",
};

// Vertical rhythm (points). One place defines the document's spacing system.
const SPACING = {
  paragraphLeading: 15,
  paragraphGap: 9, // extra space below a paragraph
  bulletLeading: 14.5,
  bulletGap: 4, // between bullets in a list
  bulletListGap: 10, // after the last bullet of a list
  h2Above: 13,
  h2Below: 6,
  calloutLeading: 13.5,
  calloutPadTop: 9, // box top above the label baseline
  calloutLabelGap: 13, // label baseline to first body baseline
  calloutPadBottom: 9, // box bottom below the last body baseline
  calloutGap: 13, // after the box
  noteLeading: 13,
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Font metrics (AFM widths, /1000, ASCII 32..126)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const W_HELV = [
  278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278,
  278, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584,
  584, 556, 1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556,
  833, 722, 778, 667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278,
  278, 278, 469, 556, 333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222,
  500, 222, 833, 556, 556, 556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500,
  500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
];
const W_BOLD = [
  278, 333, 474, 556, 556, 889, 722, 238, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278,
  278, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 333, 333, 584, 584,
  584, 611, 975, 722, 722, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 556, 722, 611,
  833, 722, 778, 667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 333,
  278, 333, 584, 556, 333, 556, 611, 556, 611, 556, 333, 611, 611, 278, 278,
  556, 278, 889, 611, 611, 611, 611, 389, 556, 333, 611, 556, 778, 556, 556,
  500, 389, 280, 389, 584,
];
const FONT_WIDTHS = { F1: W_HELV, F2: W_BOLD, F3: W_HELV }; // Oblique == regular metrics

export function measureText(str, font, size, letterSpacing = 0) {
  const table = FONT_WIDTHS[font] ?? W_HELV;
  let total = 0;
  for (const ch of str) {
    const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
    total += code >= 32 && code <= 126 ? table[code - 32] : 500;
  }
  return (total / 1000) * size + Math.max(0, str.length - 1) * letterSpacing;
}

/** Greedy word wrap with real metrics. Never splits words; never exceeds maxWidth. */
export function wrapText(text, font, size, maxWidth, letterSpacing = 0) {
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const lines = [];
  let line = "";
  for (const word of words) {
    const candidate = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;
    const measured = measureText(candidate, font, size, letterSpacing) * WRAP_SAFETY;
    if (measured <= maxWidth || !line) {
      line = candidate;
    } else {
      lines.push(line);
      line = word;
    }
  }
  if (line) lines.push(line);
  return lines;
}

function esc(str) {
  return str.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/\(/g, "\\(").replace(/\)/g, "\\)");
}

export function unescapePdfString(str) {
  return str.replace(/\\([()\\])/g, "$1");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content-stream op builders. Tc is ALWAYS emitted: text state persists across
// BT/ET, and an omitted Tc would inherit letter spacing from an earlier op.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function txt(x, y, str, font, size, fill, letterSpacing = 0) {
  return `BT /${font} ${size} Tf ${fill} ${letterSpacing} Tc ${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)} Td (${esc(str)}) Tj ET\n`;
}

function rect(x, y, w, h, fill) {
  return `${fill} ${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)} ${w.toFixed(2)} ${h.toFixed(2)} re f\n`;
}

function hline(x1, x2, y, widthPt) {
  return `${COLOR.rule} ${widthPt} w ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)} m ${x2.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)} l S\n`;
}

function rightX(str, font, size, right, letterSpacing = 0) {
  return right - measureText(str, font, size, letterSpacing);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Page flow: block-based placement with pre-computed heights
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const pages = []; // { ops, header } — header text shown top-right
let ops = "";
let y = TOP;
let header = "";
const sectionStartPage = [];

function beginPage() {
  pages.push({ ops, header });
  ops = "";
  y = TOP;
}

/** Starts a new page unless the block (plus its trailing space) fits. */
function ensure(height) {
  if (y - height < BOTTOM) beginPage();
}

/**
 * Places wrapped lines top-down, flowing across pages. Orphan control: a
 * paragraph never starts with a single line at the bottom of a page.
 */
function placeLines(lines, x, font, size, fill, leading) {
  let i = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const remaining = lines.length - i;
    const available = Math.max(0, Math.floor((y - BOTTOM + 0.01) / leading));
    if (available === 0) {
      beginPage();
      continue;
    }
    const take = Math.min(remaining, available);
    if (take === 1 && remaining >= 2 && i === 0) {
      beginPage(); // orphan line: move the whole start to the next page
      continue;
    }
    let baseline = y;
    for (let k = 0; k < take; k++) {
      ops += txt(x, baseline, lines[i + k], font, size, fill);
      baseline -= leading;
    }
    y = baseline;
    i += take;
    if (i < lines.length) {
      beginPage();
      continue;
    }
    return;
  }
}

function paragraph(text, opts = {}) {
  const {
    font = "F1",
    size = 10,
    leading = SPACING.paragraphLeading,
    fill = COLOR.text,
    indent = 0,
    gapAfter = SPACING.paragraphGap,
    maxWidth = CONTENT_W - indent,
  } = opts;
  const lines = wrapText(text, font, size, maxWidth);
  placeLines(lines, MARGIN + indent, font, size, fill, leading);
  y -= gapAfter;
}

/** Subheading: keep-with-next — needs room for itself plus 2 lines below. */
function heading(text, followMinHeight) {
  const selfHeight = SPACING.h2Above + SPACING.paragraphLeading + SPACING.h2Below;
  ensure(selfHeight + (followMinHeight ?? 0));
  y -= SPACING.h2Above;
  ops += txt(MARGIN, y, text, "F2", 13, COLOR.text);
  y -= SPACING.paragraphLeading + SPACING.h2Below;
}

function bullet(item, isLast) {
  const lines = wrapText(item, "F1", 10, CONTENT_W - 16);
  const leading = SPACING.bulletLeading;
  const gap = isLast ? SPACING.bulletListGap : SPACING.bulletGap;
  ensure(lines.length * leading + gap); // a bullet is never split across pages
  const markerY = y + 2.2;
  ops += rect(MARGIN + 1.5, markerY, 3, 3, COLOR.brand);
  let baseline = y;
  for (const line of lines) {
    ops += txt(MARGIN + 16, baseline, line, "F1", 10, COLOR.text);
    baseline -= leading;
  }
  y = baseline - gap;
}

function bullets(items) {
  items.forEach((item, index) => bullet(item, index === items.length - 1));
}

/** Callout box with a height computed from its wrapped content. */
function callout(label, text, tone) {
  const size = 9.5;
  const leading = SPACING.calloutLeading;
  const lines = wrapText(text, "F1", size, CONTENT_W - 30);
  const boxHeight =
    SPACING.calloutPadTop +
    SPACING.calloutLabelGap +
    (lines.length - 1) * leading +
    SPACING.calloutPadBottom;
  ensure(boxHeight + SPACING.calloutGap);
  const boxBottom = y - SPACING.calloutLabelGap - (lines.length - 1) * leading - SPACING.calloutPadBottom;
  const bg = tone === "enforced" ? COLOR.calloutEnforced : COLOR.calloutAdvice;
  const barFill = tone === "enforced" ? COLOR.brand : COLOR.slate.replace(" RG", " rg");
  ops += rect(MARGIN, boxBottom, CONTENT_W, boxHeight, bg);
  ops += rect(MARGIN, boxBottom, 3, boxHeight, barFill);
  ops += txt(MARGIN + 14, y, label, "F2", 9, COLOR.text);
  let baseline = y - SPACING.calloutLabelGap;
  for (const line of lines) {
    ops += txt(MARGIN + 14, baseline, line, "F1", size, COLOR.text);
    baseline -= leading;
  }
  y = boxBottom - SPACING.calloutGap;
}

function note(text) {
  paragraph(text, {
    font: "F3",
    size: 9,
    leading: SPACING.noteLeading,
    fill: COLOR.muted,
    gapAfter: SPACING.paragraphGap,
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The document copy (kept truthful to the implemented behavior)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const sections = [

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Cover page (fixed canvas, all text states explicit)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function coverOps() {
  let s = "";
  s += rect(0, PAGE_H - 7, PAGE_W, 7, COLOR.brand);
  // Brand mark
  s += rect(MARGIN, 692, 52, 52, COLOR.brand);
  const scWidth = measureText("SC", "F2", 20, 0.5);
  s += txt(MARGIN + (52 - scWidth) / 2, 711, "SC", "F2", 20, COLOR.white, 0.5);
  s += txt(MARGIN, 662, "SOCIAL CONSOLE", "F2", 10, COLOR.brand, 2.2);
  // Title
  s += txt(MARGIN, 604, "Security & Account", "F2", 34, COLOR.text);
  s += txt(MARGIN, 560, "Protection Guide", "F2", 34, COLOR.text);
  s += rect(MARGIN, 534, 40, 3, COLOR.brand);
  // Subtitle
  let sy = 506;
  for (const line of wrapText(
    "Understanding how your account, data, authentication, and publishing activities are protected.",
    "F1", 11.5, CONTENT_W - 40,
  )) {
    s += txt(MARGIN, sy, line, "F1", 11.5, COLOR.muted);
    sy -= 17;
  }
  // Scope paragraph
  sy -= 10;
  for (const line of wrapText(
    "This guide describes the protections implemented in the Social Console admin application and its publishing worker. Sections marked 'Enforced by the application' describe server-side behavior. Section 7 lists recommended administrator practices, which are marked separately.",
    "F1", 9.5, CONTENT_W - 40,
  )) {
    s += txt(MARGIN, sy, line, "F1", 9.5, COLOR.muted);
    sy -= 14;
  }
  // Bottom band
  s += hline(MARGIN, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 92, 0.8);
  s += txt(MARGIN, 78, "Document version 1.0", "F1", 8, COLOR.muted);
  s += txt(rightX("Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf", "F1", 8, PAGE_W - MARGIN), 78,
    "Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf", "F1", 8, COLOR.muted);
  return s;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents (built after the layout pass knows section pages)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function tocOps(entries) {
  let s = "";
  s += txt(MARGIN, TOP, "Contents", "F2", 20, COLOR.text);
  s += rect(MARGIN, TOP - 14, 40, 3, COLOR.brand);
  let ty = TOP - 52;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const label = `${entry.num}.  ${entry.title}`;
    const numStr = String(entry.page);
    s += txt(MARGIN, ty, label, "F1", 11, COLOR.text);
    const numX = rightX(numStr, "F1", 11, PAGE_W - MARGIN);
    s += txt(numX, ty, numStr, "F1", 11, COLOR.muted);
    // thin leader between title and page number
    const titleW = measureText(label, "F1", 11);
    const lineStart = MARGIN + titleW + 10;
    const lineEnd = numX - 10;
    if (lineEnd > lineStart + 8) {
      s += `${COLOR.rule} 0.6 w ${lineStart.toFixed(2)} ${(ty + 3.2).toFixed(2)} m ${lineEnd.toFixed(2)} ${(ty + 3.2).toFixed(2)} l S\n`;
    }
    ty -= 27;
  }
  s += txt(MARGIN, ty - 20, "About this guide", "F2", 12, COLOR.text);
  ty -= 20 + 16 + 8;
  for (const line of wrapText(
    "This document is generated from the Social Console project and describes behavior that is implemented and enforced in the admin web application and its publishing worker. It contains no credentials, tokens, or private account data.",
    "F1", 9.5, CONTENT_W,
  )) {
    s += txt(MARGIN, ty, line, "F1", 9.5, COLOR.muted);
    ty -= 14;
  }
  return s;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Layout pass — sections each start on a fresh page
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function layout() {
  beginPage(); // page 1: cover placeholder
  beginPage(); // page 2: TOC placeholder

  sections.forEach((section, index) => {
    if (ops !== "" || y !== TOP) beginPage();
    header = section.title;
    sectionStartPage[index] = pages.length; // page index where this section starts

    // Section heading block (always at the top of a fresh page)
    ops += txt(MARGIN, y, `SECTION ${index + 1}`, "F2", 8, COLOR.brand, 1.8);
    y -= 30;
    ops += txt(MARGIN, y, section.title, "F2", 21, COLOR.text);
    y -= 16;
    ops += rect(MARGIN, y, 34, 2.5, COLOR.brand);
    y -= 24;

    section.blocks.forEach((block, blockIndex) => {
      const next = section.blocks[blockIndex + 1];
      if (block.t === "p") paragraph(block.x);
      else if (block.t === "h2") heading(block.x, next ? 2 * SPACING.paragraphLeading : 0);
      else if (block.t === "note") note(block.x);
      else if (block.t === "bullets") bullets(block.items);
      else if (block.t === "callout") callout(block.label, block.x, block.tone);
    });
  });
  if (ops !== "" || y !== TOP) beginPage();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Render headers/footers (fixed height, so layout is unaffected)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const DOC_LABEL = "Social Console - Security & Account Protection Guide";
const FILE_LABEL = "Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf";

function frameOps(page, pageNumber, total) {
  let frame = "";
  // Running header
  frame += txt(MARGIN, GEOM.HEADER_BASELINE, "SOCIAL CONSOLE", "F2", 7, COLOR.brand, 1.4);
  const rightLabel = page.header || DOC_LABEL;
  const headerTc = 0.3;
  let label = rightLabel;
  while (measureText(label, "F1", 7, headerTc) > 200 && label.length > 4) label = label.slice(0, -2);
  if (label !== rightLabel) label = `${label}...`;
  frame += txt(rightX(label, "F1", 7, PAGE_W - MARGIN, headerTc), GEOM.HEADER_BASELINE, label, "F1", 7, COLOR.muted, headerTc);
  frame += hline(MARGIN, PAGE_W - MARGIN, GEOM.HEADER_RULE, 0.6);
  // Running footer
  frame += hline(MARGIN, PAGE_W - MARGIN, GEOM.FOOTER_RULE, 0.6);
  frame += txt(MARGIN, GEOM.FOOTER_BASELINE, FILE_LABEL, "F1", 7, COLOR.muted);
  const pageLabel = `Page ${pageNumber} of ${total}`;
  frame += txt(rightX(pageLabel, "F1", 7, PAGE_W - MARGIN), GEOM.FOOTER_BASELINE, pageLabel, "F1", 7, COLOR.muted);
  return frame;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PDF serialization
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const objects = []; // { body } — index + 1 = object number
function addObject(body) {
  objects.push(body);
  return objects.length; // 1-based object number
}

function serialize(finalPages) {
  // Reserve: 1 Catalog (filled last), 2 Pages, 3-5 Fonts, 6 Info. Pages follow,
  // then outlines. Filling the reserved bodies in place keeps every reference.
  addObject("CATALOG_PLACEHOLDER"); // 1
  const pagesObjNum = addObject("PAGES_PLACEHOLDER"); // 2
  const fontDefs = [
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Oblique /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
  ];
  for (const def of fontDefs) addObject(def); // 3, 4, 5
  const infoObjNum = addObject(
    "<< /Title (Social Console - Security & Account Protection Guide) " +
    "/Author (Social Console) " +
    "/Subject (How the Social Console protects accounts, authentication, sessions, social connections, publishing, and data) " +
    "/Creator (Social Console) /Producer (Social Console security guide generator) >>",
  ); // 6

  const kids = [];
  const pageObjNums = [];
  for (const content of finalPages) {
    const stream = Buffer.from(content, "utf8");
    const contentNum = addObject(
      `<< /Length ${stream.byteLength} >>\nstream\n${content}endstream`,
    );
    const pageNum = addObject(
      `<< /Type /Page /Parent ${pagesObjNum} 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${PAGE_W} ${PAGE_H}] /Contents ${contentNum} 0 R >>`,
    );
    kids.push(`${pageNum} 0 R`);
    pageObjNums.push(pageNum);
  }

  objects[pagesObjNum - 1] =
    `<< /Type /Pages /Kids [${kids.join(" ")}] /Count ${kids.length} ` +
    `/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R /F3 5 0 R >> >> >>`;

  // Outline bookmarks (one per section, linking to the section's first page).
  const outlineItems = sections.map((section, i) => ({
    title: `${i + 1}. ${section.title}`,
    pageObj: pageObjNums[sectionStartPage[i]],
  }));
  const itemNums = outlineItems.map(() => addObject("OUTLINE_PLACEHOLDER"));
  const outlineRootNum = addObject(
    `<< /Type /Outlines /First ${itemNums[0]} 0 R /Last ${itemNums[itemNums.length - 1]} 0 R /Count ${itemNums.length} >>`,
  );
  outlineItems.forEach((item, i) => {
    const parts = [
      `<< /Title (${esc(item.title)}) /Parent ${outlineRootNum} 0 R`,
      `/Dest [${item.pageObj} 0 R /XYZ null ${PAGE_H - 24} null]`,
    ];
    if (i > 0) parts.push(`/Prev ${itemNums[i - 1]} 0 R`);
    if (i < itemNums.length - 1) parts.push(`/Next ${itemNums[i + 1]} 0 R`);
    parts.push(">>");
    objects[itemNums[i] - 1] = parts.join(" ");
  });

  objects[0] =
    `<< /Type /Catalog /Pages ${pagesObjNum} 0 R /Outlines ${outlineRootNum} 0 R /PageMode /UseOutlines >>`;

  // Write the file with a correct xref table.
  const chunks = [];
  let offset = 0;
  const offsets = [0]; // object 0 is free
  function write(str) {
    const buf = Buffer.from(str, "utf8");
    chunks.push(buf);
    offset += buf.byteLength;
  }

  write("%PDF-1.7\n%\xE2\xE3\xCF\xD3\n");
  objects.forEach((body, i) => {
    offsets.push(offset);
    write(`${i + 1} 0 obj\n${body}\nendobj\n`);
  });
  const xrefPos = offset;
  let xref = `xref\n0 ${objects.length + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= objects.length; i++) {
    xref += `${String(offsets[i]).padStart(10, "0")} 00000 n \n`;
  }
  write(xref);
  write(`trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length + 1} /Root 1 0 R /Info ${infoObjNum} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xrefPos}\n%%EOF\n`);

  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Structured parsing of the generated PDF (shared with tests and the preview
// renderer so validation always matches the generator's op formats).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const TEXT_OP = /BT \/(F\d) ([\d.]+) Tf ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) rg (-?[\d.]+) Tc (-?[\d.-]+) (-?[\d.-]+) Td \(((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*)\) Tj ET/g;
const RECT_OP = /([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) rg ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) re f/g;
const LINE_OP = /([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) ([\d.]+) RG ([\d.]+) w (-?[\d.-]+) (-?[\d.-]+) m (-?[\d.-]+) (-?[\d.-]+) l S/g;

export function parseGuidePdf(pdfLatin1) {
  const streams = [...pdfLatin1.matchAll(/stream\n([\s\S]*?)endstream/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  const pdfPages = streams.map((stream) => {
    const runs = [];
    for (const m of stream.matchAll(TEXT_OP)) {
      runs.push({
        x: Number(m[7]),
        y: Number(m[8]),
        size: Number(m[2]),
        font: m[1],
        tc: Number(m[6]),
        fill: [Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5])],
        text: unescapePdfString(m[9]),
      });
    }
    const rects = [];
    for (const m of stream.matchAll(RECT_OP)) {
      rects.push({
        x: Number(m[4]),
        y: Number(m[5]),
        w: Number(m[6]),
        h: Number(m[7]),
        fill: [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3])],
      });
    }
    const lines = [];
    for (const m of stream.matchAll(LINE_OP)) {
      lines.push({
        x1: Number(m[5]),
        y1: Number(m[6]),
        x2: Number(m[7]),
        y2: Number(m[8]),
        widthPt: Number(m[4]),
        stroke: [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3])],
      });
    }
    return { runs, rects, lines, raw: stream };
  });
  return { pages: pdfPages, streams };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function main() {
  layout();

  const total = pages.length;
  const finalPages = pages.map((page, index) => {
    const pageNumber = index + 1;
    if (index === 0) return coverOps(); // the cover carries no header/footer
    return page.ops + frameOps(page, pageNumber, total);
  });

  // Insert the TOC content now that section start pages are known. The frame
  // ops of the placeholder page are kept so the TOC carries the running
  // header and footer like every other content page.
  finalPages[1] = tocOps(
    sections.map((section, i) => ({
      num: i + 1,
      title: section.title,
      // Displayed page numbers count from 1 including the cover.
      page: sectionStartPage[i] + 1,
    })),
  ) + finalPages[1];

  const pdf = serialize(finalPages);
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(OUT), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(OUT, pdf);
  console.log(`Wrote ${OUT}`);
  console.log(`Pages: ${total} (${sections.length} sections, cover + contents)`);
  console.log(`Size: ${pdf.byteLength} bytes`);
}

// Only run when invoked directly (tests import this module for its helpers).
const invokedDirectly = process.argv[1]
  && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href;
if (invokedDirectly) {
  main();
}

FILE: social-media-web/scripts/migrate.mjs

import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { readdir, readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import { Client } from "pg";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");

async function loadEnv() {
  const candidates = [
    path.join(root, ".env.local"),
    path.join(root, ".env"),
    path.join(root, "..", "social-media-mcp", ".env"),
  ];
  for (const file of candidates) {
    if (!existsSync(file)) continue;
    const text = await readFile(file, "utf8");
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const match = /^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/.exec(line);
      if (!match || process.env[match[1]] !== undefined) continue;
      process.env[match[1]] = match[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    }
  }
}

await loadEnv();

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL?.trim();
if (!connectionString) {
  console.error("Set DATABASE_URL (web .env.local or social-media-mcp/.env) before running migrations.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const directory = path.join(root, "migrations");
const files = (await readdir(directory)).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".sql")).sort();

const client = new Client({ connectionString });
await client.connect();
try {
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = await readFile(path.join(directory, file), "utf8");
    await client.query("begin");
    try {
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query("commit");
      console.log(`Applied ${file}`);
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query("rollback");
      throw error;
    }
  }
} finally {
  await client.end();
}

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

// Emergency, offline recovery for the single Super Admin. This is deliberately
// a CLI script rather than an HTTP endpoint: it needs direct database access,
// an explicit operator acknowledgement, and a password supplied out of band.
// There is no unauthenticated path to change an administrator password.

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");

for (const file of [
  path.join(root, ".env.local"),
  path.join(root, ".env"),
  path.join(root, "..", "social-media-mcp", ".env"),
]) {
  if (!existsSync(file)) continue;
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8");
  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const match = /^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/.exec(line);
    if (!match || process.env[match[1]] !== undefined) continue;
    process.env[match[1]] = match[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
  }
}

const ACK_PHRASE = "recover-super-admin";
const acknowledgement = process.env.RECOVER_ADMIN_ACKNOWLEDGE?.trim();
if (acknowledgement !== ACK_PHRASE) {
  console.error(
    `Refusing to run. Set RECOVER_ADMIN_ACKNOWLEDGE=${ACK_PHRASE} to confirm this is an intentional emergency recovery.`,
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

const newPassword = process.env.ADMIN_NEW_PASSWORD ?? process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
if (!newPassword) {
  console.error("Set ADMIN_NEW_PASSWORD (or ADMIN_PASSWORD) to the new administrator password.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const { validatePasswordStrength } = await import("../src/lib/security-policy");
const strength = validatePasswordStrength(newPassword);
if (!strength.ok) {
  console.error(strength.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

const { hashPassword } = await import("better-auth/crypto");
const { ADMIN_ROLE } = await import("../src/lib/auth");
const { db } = await import("../src/lib/db");
const { account, session, user } = await import("../src/lib/db/schema");
const { logActivity } = await import("../src/lib/activity");

const admins = await db
  .select({ id: user.id, email: user.email })
  .from(user)
  .where(eq(user.role, ADMIN_ROLE));

if (admins.length === 0) {
  console.error("No active Super Admin found. Use db:seed-admin to provision one.");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (admins.length > 1) {
  console.error("Multiple Super Admin rows found; refusing to guess. Resolve this manually first.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const admin = admins[0]!;
const passwordHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);

try {
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [existing] = await tx
      .select({ id: account.id })
      .from(account)
      .where(and(eq(account.userId, admin.id), eq(account.providerId, "credential")))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing) {
      await tx
        .update(account)
        .set({ password: passwordHash, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(account.id, existing.id));
    } else {
      await tx.insert(account).values({
        id: randomUUID(),
        accountId: admin.id,
        providerId: "credential",
        userId: admin.id,
        password: passwordHash,
      });
    }

    // Any session issued before this recovery is untrusted.
    await tx.delete(session).where(eq(session.userId, admin.id));

    // A recovered admin must be able to sign in; clear a stale lockout state
    // without changing the role or ownership of any other data.
    await tx
      .update(user)
      .set({
        approvalStatus: "approved",
        banned: false,
        banReason: null,
        banExpires: null,
        deletedAt: null,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(user.id, admin.id));

    await logActivity(
      {
        actorUserId: admin.id,
        targetUserId: admin.id,
        action: "admin_emergency_password_recovery",
        resourceType: "user",
        resourceId: admin.id,
        metadata: { method: "offline-script", sessionsRevoked: true },
      },
      tx,
    );
  });
} catch (error) {
  console.error("Emergency recovery failed:");
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`Super Admin ${admin.email} password recovered. All sessions were revoked.`);

FILE: social-media-web/scripts/render-guide-preview.mjs

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Renders the generated security guide PDF to HTML canvases for visual
// inspection. Parses the actual content streams (uncompressed) and draws every
// rect, line, and text run at its true coordinates — a faithful rendering that
// reflects what a PDF viewer shows (including Arial substitution for
// Helvetica, which browsers apply).
//
// Usage: node scripts/render-guide-preview.mjs [outDir]
// Writes outDir/guide-preview.html with one canvas per page.

import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import { GEOM, parseGuidePdf } from "./generate-security-guide.mjs";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const outDir = path.resolve(here, "..", process.argv[2] ?? ".tmp-guide-preview");

const pdfPath = path.resolve(here, "../public/Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf");
const pdf = readFileSync(pdfPath).toString("latin1");
const { pages } = parseGuidePdf(pdf);

const SCALE = 1.25;
const canvasW = Math.round(GEOM.PAGE_W * SCALE);
const canvasH = Math.round(GEOM.PAGE_H * SCALE);

const rgb = ([r, g, b]) => `rgb(${Math.round(r * 255)},${Math.round(g * 255)},${Math.round(b * 255)})`;

function pageScript(pageIndex) {
  const page = pages[pageIndex];
  const rects = page.rects.map((r) => ({ ...r, css: rgb(r.fill) }));
  const lines = page.lines.map((l) => ({ ...l, css: rgb(l.stroke) }));
  const runs = page.runs.map((t) => ({ ...t, css: rgb(t.fill) }));
  return `
(function () {
  const c = document.getElementById("page-${pageIndex}");
  const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
  const S = ${SCALE}, H = ${GEOM.PAGE_H};
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  for (const r of ${JSON.stringify(rects)}) {
    ctx.fillStyle = r.css;
    ctx.fillRect(r.x * S, (H - r.y - r.h) * S, r.w * S, r.h * S);
  }
  ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  for (const l of ${JSON.stringify(lines)}) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = l.css;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, l.widthPt * S);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(l.x1 * S, (H - l.y1) * S);
    ctx.lineTo(l.x2 * S, (H - l.y2) * S);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  for (const t of ${JSON.stringify(runs)}) {
    ctx.fillStyle = t.css;
    const weight = t.font === "F2" ? "bold " : "";
    ctx.font = weight + (t.size * S).toFixed(2) + "px Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif";
    try { ctx.letterSpacing = (t.tc * S).toFixed(2) + "px"; } catch {}
    ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x * S, (H - t.y) * S);
    try { ctx.letterSpacing = "0px"; } catch {}
  }
})();
`;
}

const html = `<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin: 16px; background: #555; font-family: sans-serif; }
  canvas { display: block; margin: 12px auto; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
  p { color: #fff; text-align: center; margin: 6px; }
</style></head><body>
${pages
    .map(
      (_p, i) =>
        `<p>Page ${i + 1} of ${pages.length}</p><canvas id="page-${i}" width="${canvasW}" height="${canvasH}"></canvas>`,
    )
    .join("\n")}
<script>
${pages.map((_, i) => pageScript(i)).join("\n")}
</script>
</body></html>`;

// Also emit each page as its own single-page HTML for close-up screenshots.
pages.forEach((_, i) => {
  const single = `<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin: 16px; background: #555; font-family: sans-serif; }
  canvas { display: block; margin: 12px auto; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
  p { color: #fff; text-align: center; margin: 6px; }
</style></head><body>
<p>Page ${i + 1} of ${pages.length}</p>
<canvas id="page-${i}" width="${canvasW}" height="${canvasH}"></canvas>
<script>${pageScript(i)}</script>
</body></html>`;
  writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `page-${i + 1}.html`), single);
});

mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
const out = path.join(outDir, "guide-preview.html");
writeFileSync(out, html);
console.log(`Wrote ${out} (${pages.length} pages, ${canvasW}x${canvasH} each)`);
console.log(`Total height at 1x: ${pages.length * (canvasH + 30) + 40}px`);

FILE: social-media-web/scripts/seed-admin.mts

import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import { and, eq, ne } from "drizzle-orm";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");

for (const file of [
  path.join(root, ".env.local"),
  path.join(root, ".env"),
  path.join(root, "..", "social-media-mcp", ".env"),
]) {
  if (!existsSync(file)) continue;
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8");
  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const match = /^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/.exec(line);
    if (!match || process.env[match[1]] !== undefined) continue;
    process.env[match[1]] = match[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
  }
}

process.env.ALLOW_ADMIN_SIGNUP = "true";

const email = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL?.trim();
const password = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
const adminName = process.env.ADMIN_NAME?.trim() || "Administrator";

if (!email || !password) {
  console.error("Set ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD before seeding the admin account.");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (password.length < 8) {
  console.error("ADMIN_PASSWORD must be at least 8 characters.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const { auth, ADMIN_ROLE } = await import("../src/lib/auth");
const { db } = await import("../src/lib/db");
const { user } = await import("../src/lib/db/schema");
const { logActivity } = await import("../src/lib/activity");

// Single-Super-Admin invariant: refuse when any admin already exists. The
// database makes this bulletproof via the partial unique `role` index
// (migration 0002); this early check gives a clear refusal message, and the
// promote step below re-verifies inside a transaction so concurrent
// invocations can never create two admins.
const existingAdmins = await db
  .select({ id: user.id, email: user.email })
  .from(user)
  .where(eq(user.role, ADMIN_ROLE));

if (existingAdmins.length > 0) {
  console.error(
    `A Super Admin already exists (${existingAdmins[0]!.email}). Refusing to create another one.`,
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

const alreadyValid = await auth.api
  .signInEmail({ body: { email, password } })
  .then(() => true)
  .catch(() => false);

// If the configured credentials already sign in, only accept that as "done"
// when the matched account actually IS the Super Admin. A previous failed
// seeding attempt (e.g. an aborted run between signup and promotion) can
// leave a role=user row behind; in that case fall through to the promotion
// step below, which re-verifies the single-admin invariant transactionally.
let promoteUserId: string | undefined;
if (alreadyValid) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: user.id, role: user.role })
    .from(user)
    .where(eq(user.email, email))
    .limit(1);
  if (row && row.role === ADMIN_ROLE) {
    console.log(`Admin ${email} already exists and is already the Super Admin.`);
    process.exit(0);
  }
  if (!row) {
    console.error(
      "The credentials matched no user row. Refusing to continue without signup.",
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }
  promoteUserId = row.id;
  console.log(`Credentials match ${email} (role=${row.role}); completing promotion to Super Admin.`);
} else {
  try {
    const created = await auth.api.signUpEmail({ body: { email, password, name: adminName } });
    promoteUserId = (created?.user as { id?: string } | undefined)?.id;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not create the admin account:");
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Promote the account (freshly created as pending/role=user, or recovered
// from an earlier aborted seeding attempt) to the Super Admin inside one
// transaction. The partial unique index aborts this transaction if a
// concurrent run promoted a different account first.
try {
  promoteUserId = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx
      .select({ id: user.id })
      .from(user)
      .where(eq(user.email, email))
      .limit(1);
    if (!row) throw new Error(`User ${email} was not found after signup.`);
    if (promoteUserId && row.id !== promoteUserId) {
      throw new Error(`The promoted row is not the account the credentials belong to.`);
    }
    const blockers = await tx
      .select({ id: user.id, email: user.email })
      .from(user)
      .where(and(eq(user.role, ADMIN_ROLE), ne(user.id, row.id)));
    if (blockers.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `A Super Admin already exists (${blockers[0]!.email}). Refusing to create another one.`,
      );
    }
    await tx
      .update(user)
      .set({
        role: ADMIN_ROLE,
        approvalStatus: "approved",
        banned: false,
        banReason: null,
        banExpires: null,
        deletedAt: null,
      })
      .where(eq(user.id, row.id));
    return row.id;
  });
} catch (error) {
  const code = error instanceof Error && "code" in error ? String((error as { code?: unknown }).code) : "";
  if (code === "23505") {
    console.error("A Super Admin already exists (database single-admin invariant enforced). Refusing.");
  } else {
    console.error("Could not promote the admin account:");
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }
  process.exit(1);
}

// Audit: admin initialization. Non-sensitive metadata only.
await logActivity({
  actorUserId: promoteUserId,
  targetUserId: promoteUserId,
  action: "admin_initialized",
  resourceType: "user",
  resourceId: promoteUserId,
  metadata: { seededBy: "seed-admin" },
});

console.log(`Super Admin ${email} initialized (role=admin, approved).`);

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(auth)/forgot-password/forgot-password-form.tsx

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import {
  OTP_LENGTH,
  OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
  PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
  passwordRequirements,
  validateOtp,
  validatePasswordStrength,
} from "@/lib/security-policy";

type Step = "request" | "verify" | "done";

interface AuthErrorShape {
  code?: string;
  message?: string;
}

function messageFor(error: AuthErrorShape | null, fallback: string): string {
  if (!error) return fallback;
  switch (error.code) {
    case "OTP_EXPIRED":
      return "That code has expired. Request a new one.";
    case "INVALID_OTP":
      return "That code is not valid. Check the email and try again.";
    case "TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS":
      return "Too many attempts. Request a new code.";
    case "TOO_MANY_REQUESTS":
      return "Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.";
    default:
      return error.message || fallback;
  }
}

function Requirement({ met, children }: { met: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <li className={`text-xs ${met ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}>
      {met ? "✓" : "•"} {children}
    </li>
  );
}

export function ForgotPasswordForm() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("request");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [resendAt, setResendAt] = useState(0);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());

  const requirements = passwordRequirements(newPassword);
  const secondsUntilResend = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((resendAt - now) / 1000));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resendAt <= Date.now()) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      const current = Date.now();
      setNow(current);
      if (current >= resendAt) window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [resendAt]);

  async function requestCode(event?: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event?.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const normalized = normalizeEmail(email);
    if (!normalized) {
      setError("Enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);
    try {
      // Better Auth answers with the same success response whether or not the
      // address exists, so this screen never reveals which emails are known.
      const { error: requestError } = await authClient.emailOtp.requestPasswordReset({
        email: normalized,
      });
      if (requestError) {
        setError(messageFor(requestError, "Could not send a reset code. Try again."));
        return;
      }
      setEmail(normalized);
      setOtp("");
      setStep("verify");
      setResendAt(Date.now() + OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS * 1000);
      setNow(Date.now());
    } catch {
      setError("Could not send a reset code. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  async function resetPassword(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const parsedOtp = validateOtp(otp);
    if (!parsedOtp.ok) {
      setError(parsedOtp.message);
      return;
    }
    const strength = validatePasswordStrength(newPassword);
    if (!strength.ok) {
      setError(strength.message);
      return;
    }
    if (strength.value !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("The new passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);
    try {
      const { error: resetError } = await authClient.emailOtp.resetPassword({
        email,
        otp: parsedOtp.value,
        password: strength.value,
      });
      if (resetError) {
        setError(messageFor(resetError, "Could not reset your password. Try again."));
        return;
      }
      setNewPassword("");
      setConfirmPassword("");
      setOtp("");
      setStep("done");
    } catch {
      setError("Could not reset your password. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Reset your password</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {step === "done"
            ? "Your password has been changed."
            : "We will email a one-time 6-digit code to your account address."}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {step === "request" ? (
          <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={requestCode}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="reset-email">Email</Label>
              <Input
                id="reset-email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="username"
                required
                value={email}
                onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            {error ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
              {pending ? "Sending..." : "Send reset code"}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : null}

        {step === "verify" ? (
          <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={resetPassword}>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If an account exists for <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{email}</span>,
              a {OTP_LENGTH}-digit code is on its way. It expires in 5 minutes.
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="reset-otp">Verification code</Label>
              <Input
                id="reset-otp"
                inputMode="numeric"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                maxLength={OTP_LENGTH}
                required
                value={otp}
                onChange={(event) => setOtp(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="reset-password">New password</Label>
              <Input
                id="reset-password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                required
                value={newPassword}
                onChange={(event) => setNewPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="reset-confirm">Confirm new password</Label>
              <Input
                id="reset-confirm"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                required
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(event) => setConfirmPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <ul className="grid gap-1" aria-label="Password requirements">
              <Requirement met={requirements.length}>
                At least {PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} characters
              </Requirement>
              <Requirement met={requirements.lowercase}>Lowercase letter</Requirement>
              <Requirement met={requirements.uppercase}>Uppercase letter</Requirement>
              <Requirement met={requirements.digit}>Number</Requirement>
              <Requirement met={requirements.symbol}>Symbol</Requirement>
            </ul>
            {error ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
              {pending ? "Resetting..." : "Reset password"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={pending || secondsUntilResend > 0}
              onClick={() => void requestCode()}
            >
              {secondsUntilResend > 0
                ? `Resend code in ${secondsUntilResend}s`
                : "Resend code"}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : null}

        {step === "done" ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Every signed-in session was signed out. Use your new password to
              sign in again.
            </p>
            <Link href="/login">
              <Button className="w-full">Back to sign in</Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {step !== "done" ? (
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Remembered it?{" "}
            <Link className="underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground" href="/login">
              Sign in
            </Link>
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

export function LoginForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  // Password starts hidden; the eye toggle only changes the input type, never
  // the value, focus, or validation state.
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);

    const { error: signInError } = await authClient.signIn.email({ email, password });
    if (signInError) {
      // Includes Better Auth's native BANNED_USER message for suspended
      // accounts and a generic failure otherwise, so unknown emails never
      // reveal whether an account exists.
      setError(signInError.message ?? "Sign in failed. Check your credentials.");
      setPending(false);
      return;
    }

    // Pending/rejected users hold a limited session that grants no access;
    // the dashboard layout sends them to the status page (no enumeration).
    router.replace(next);
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Sign in</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Administrator access to the social media console.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="username"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                className="pr-9"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((visible) => !visible)}
                aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                aria-pressed={showPassword}
                className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          {error ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p> : null}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending ? "Signing in..." : "Sign in"}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Don&apos;t have an account?{" "}
            <Link
              className="underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground"
              href={next === "/" ? "/signup" : `/signup?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`}
            >
              Sign up
            </Link>
          </p>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { SignOutButton } from "@/components/sign-out-button";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { getSession, readAccountState } from "@/lib/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function PendingApprovalPage() {
  const session = await getSession();
  const state = readAccountState(session);
  // Signed-in approved users have no business on the status page.
  if (state && !state.deleted && !state.banActive && state.approvalStatus === "approved") {
    redirect("/");
  }

  // With a session the page reflects that account's real status (pending or
  // rejected). Without one - e.g. right after signup, where the freshly
  // created session was discarded - the generic pending message is shown and
  // reveals nothing about any particular account.
  const rejected = state?.approvalStatus === "rejected";
  const heading = rejected ? "Registration not approved" : "Awaiting administrator approval";
  const description = rejected
    ? "This account was not approved. Contact the administrator if you believe this is a mistake."
    : "Your registration was received and is waiting for an administrator to approve it. You will be able to sign in once the account is approved.";

  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{heading}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {description}
          {rejected || state?.deleted ? null : (
            <span className="mt-2 block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              This page appears until approval. All console features stay locked meanwhile.
            </span>
          )}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "w-full" })}
        >
          Return to sign in
        </Link>
        {session ? <SignOutButton /> : null}
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

export function SignupForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);

    const { error: signUpError } = await authClient.signUp.email({ name, email, password });
    if (signUpError) {
      setError(signUpError.message ?? "Sign up failed. Try a different email.");
      setPending(false);
      return;
    }

    // Registration is approval-based: the freshly created account starts
    // pending, so its auto-created session is discarded immediately. The user
    // sees the approval notice instead of the dashboard.
    await authClient.signOut();
    router.replace("/pending");
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Create account</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Set up access to the social media console.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>
            <Input
              id="name"
              type="text"
              autoComplete="name"
              required
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="username"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              required
              value={password}
              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          {error ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p> : null}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending ? "Creating account..." : "Sign up"}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Already have an account?{" "}
            <Link
              className="underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground"
              href={next === "/" ? "/login" : `/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`}
            >
              Sign in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {

  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

import {
  accountConnectionState,
  connectionAction,
  type AccountConnectionState,
} from "@/lib/account-connection-state";

type PlatformId = "facebook" | "instagram" | "linkedin";

type AuthSessionStatus = "pending" | "connected" | "cancelled" | "failed" | "expired";

interface PlatformStatus {
  platform: PlatformId;
  connected?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  error?: string;
  accountName?: string | null;
  expiresAt?: number | null;
  tokenExpired?: boolean;
  missingPermissions?: string[];
  grantedScopes?: string[];
  grantedPermissions?: string[];
  warning?: string;
  connectedAt?: string | null;
  previouslyConnected?: boolean;
}

interface CredentialStatus {
  provider: PlatformId;
  configured: boolean;
  source: "user" | "shared";
  clientId?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
}

interface ProviderMeta {
  label: string;
  idLabel: string;
  secretLabel: string;
  description: string;
  idPlaceholder: string;
  secretPlaceholder: string;
  tint: string;
}

interface FormState {
  clientId: string;
  clientSecret: string;
}

type BusyState = { platform: PlatformId; action: "save" | "connect" } | null;

// Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn each issue their own app/client id, so a user
// configures one credential record per provider.
const PROVIDERS: Record<PlatformId, ProviderMeta> = {
  facebook: {
    label: "Facebook",
    idLabel: "App ID",
    secretLabel: "App Secret",
    description: "Meta app for Facebook Pages",
    idPlaceholder: "Your Meta app ID",
    secretPlaceholder: "Your Meta app secret",
    tint: "bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
  },
  instagram: {
    label: "Instagram",
    idLabel: "App ID",
    secretLabel: "App Secret",
    description: "Instagram Login app",
    idPlaceholder: "Your Instagram app ID",
    secretPlaceholder: "Your Instagram app secret",
    tint: "bg-pink-600/10 text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400",
  },
  linkedin: {
    label: "LinkedIn",
    idLabel: "Client ID",
    secretLabel: "Client Secret",
    description: "LinkedIn developer app",
    idPlaceholder: "Your LinkedIn client ID",
    secretPlaceholder: "Your LinkedIn client secret",
    tint: "bg-sky-700/10 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400",
  },
};

const PLATFORM_ORDER: PlatformId[] = ["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"];

const MAX_WAIT_LOOPS = 18;

const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeStyle: "short",
});

function formatDateTime(value: string | number | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return null;
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
  return dateTimeFormatter.format(date);
}

function emptyForms(): Record<PlatformId, FormState> {
  return {
    facebook: { clientId: "", clientSecret: "" },
    instagram: { clientId: "", clientSecret: "" },
    linkedin: { clientId: "", clientSecret: "" },
  };
}

function emptyEditing(): Record<PlatformId, boolean> {
  return { facebook: false, instagram: false, linkedin: false };
}

function emptyStatuses(): Record<PlatformId, PlatformStatus> {
  return {
    facebook: { platform: "facebook", connected: false },
    instagram: { platform: "instagram", connected: false },
    linkedin: { platform: "linkedin", connected: false },
  };
}

function emptyCredentials(): Record<PlatformId, CredentialStatus> {
  return {
    facebook: { provider: "facebook", configured: false, source: "shared" },
    instagram: { provider: "instagram", configured: false, source: "shared" },
    linkedin: { provider: "linkedin", configured: false, source: "shared" },
  };
}

function indexStatuses(list: PlatformStatus[]): Record<PlatformId, PlatformStatus> {
  const indexed = emptyStatuses();
  for (const status of list) {
    if (status.platform in indexed) indexed[status.platform] = status;
  }
  return indexed;
}

function indexCredentials(list: CredentialStatus[]): Record<PlatformId, CredentialStatus> {
  const indexed = emptyCredentials();
  for (const credential of list) {
    if (credential.provider in indexed) indexed[credential.provider] = credential;
  }
  return indexed;
}

function connectionReason(status: PlatformStatus): string {
  if (status.error) return status.error;
  const reason = status.reason;
  if (!reason) return "Connect this platform to authorize publishing.";
  // The low-level tooling hint is not useful in this UI.
  if (/social_authorization_start/i.test(reason)) {
    return "Connect this platform to authorize publishing.";
  }
  return reason;
}

function expiryLabel(status: PlatformStatus): string {
  const formatted = formatDateTime(status.expiresAt);
  if (status.tokenExpired) {
    return formatted
      ? `Access token expired on ${formatted}.`
      : "The access token has expired.";
  }
  if (formatted) return `Access token expires ${formatted}.`;
  return "No token expiry reported.";
}

function authStatusMessage(platform: PlatformId, status: AuthSessionStatus): string {
  const label = PROVIDERS[platform].label;
  if (status === "cancelled") {
    return `${label} authorization was cancelled. You can try again.`;
  }
  if (status === "expired") {
    return `${label} authorization expired before it completed. Try again.`;
  }
  return `${label} authorization failed. Check the app ID, app secret, and callback URL, then try again.`;
}

function PlatformIcon({
  platform,

}: {

}) {
  if (platform === "facebook") {

    );

  if (platform === "instagram") {
    return (
      <svg

    </svg>
