}

function statusBadgeClass(state: AccountConnectionState): string {
  if (state === "connected") return "bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-600";
  return "";
}

function cardRingClass(state: AccountConnectionState): string {
  // Only a live connection earns a coloured outline. Expired tokens get an
  // amber warning, while never-connected / disconnected cards stay neutral so
  // the page does not read as a wall of errors.
  if (state === "connected") return "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80";
  if (state === "expired") return "ring-2 ring-amber-500/70";
  return "ring-1 ring-foreground/10";
}

export function AccountsPanel() {
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<PlatformId, PlatformStatus> | null>(null);
  const [credentials, setCredentials] =
    useState<Record<PlatformId, CredentialStatus> | null>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(true);
  const [forms, setForms] = useState<Record<PlatformId, FormState>>(emptyForms);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Record<PlatformId, boolean>>(emptyEditing);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<BusyState>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<PlatformId, string>>>({});
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Partial<Record<PlatformId, string>>>({});
  // Removing saved credentials is destructive (the OAuth app config is lost),
  // so it asks for confirmation with the app's standard dialog.
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<PlatformId | null>(null);

  const setCardError = useCallback((platform: PlatformId, message: string | null) => {
    setErrors((current) => {
      const next = { ...current };
      if (message) next[platform] = message;
      else delete next[platform];
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const setCardMessage = useCallback((platform: PlatformId, message: string | null) => {
    setMessages((current) => {
      const next = { ...current };
      if (message) next[platform] = message;
      else delete next[platform];
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    return Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/platforms", { cache: "no-store" }),
      fetch("/api/credentials", { cache: "no-store" }),
    ])
      .then(async ([platformsResponse, credentialsResponse]) => {
        const platformsBody = (await platformsResponse.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          platforms?: PlatformStatus[];
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!platformsResponse.ok) {
          toast.error(platformsBody.error ?? "Could not load connection status.");
          setStatuses((current) => current ?? emptyStatuses());
        } else {
          setStatuses(indexStatuses(platformsBody.platforms ?? []));
        }

        const credentialsBody = (await credentialsResponse.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          active?: boolean;
          credentials?: CredentialStatus[];
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!credentialsResponse.ok) {
          toast.error(
            credentialsBody.error ?? "Could not load developer app credentials.",
          );
          setCredentials((current) => current ?? emptyCredentials());
          return;
        }

        const list = credentialsBody.credentials ?? [];
        setActive(credentialsBody.active ?? true);
        setCredentials(indexCredentials(list));
        // Prefill the (public) app/client id so an update only needs a changed
        // value. Secrets are never returned, so the secret field stays blank.
        setForms((current) => {
          const next = { ...current };
          for (const entry of list) {
            next[entry.provider] = {
              clientId: entry.clientId ?? next[entry.provider].clientId,
              clientSecret: next[entry.provider].clientSecret,
            };
          }
          return next;
        });
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        toast.error(
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load account settings.",
        );
        setStatuses((current) => current ?? emptyStatuses());
        setCredentials((current) => current ?? emptyCredentials());
      });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  // The provider redirects the OAuth tab back to a fixed /accounts page. Surface
  // the coarse result on the matching card and refresh both connection and
  // credential state even if the original tab's polling already finished.
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const oauth = params.get("oauth");
    if (!oauth) return;
    const platformParam = params.get("platform");
    const platform =
      platformParam && PLATFORM_ORDER.includes(platformParam as PlatformId)
        ? (platformParam as PlatformId)
        : null;
    const label = platform ? PROVIDERS[platform].label : "Social account";

    let errorMessage: string | null = null;
    if (oauth === "connected") {
      toast.success(`${label} connected.`);
    } else {
      errorMessage =
        oauth === "cancelled"
          ? `${label} connection was cancelled. You can try again.`
          : oauth === "expired"
            ? `${label} connection request expired. Try again.`
            : `${label} connection failed. Check the saved credentials and callback URL, then try again.`;
      toast.error(errorMessage);
    }

    const clean = new URL(window.location.href);
    clean.searchParams.delete("oauth");
    clean.searchParams.delete("platform");
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", `${clean.pathname}${clean.search}${clean.hash}`);
    void load().then(() => {
      if (platform && errorMessage) setCardError(platform, errorMessage);
    });
  }, [load, setCardError]);

  const save = useCallback(
    async (platform: PlatformId, options: { silent?: boolean } = {}): Promise<boolean> => {
      const form = forms[platform];
      const clientId = form.clientId.trim();
      const clientSecret = form.clientSecret.trim();
      const configured = credentials?.[platform].configured ?? false;
      const meta = PROVIDERS[platform];

      if (!active) {
        const message =
          "Saving user-owned credentials requires the cloud backend (TOKEN_STORE_BACKEND=supabase).";
        setCardError(platform, message);
        if (!options.silent) toast.error(message);
        return false;
      }
      if (!clientId) {
        const message = `Enter the ${meta.idLabel.toLowerCase()}.`;
        setCardError(platform, message);
        if (!options.silent) toast.error(message);
        return false;
      }
      if (!configured && !clientSecret) {
        const message = `Enter the ${meta.secretLabel.toLowerCase()}.`;
        setCardError(platform, message);
        if (!options.silent) toast.error(message);
        return false;
      }

      setBusy({ platform, action: "save" });
      setCardError(platform, null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/credentials", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            provider: platform,
            clientId,
            // Omit the secret when the field is blank so the stored one is kept.
            ...(clientSecret ? { clientSecret } : {}),
          }),
        });
        const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          credentials?: CredentialStatus[];
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!response.ok) {
          const message = body.error ?? "Could not save credentials.";
          setCardError(platform, message);
          if (!options.silent) toast.error(message);
          return false;
        }

        if (body.credentials) {
          setCredentials(indexCredentials(body.credentials));
        } else {
          setCredentials((current) => ({
            ...(current ?? emptyCredentials()),
            [platform]: {
              provider: platform,
              configured: true,
              source: "user",
              clientId,
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          }));
        }
        setForms((current) => ({
          ...current,
          [platform]: {
            clientId,
            // Never keep the submitted secret in component state after saving.
            clientSecret: "",
          },
        }));
        setEditing((current) => ({ ...current, [platform]: false }));
        if (!options.silent) toast.success(`${meta.label} credentials saved.`);
        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not save credentials.";
        setCardError(platform, message);
        if (!options.silent) toast.error(message);
        return false;
      } finally {
        setBusy(null);
      }
    },
    [active, credentials, forms, setCardError],
  );

  const connect = useCallback(
    async (platform: PlatformId) => {
      setCardError(platform, null);
      setCardMessage(platform, null);

      // Open the provider tab now, while we still have the click gesture. Some
      // browsers block window.open after an awaited save/fetch, even when the
      // user initiated the action.
      const authWindow = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
      if (!authWindow) {
        const message =
          "Allow pop-ups for this site so the provider sign-in tab can open.";
        setCardError(platform, message);
        toast.error(message);
        return;
      }
      try {
        authWindow.opener = null;
      } catch {
        // Some browsers restrict this; the navigation below still replaces the
        // blank document with the provider page.
      }
      const closePendingWindow = () => {
        try {
          authWindow.close();
        } catch {
          // Ignore: the browser may already have closed the tab.
        }
      };

      // If the user typed credentials but has not saved them yet, save first so
      // the OAuth flow always runs against the values shown in the card.
      const form = forms[platform];
      const configured = credentials?.[platform].configured ?? false;
      const shouldSave =
        Boolean(form.clientId.trim()) && (!configured || editing[platform]);
      if (shouldSave) {
        const saved = await save(platform, { silent: true });
        if (!saved) {
          closePendingWindow();
          return;
        }
      }

      setBusy({ platform, action: "connect" });
      try {
        const startResponse = await fetch("/api/platforms/authorize", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ platform }),
        });
        const startBody = (await startResponse.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          authorizationUrl?: string;
          sessionId?: string;
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!startResponse.ok || !startBody.authorizationUrl || !startBody.sessionId) {
          const message = startBody.error ?? "Could not start authorization.";
          setCardError(platform, message);
          toast.error(message);
          closePendingWindow();
          return;
        }

        try {
          authWindow.location.href = startBody.authorizationUrl;
        } catch {
          const message =
            "Could not open the provider sign-in tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.";
          setCardError(platform, message);
          toast.error(message);
          closePendingWindow();
          return;
        }
        setCardMessage(
          platform,
          `Complete the ${PROVIDERS[platform].label} sign-in in the new tab. This card updates automatically.`,
        );

        let finalStatus: AuthSessionStatus | null = null;
        let finalError: string | undefined;
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_WAIT_LOOPS; attempt += 1) {
          const waitResponse = await fetch("/api/platforms/authorize/wait", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: startBody.sessionId, timeoutSeconds: 5 }),
          });
          const waitBody = (await waitResponse.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
            status?: { status?: AuthSessionStatus; error?: string };
            error?: string;
          };
          if (!waitResponse.ok) {
            const message = waitBody.error ?? "Could not confirm the authorization result.";
            setCardError(platform, message);
            toast.error(message);
            return;
          }
          const status = waitBody.status?.status;
          if (status && status !== "pending") {
            finalStatus = status;
            finalError = waitBody.status?.error;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (finalStatus === "connected") {
          toast.success(`${PROVIDERS[platform].label} connected.`);
          setCardMessage(platform, null);
        } else if (finalStatus) {
          const message = finalError ?? authStatusMessage(platform, finalStatus);
          setCardError(platform, message);
          toast.error(message);
        } else {
          setCardMessage(
            platform,
            "Authorization did not finish in time. Approve the sign-in in the opened tab, or try again.",
          );
        }
        await load();
      } catch (error) {
        const message =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not connect the platform.";
        setCardError(platform, message);
        toast.error(message);
      } finally {
        setBusy(null);
      }
    },
    [credentials, editing, forms, load, save, setCardError, setCardMessage],
  );

  const remove = useCallback(
    async (platform: PlatformId) => {
      setRemoving(null);
      const label = PROVIDERS[platform].label;
      setBusy({ platform, action: "save" });
      setCardError(platform, null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/credentials?provider=${platform}`, {
          method: "DELETE",
        });
        const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          credentials?: CredentialStatus[];
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!response.ok) {
          const message = body.error ?? "Could not remove credentials.";
          setCardError(platform, message);
          toast.error(message);
          return;
        }
        if (body.credentials) {
          setCredentials(indexCredentials(body.credentials));
        } else {
          setCredentials((current) => ({
            ...(current ?? emptyCredentials()),
            [platform]: { provider: platform, configured: false, source: "shared" },
          }));
        }
        setForms((current) => ({
          ...current,
          [platform]: { clientId: "", clientSecret: "" },
        }));
        setEditing((current) => ({ ...current, [platform]: false }));
        toast.success(
          `${label} developer credentials removed. Connected accounts were not changed.`,
        );
      } catch (error) {
        const message =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not remove credentials.";
        setCardError(platform, message);
        toast.error(message);
      } finally {
        setBusy(null);
      }
    },
    [setCardError],
  );

  const cancelEdit = useCallback(
    (platform: PlatformId) => {
      setForms((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [platform]: {
          clientId: credentials?.[platform].clientId ?? "",
          clientSecret: "",
        },
      }));
      setEditing((current) => ({ ...current, [platform]: false }));
      setCardError(platform, null);
    },
    [credentials, setCardError],
  );

  const updateForm = useCallback(
    (platform: PlatformId, field: keyof FormState, value: string) => {
      setForms((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [platform]: { ...current[platform], [field]: value },
      }));
    },
    [],
  );

  if (statuses === null || credentials === null) {
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        <Skeleton className="h-[26rem] w-full" />
        <Skeleton className="h-[26rem] w-full" />
        <Skeleton className="h-[26rem] w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Each card is one platform: save your developer app credentials, then
          connect the social account. The border turns green only after the
          provider confirms the authorization.
        </p>
        {!active ? (
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
            User-owned credentials are unavailable because this deployment is not
            using the cloud token store. Connections still use the shared app.
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        {PLATFORM_ORDER.map((platform) => {
          const meta = PROVIDERS[platform];
          const connection = statuses[platform];
          const credential = credentials[platform];
          const state = accountConnectionState(connection);
          const configured = credential.configured;
          const form = forms[platform];
          const isEditing = editing[platform] || !configured;
          const busyHere = busy?.platform === platform;
          const cardError = errors[platform];
          const cardMessage = messages[platform];
          const missingPermissions = connection.missingPermissions ?? [];
          const isSaving = busyHere && busy.action === "save";
          const isConnecting = busyHere && busy.action === "connect";
          const accountName = connection.accountName?.trim();
          // "Reconnect" is right whenever an OAuth consent completed before
          // (live connection or a stored token record); everyone else,
          // including users who only saved developer credentials, sees
          // "Connect".
          const action = connectionAction(state, connection.previouslyConnected);

          return (
            <Card
              key={platform}
              className={cn(
                "transition-colors duration-200",
                cardRingClass(state),
              )}
            >
              <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg",
                      meta.tint,
                    )}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    <PlatformIcon platform={platform} className="size-5" />
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <CardTitle className="truncate">{meta.label}</CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription className="truncate">
                      {state === "connected"
                        ? accountName ?? "Authorized account"
                        : state === "expired"
                          ? "Reconnect to renew access"
                          : "Not connected"}
                    </CardDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Badge
                  variant={state === "connected" ? "default" : "destructive"}
                  className={statusBadgeClass(state)}
                >
                  {state === "connected"
                    ? "Connected"
                    : state === "expired"
                      ? "Reconnect required"
                      : "Not connected"}
                </Badge>
              </CardHeader>

              <CardContent className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-4">
                <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                  {state === "connected" ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        <CircleCheck className="size-4" />
                        Connected
                      </div>
                      <p
                        className="truncate text-sm font-medium"
                        title={accountName ?? undefined}
                      >
                        {accountName ?? "Authorized account"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {expiryLabel(connection)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-destructive">
                        <CircleAlert className="size-4" />
                        {state === "expired" ? "Reconnect required" : "Not connected"}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {state === "expired"
                          ? expiryLabel(connection)
                          : connectionReason(connection)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {missingPermissions.length > 0 ? (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-destructive">
                      Missing permissions: {missingPermissions.join(", ")}.
                      Reconnect and grant them.
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                  {connection.warning ? (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                      {connection.warning}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </div>

                {cardError ? (
                  <div
                    role="alert"
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 p-3 text-sm text-destructive"
                  >
                    <CircleAlert className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{cardError}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {cardMessage ? (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{cardMessage}</p>
                ) : null}

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium">
                      <KeyRound className="size-4" />
                      Developer app
                    </div>
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
                      {configured ? "Credentials saved" : "Using shared app"}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>

                  {!isEditing ? (
                    <>
                      <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs">
                        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{meta.idLabel}</dt>
                        <dd
                          className="truncate font-mono"
                          title={credential.clientId}
                        >
                          {credential.clientId ?? "—"}
                        </dd>
                        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{meta.secretLabel}</dt>
                        <dd className="text-muted-foreground">
                          •••••••• (saved)
                        </dd>
                      </dl>
                      {credential.updatedAt ? (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          Updated {formatDateTime(credential.updatedAt) ?? "recently"}
                        </p>
                      ) : null}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={busy !== null}
                          onClick={() =>
                            setEditing((current) => ({ ...current, [platform]: true }))
                          }
                        >
                          Update credentials
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                          disabled={busy !== null}
                          onClick={() => setRemoving(platform)}
                        >
                          Remove
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                        <Label htmlFor={`${platform}-client-id`}>{meta.idLabel}</Label>
                        <Input
                          id={`${platform}-client-id`}
                          value={form.clientId}
                          autoComplete="off"
                          spellCheck={false}
                          placeholder={meta.idPlaceholder}
                          disabled={!active || busy !== null}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            updateForm(platform, "clientId", event.target.value)
                          }
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                        <Label htmlFor={`${platform}-client-secret`}>
                          {meta.secretLabel}
                        </Label>
                        <Input
                          id={`${platform}-client-secret`}
                          type="password"
                          value={form.clientSecret}
                          autoComplete="new-password"
                          spellCheck={false}
                          placeholder={
                            configured
                              ? "Leave blank to keep the saved secret"
                              : meta.secretPlaceholder
                          }
                          disabled={!active || busy !== null}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            updateForm(platform, "clientSecret", event.target.value)
                          }
                        />
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          Encrypted before storage and never shown again after
                          saving.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={!active || busy !== null || !form.clientId.trim()}
                          onClick={() => void save(platform)}
                        >
                          {isSaving
                            ? "Saving..."
                            : configured
                              ? "Update credentials"
                              : "Save credentials"}
                        </Button>
                        {configured ? (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            disabled={busy !== null}
                            onClick={() => cancelEdit(platform)}
                          >
                            Cancel
                          </Button>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t pt-3">
                  <Button
                    disabled={busy !== null}
                    onClick={() => void connect(platform)}
                  >
                    {isConnecting ? (
                      <>
                        <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" />
                        Waiting for sign-in...
                      </>
                    ) : action === "reconnect" ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw />
                        Reconnect
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <ExternalLink />
                        Connect
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Button>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {configured
                      ? "OAuth uses your saved developer app."
                      : "OAuth uses the shared app until you save your own."}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <AlertDialog
        open={removing !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setRemoving(null);
        }}
      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>
              {removing
                ? `Remove the saved ${PROVIDERS[removing].label} developer credentials?`
                : ""}
            </AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              The saved app ID and secret will be deleted. Connected accounts
              are not disconnected, but you will need the credentials again to
              reconnect later.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Keep credentials</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              variant="destructive"
              onClick={() => {
                if (removing) void remove(removing);
              }}
            >
              Remove credentials
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";

export default function AdminError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  // Server Component errors are intentionally masked in production (React
  // error #441): `error.message` is a generic React sentence, not the real
  // failure. Show an actionable message there, keep the real message in
  // development, and always surface the digest so server logs can be matched.
  const description =
    process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
      ? "An unexpected error occurred while loading this administration page. Try again; if it keeps happening, quote the reference below when contacting support."
      : error.message || "An unexpected error occurred while loading this page.";

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Administration data could not be loaded</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{description}</CardDescription>
        {error.digest ? (
          <CardDescription className="font-mono text-xs">
            Reference: {error.digest}
          </CardDescription>
        ) : null}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Button onClick={reset}>Try again</Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { AdminPagination } from "@/components/admin/admin-pagination";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import {

  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,

import {

import { requireAdminPage } from "@/lib/admin-page";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  timeStyle: "short",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return dateFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function formatTime(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return timeFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon: Icon,
  iconClassName,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  iconClassName: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Card size="sm" className="gap-0 py-4">
      <CardContent className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
          <span className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{value}</span>
        </div>
        <span
          className={`flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${iconClassName}`}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ExternalLinkIcon, PauseIcon, PlayIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function PostActions({
  id,
  status,
  publishedUrl,
}: {
  id: string;
  status: "scheduled" | "publishing" | "published" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "held";
  publishedUrl?: string | null;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const action = status === "scheduled" ? "hold" : status === "held" ? "resume" : null;
  // Only surface absolute HTTP(S) links from the publishing result.
  const safePublishedUrl =
    publishedUrl && /^https?:\/\//i.test(publishedUrl) ? publishedUrl : null;

  if (!action) {
    if (status === "published" && safePublishedUrl) {
      return (
        <a
          href={safePublishedUrl}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noreferrer noopener"
          title="View published post"
          className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}
        >
          <ExternalLinkIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          View
        </a>
      );
    }
    return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>;
  }

  async function submit() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/admin/scheduler/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`,
        { method: "POST" },
      );
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        error?: string;
        message?: string;
        status?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? `Could not ${action} the post.`);
        return;
      }
      toast.success(
        action === "hold"
          ? "Post held. The worker will not publish it."
          : body.message ?? "Post resumed.",
      );
      setOpen(false);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Could not ${action} the post.`,
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        size="sm"
        variant={action === "hold" ? "outline" : "default"}
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        {action === "hold" ? (
          <PauseIcon aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : (
          <PlayIcon aria-hidden="true" />
        )}
        {action === "hold" ? "Hold" : "Resume"}
      </Button>
      <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>
              {action === "hold" ? "Hold this post?" : "Resume this post?"}
            </AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              {action === "hold"
                ? "The publishing worker will skip this post until it is resumed. Already-publishing posts cannot be held."
                : "The post returns to the queue at its original scheduled time. Overdue posts stay held to prevent an immediate duplicate publish; reschedule them explicitly instead."}
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={busy}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction disabled={busy} onClick={() => void submit()}>
              {busy ? "Working…" : action === "hold" ? "Hold post" : "Resume post"}
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { EyeIcon, ImageIcon, VideoIcon } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

function mediaLabel(mediaType: string): string {
  if (mediaType === "image") return "Image";
  if (mediaType === "video") return "Video";
  return mediaType
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/^\w/, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
}

export function PostContentCell({
  text,
  textPreview,
  mediaType,
}: {
  text: string;
  textPreview: string;
  mediaType: string | null;
}) {
  // The query layer appends an ellipsis when it truncates the preview, so a
  // shorter preview means the full text is worth opening in the dialog. The
  // extra threshold covers previews that are technically complete but still
  // clamp at narrow table widths.
  const isTruncated = text.length > textPreview.length || text.length > 120;

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5">
      <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm leading-snug break-words text-foreground/90">
        {textPreview}
      </p>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {mediaType ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
            {mediaType === "video" ? (
              <VideoIcon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <ImageIcon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
            {mediaLabel(mediaType)}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {isTruncated ? (
          <Dialog>
            <DialogTrigger
              render={
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="xs"
                  className="-ml-1 px-1 text-primary hover:text-primary"
                />
              }
            >
              <EyeIcon className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
              View full post
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Post content</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  The complete text stored for this scheduled post.
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>
              <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
                  {text}
                </p>
              </div>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/admin/scheduler/scheduler-filters.tsx

"use client";

import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All statuses",
  scheduled: "Scheduled",
  publishing: "Publishing",
  published: "Published",
  failed: "Failed",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
  held: "Held",
};

const PLATFORM_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All platforms",
  facebook: "Facebook",
  instagram: "Instagram",
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
};

export function SchedulerFilters({
  initialQuery,
  initialStatus,
  initialPlatform,
}: {
  initialQuery: string;
  initialStatus: string;
  initialPlatform: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialStatus);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState(initialPlatform);

  // Preserve the date range (from/to) while changing other filters.
  function apply(nextQuery: string, nextStatus: string, nextPlatform: string) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
    params.delete("page");
    const trimmed = nextQuery.trim();
    if (trimmed) params.set("q", trimmed);
    else params.delete("q");
    if (nextStatus !== "all") params.set("status", nextStatus);
    else params.delete("status");
    if (nextPlatform !== "all") params.set("platform", nextPlatform);
    else params.delete("platform");
    const search = params.toString();
    startTransition(() =>
      router.replace(search ? `${pathname}?${search}` : pathname),
    );
  }

  const active = Boolean(query.trim()) || status !== "all" || platform !== "all";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
        <Label
          htmlFor="scheduler-search"
          className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
        >
          Search
        </Label>
        <form
          className="flex gap-2"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            apply(query, status, platform);
          }}
        >
          <Input
            id="scheduler-search"
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search owner or post text"
            aria-label="Search scheduled posts by owner or text"
            maxLength={100}
            className="min-w-0"
          />
          <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={pending}>
            Search
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:w-[380px] lg:shrink-0">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <Label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            Status
          </Label>
          <Select
            value={status}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const next = value ?? "all";
              setStatus(next);
              apply(query, next, platform);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger
              className="w-full"
              aria-label="Filter by post status"
            >
              <SelectValue>
                {(value) => STATUS_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All statuses"}
              </SelectValue>
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {Object.entries(STATUS_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
                <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                  {label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <Label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            Platform
          </Label>
          <Select
            value={platform}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const next = value ?? "all";
              setPlatform(next);
              apply(query, status, next);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full" aria-label="Filter by platform">
              <SelectValue>
                {(value) => PLATFORM_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All platforms"}
              </SelectValue>
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {Object.entries(PLATFORM_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
                <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                  {label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {active ? (
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"
          disabled={pending}
          className="self-start lg:self-end"
          onClick={() => {
            setQuery("");
            setStatus("all");
            setPlatform("all");
            apply("", "all", "all");
          }}
        >
          Reset
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import type { AdminProfile } from "@/lib/admin-security";
import {
  DISPLAY_NAME_MAX_LENGTH,
  PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH,
  passwordRequirements,
  validateDisplayName,
  validatePasswordChange,
} from "@/lib/security-policy";

interface SettingsClientProps {
  profile: AdminProfile;
}

interface ApiBody {
  error?: string;
  name?: string;
  revoked?: number;
}

/** Small tinted icon chip used as the card identity marker. */
function CardIcon({
  icon: Icon,
  className,
}: {
  icon: typeof User;
  className: string;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${className}`}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <Icon className="size-4" />
    </span>
  );
}

function Requirement({ met, children }: { met: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const Icon = met ? Check : Circle;
  return (
    <li
      className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-xs ${met ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}
    >
      <Icon className={`size-3.5 ${met ? "text-emerald-600" : ""}`} aria-hidden />
      {children}
    </li>
  );
}

export function SettingsClient({ profile }: SettingsClientProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [name, setName] = useState(profile.name);
  const [profilePending, setProfilePending] = useState(false);
  const [profileError, setProfileError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [passwordPending, setPasswordPending] = useState(false);
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const requirements = passwordRequirements(newPassword);

  async function saveProfile(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setProfileError(null);

    const parsed = validateDisplayName(name);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setProfileError(parsed.message);
      return;
    }

    setProfilePending(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/profile", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: parsed.value }),
      });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ApiBody;
      if (!response.ok) {
        setProfileError(body.error ?? "Could not save your profile.");
        return;
      }
      setName(body.name ?? parsed.value);
      toast.success("Profile updated.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setProfileError("Could not save your profile.");
    } finally {
      setProfilePending(false);
    }
  }

  async function changePassword(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPasswordError(null);

    const parsed = validatePasswordChange({
      currentPassword,
      newPassword,
      confirmPassword,
    });
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setPasswordError(parsed.message);
      return;
    }

    setPasswordPending(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/security/password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          currentPassword: parsed.value.currentPassword,
          newPassword: parsed.value.newPassword,
          confirmPassword,
        }),
      });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ApiBody;
      if (!response.ok) {
        setPasswordError(body.error ?? "Could not change your password.");
        return;
      }
      setCurrentPassword("");
      setNewPassword("");
      setConfirmPassword("");
      toast.success("Password changed. Every other session was signed out.");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setPasswordError("Could not change your password.");
    } finally {
      setPasswordPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
      <Card className="gap-4">
        <CardHeader className="gap-1 border-b px-4 py-4 lg:px-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <CardIcon
              icon={User}
              className="bg-sky-50 text-sky-600 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300"
            />
            Profile information
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Your display name appears across the console and can be changed
            here.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-4 lg:px-5">
          <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={saveProfile}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="profile-name">Display name</Label>
              <Input
                id="profile-name"
                value={name}
                maxLength={DISPLAY_NAME_MAX_LENGTH}
                autoComplete="name"
                aria-invalid={profileError ? true : undefined}
                aria-describedby={profileError ? "profile-error" : undefined}
                onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="profile-email">Email</Label>
              <Input id="profile-email" value={profile.email} readOnly disabled />
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <Lock className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                Read-only — managed by your sign-in provider and cannot be
                changed here.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">Role</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="secondary">Super Admin</Badge>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <Lock className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                  Fixed — there is exactly one Super Admin.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            {profileError ? (
              <p id="profile-error" className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
                {profileError}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            <div>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={profilePending}>
                {profilePending ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden /> Saving...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "Save profile"
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="gap-4">
        <CardHeader className="gap-1 border-b px-4 py-4 lg:px-5">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <CardIcon
              icon={KeyRound}
              className="bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/50 dark:text-violet-300"
            />
            Change password
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Use at least {PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} characters with three of four
            character types. Every other signed-in device is signed out.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-4 lg:px-5">
          <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={changePassword}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="current-password">Current password</Label>
              <Input
                id="current-password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                value={currentPassword}
                onChange={(event) => setCurrentPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="new-password">New password</Label>
              <Input
                id="new-password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={newPassword}
                onChange={(event) => setNewPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="confirm-password">Confirm new password</Label>
              <Input
                id="confirm-password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(event) => setConfirmPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                Password requirements
              </span>
              <ul
                className="grid gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2"
                aria-label="Password requirements"
              >
                <Requirement met={requirements.length}>
                  At least {PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} characters
                </Requirement>
                <Requirement met={requirements.lowercase}>Lowercase letter</Requirement>
                <Requirement met={requirements.uppercase}>Uppercase letter</Requirement>
                <Requirement met={requirements.digit}>Number</Requirement>
                <Requirement met={requirements.symbol}>Symbol</Requirement>
              </ul>
            </div>
            {passwordError ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  timeStyle: "short",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeStyle: "short",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return dateFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function formatTime(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return timeFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function dateTime(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return dateTimeFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function accountLabel(connection: AdminSocialConnectionRow): string {
  return connection.accountName ?? connection.accountId ?? "—";
}

function PlatformBadge({ platform }: { platform: AdminPlatform }) {

      title={meta.label}

      {meta.label}
    </span>
  );
}

export default async function AdminSocialAccountsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  await requireAdminPage();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (typeof value === "string") query.set(key, value);
    else if (Array.isArray(value) && value[0]) query.set(key, value[0]);
  }
  const filters = parseSocialAccountFilters(query);
  const result = await listSocialAccounts(filters);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Social accounts"
        description="Monitor every connected social account across the platform. Only non-secret metadata is shown; access tokens are never exposed."
      />

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Connections</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {result.filteredConnections} of {result.totalConnections} connections
            {" · "}
            {result.filteredUsers} user{result.filteredUsers === 1 ? "" : "s"}{" "}
            shown, one row per owner.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <SocialAccountFilters
            initialQuery={filters.query}
            initialPlatform={filters.platform}
            initialStatus={filters.status}
          />

          {result.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={UserSearch}
              title="No users match these filters"
              description="Try a different search term, platform, or status filter."
            />
          ) : (
            <Table className="min-w-[960px] table-fixed">
              <colgroup>
                <col className="w-[17%]" />
                <col className="w-[11%]" />
                <col className="w-[20%]" />
                <col className="w-[14%]" />
                <col className="w-[12%]" />
                <col className="w-[12%]" />
                <col className="w-[14%]" />
              </colgroup>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Owner</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Platform</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Connected account</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Last sync</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Token expiry</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="px-3">Last error</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {result.rows.map((row) => (
                  <OwnerRow key={row.userId} row={row} />
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}

          <AdminPagination
            page={result.page}
            pageSize={result.pageSize}
            total={result.filteredUsers}
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

const PLATFORM_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All platforms",
  facebook: "Facebook",
  instagram: "Instagram",
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All statuses",
  connected: "Connected",
  expired: "Expired",
  error: "Error",
  disconnected: "Disconnected",
};

export function SocialAccountFilters({
  initialQuery,
  initialPlatform,
  initialStatus,
}: {
  initialQuery: string;
  initialPlatform: string;
  initialStatus: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState(initialPlatform);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialStatus);

  function apply(nextQuery: string, nextPlatform: string, nextStatus: string) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    const trimmed = nextQuery.trim();
    if (trimmed) params.set("q", trimmed);
    if (nextPlatform !== "all") params.set("platform", nextPlatform);
    if (nextStatus !== "all") params.set("status", nextStatus);
    const search = params.toString();
    startTransition(() =>
      router.replace(search ? `${pathname}?${search}` : pathname),
    );
  }

  const active = query.trim() || platform !== "all" || status !== "all";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
      <form
        className="flex w-full gap-2 sm:max-w-sm"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          apply(query, platform, status);
        }}
      >
        <Input
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search owner name or email"
          aria-label="Search social accounts by owner name or email"
          maxLength={100}
        />
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={pending}>
          Search
        </Button>
      </form>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Select
          value={platform}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const next = value ?? "all";
            setPlatform(next);
            apply(query, next, status);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-40" aria-label="Filter by platform">
            <SelectValue>
              {(value) => PLATFORM_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All platforms"}
            </SelectValue>
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {Object.entries(PLATFORM_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
              <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                {label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        <Select
          value={status}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const next = value ?? "all";
            setStatus(next);
            apply(query, platform, next);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-40" aria-label="Filter by connection status">
            <SelectValue>
              {(value) => STATUS_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All statuses"}
            </SelectValue>
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {Object.entries(STATUS_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
              <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                {label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        {active ? (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => {
              setQuery("");
              setPlatform("all");
              setStatus("all");
              apply("", "all", "all");
            }}
          >
            Reset
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { PostStatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { PlatformChip } from "@/components/platform-chip";
import { CalendarDays } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/calendar";

export interface CalendarPost {
  id: string;
  platform: "facebook" | "instagram" | "linkedin";
  status: "scheduled" | "publishing" | "published" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "held";
  mediaType: string;
  text: string;
  when: string;
}

function dayKey(date: Date): number {
  return date.getFullYear() * 10_000 + (date.getMonth() + 1) * 100 + date.getDate();
}

const dayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  weekday: "long",
  month: "long",
  day: "numeric",
  year: "numeric",
});

const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  timeStyle: "short",
});

export function CalendarPanel({ posts }: { posts: CalendarPost[] }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Date | undefined>(undefined);

  const entries = useMemo(
    () =>
      posts.map((post) => ({
        post,
        date: new Date(post.when),
      })),
    [posts],
  );

  const scheduledDates = useMemo(() => entries.map((entry) => entry.date), [entries]);
  const selectedKey = selected ? dayKey(selected) : null;
  const selectedPosts = selectedKey === null
    ? []
    : entries.filter((entry) => dayKey(entry.date) === selectedKey);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Schedule</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Days with scheduled or published posts are marked. Select a day to
            see its posts.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex justify-center">
          <Calendar
            mode="single"
            selected={selected}
            onSelect={setSelected}
            modifiers={{ scheduled: scheduledDates }}
            modifiersClassNames={{ scheduled: "bg-primary/15 font-semibold" }}
            className="rounded-md border"
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>
            {selected ? dayFormatter.format(selected) : "Select a day"}
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {selected
              ? `${selectedPosts.length} post${selectedPosts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} on this day.`
              : "Pick a marked day to see its posts."}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {selectedPosts.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={CalendarDays}
              title={selected ? "Nothing on this day" : "No day selected"}
              description={
                selected
                  ? "No posts are scheduled or were published on this day."
                  : "Marked days in the calendar have scheduled or published posts."
              }
            />
          ) : (
            selectedPosts.map(({ post }) => (
              <div
                key={post.id}
                className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b pb-3 last:border-b-0 last:pb-0"
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span className="mt-0.5">
                    <PlatformChip platform={post.platform} />
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                    <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm font-medium">
                      {post.text || "—"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {timeFormatter.format(new Date(post.when))}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <PostStatusBadge status={post.status} />
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { CalendarPanel, type CalendarPost } from "./calendar-panel";
import { scheduledPostStatus } from "@/lib/backend";
import { requireApprovedUser } from "@/lib/session";

export default async function CalendarPage() {
  // Calendar is in the shared sidebar navigation for every approved account.
  const session = await requireApprovedUser();
  const posts = await scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id);

  const entries: CalendarPost[] = posts
    .filter((post) => post.status !== "cancelled")
    .map((post) => ({
      id: post.id,
      platform: post.platform,
      status: post.status,
      mediaType: post.mediaType,
      text: post.text,
      when: post.publishedAt ?? post.scheduledAt,
    }));

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Calendar"
        description="Scheduled and published posts across the month, one platform per mark."
      />
      <CalendarPanel posts={entries} />
    </>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/compose/composer.tsx
