"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus, LoaderCircle, Send, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { PlatformChip } from "@/components/platform-chip";
import { PlatformLogo } from "@/components/platform-logo";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { cn } from "cn";

const PLATFORMS = [
  { id: "facebook", label: "Facebook" },
  { id: "instagram", label: "Instagram" },
  { id: "linkedin", label: "LinkedIn" },
] as const;

type PlatformId = (typeof PLATFORMS)[number]["id"];

const TEXT_LIMITS: Record<PlatformId, number> = {
  instagram: 2200,
  facebook: 63206,
  linkedin: 3000,
};

const ACCEPT = "image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,video/mp4,video/quicktime";
const MAX_ITEMS = 10;

type MediaKind = "image" | "video";

function kindFor(file: File): MediaKind {
  if (file.type.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  if (file.type.startsWith("video/")) return "video";
  throw new Error(`Unsupported file type "${file.type || file.name}".`);
}

function localDateTimeDefault(offsetMinutes: number): string {
  const date = new Date(Date.now() + offsetMinutes * 60_000);
  const pad = (value: number) => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

/** A red field message shown under the field that caused it. */
function FieldError({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}

function formatCountdown(target: string): string {
  const date = new Date(target);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const diff = date.getTime() - Date.now();
  const days = Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000);
  const hours = Math.floor((diff % 86_400_000) / 3_600_000);
  const minutes = Math.round((diff % 3_600_000) / 60_000);
  if (days > 0) return `in ${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  if (hours > 0) return `in ${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  if (minutes > 0) return `in ${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  return "very soon";
}

export function Composer() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [platforms, setPlatforms] = useState<PlatformId[]>(["instagram"]);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [scheduledAt, setScheduledAt] = useState(() => localDateTimeDefault(60));
  const [publishNow, setPublishNow] = useState(false);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [previewUrls, setPreviewUrls] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  // Stable lower bound for the schedule picker. Reading the clock during
  // render would be impure; the server re-validates the chosen time anyway.
  const [minSchedule] = useState(() => localDateTimeDefault(1));

  const previews = useMemo(
    () =>
      files.map((file, index) => ({
        file,
        url: previewUrls[index],
        kind: kindFor(file),
      })),
    [files, previewUrls],
  );

  const imageCount = previews.filter((item) => item.kind === "image").length;
  const videoCount = previews.filter((item) => item.kind === "video").length;
  const isCarousel = imageCount >= 2 && videoCount === 0;

  const selectedLimit = platforms.reduce(
    (limit, id) => Math.min(limit, TEXT_LIMITS[id]),
    Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
  );

  // One error list per field, so each message renders next to its input.
  const platformError = platforms.length === 0 ? "Select at least one platform." : null;
  const textError =
    !text.trim()
      ? "Add the post text."
      : text.length > selectedLimit
        ? `Text exceeds the ${selectedLimit}-character limit for the selected platforms.`
        : null;
  const mediaError =
    files.length > MAX_ITEMS
      ? `Choose at most ${MAX_ITEMS} media items.`
      : videoCount > 0 && imageCount > 0
        ? "Use either a single video or only images."
        : platforms.includes("instagram") && files.length === 0
          ? "Instagram requires at least one image or video."
          : isCarousel && (!platforms.includes("instagram") || platforms.length > 1)
            ? "Carousels can only be published to Instagram."
            : null;
  const scheduleError = publishNow
    ? null
    : !scheduledAt
      ? "Choose a schedule time."
      : Number.isNaN(new Date(scheduledAt).getTime())
        ? "Choose a valid date and time."
        : scheduledAt < minSchedule
          ? "Choose a time in the future."
          : null;

  const issues: string[] = [];
  if (platformError) issues.push(platformError);
  if (textError) issues.push(textError);
  if (mediaError) issues.push(mediaError);
  if (scheduleError) issues.push(scheduleError);

  function togglePlatform(id: PlatformId) {
    setPlatforms((current) =>
      current.includes(id) ? current.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...current, id],
    );
  }

  function onFiles(next: FileList | null) {
    if (!next) return;
    const incoming = Array.from(next);
    try {
      for (const file of incoming) kindFor(file);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unsupported file.");
      return;
    }

    const combined = [...files, ...incoming].slice(0, MAX_ITEMS);
    if (files.length + incoming.length > MAX_ITEMS) {
      toast.error(`Only ${MAX_ITEMS} media items can be attached.`);
    }
    setFiles(combined);
    setPreviewUrls((current) => {
      current.forEach((url) => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
      return combined.map((file) => URL.createObjectURL(file));
    });
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
  }

  function removeFile(index: number) {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrls[index]);
    setFiles((current) => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    setPreviewUrls((current) => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  async function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (issues.length > 0 || pending) return;

    setPending(true);
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      platforms.forEach((platform) => form.append("platforms", platform));
      form.append("text", text.trim());
      form.append("publishNow", publishNow ? "true" : "false");
      if (!publishNow) {
        form.append("scheduledAt", new Date(scheduledAt).toISOString());
      }
      files.forEach((file) => form.append("media", file));

      const response = await fetch("/api/posts", { method: "POST", body: form });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        error?: string;
        scheduled?: unknown[];
      };

      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Could not schedule the post.");
        return;
      }

      toast.success(
        publishNow
          ? "Publishing now. Check the Queue for progress."
          : `Scheduled ${Array.isArray(body.scheduled) ? body.scheduled.length : 1} post(s).`,
      );
      router.push("/queue");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Could not create the post. Try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form className="flex flex-col gap-6" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Post content</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Choose where to publish and write the caption.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label id="platforms-label">Platforms</Label>
            <div
              role="group"
              aria-labelledby="platforms-label"
              className="flex flex-col gap-2"
            >
              {PLATFORMS.map((platform) => {
                const active = platforms.includes(platform.id);
                return (
                  <label
                    key={platform.id}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 focus-within:ring-[3px] focus-within:ring-ring/50 focus-within:outline-none",
                      active ? "border-primary bg-primary/5" : "border-input",
                    )}
                  >
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={active}
                      onCheckedChange={() => togglePlatform(platform.id)}
                    />
                    <PlatformLogo
                      platform={platform.id}
                      className="size-7 rounded-md"
                    />
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      {platform.label}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {platformError ? <FieldError>{platformError}</FieldError> : null}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="text">Post text</Label>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "text-xs text-muted-foreground",
                  text.length > selectedLimit && "font-medium text-destructive",
                )}
              >
                {text.length} / {selectedLimit}
              </span>
            </div>
            <Textarea
              id="text"
              rows={6}
              value={text}
              aria-invalid={textError !== null}
              onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Write your post..."
            />
            {textError ? <FieldError>{textError}</FieldError> : null}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Media</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Optional: images, a video, or an Instagram carousel.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            JPEG, PNG, or GIF images (2–10 for an Instagram carousel), or a
            single MP4/MOV video up to 50&nbsp;MB. Instagram needs at least one
            item.
          </p>
          <label
            htmlFor="media"
            className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed px-6 py-8 text-center transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none"
          >
            <ImagePlus className="size-5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Click to choose images or a video
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {files.length === 0
                ? "Nothing attached yet"
                : `${files.length} of ${MAX_ITEMS} items attached`}
            </span>
            <Input
              id="media"
              ref={inputRef}
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT}
              multiple
              className="sr-only"
              onChange={(event) => onFiles(event.target.files)}
            />
          </label>
          {mediaError ? <FieldError>{mediaError}</FieldError> : null}
          {previews.length > 0 ? (
            <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {previews.map((item, index) => (
                <li key={`${item.file.name}-${index}`} className="w-24">
                  <figure className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                      {item.kind === "image" && item.url ? (
                        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                        <img
                          src={item.url}
                          alt={item.file.name}
                          className="aspect-square w-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <video
                          src={item.url}
                          className="aspect-square w-full object-cover"
                          muted
                          playsInline
                        />
                      )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={`Remove ${item.file.name}`}
                        className="absolute right-1 top-1 flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background/80 text-foreground shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-background focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:outline-none"
                        onClick={() => removeFile(index)}
                      >
                        <X className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <figcaption className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="truncate text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {item.file.name}
                      </span>
                      <Badge variant="secondary" className="shrink-0 text-[9px]">
                        {item.kind}
                      </Badge>
                    </figcaption>
                  </figure>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Publish options</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Publish immediately, or schedule for a future time.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div
            role="radiogroup"
            aria-label="When to publish"
            className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2"
          >
            {(
              [
                {
                  value: true,
                  title: "Publish Now",
                  description: "Queue the post and let the worker publish it right away.",
                },
                {
                  value: false,
                  title: "Schedule Post",
                  description: "Publish automatically at the chosen date and time.",
                },
              ] as const
            ).map((option) => {
              const active = publishNow === option.value;
              return (
                <button
                  key={option.title}
                  type="button"
                  role="radio"
                  aria-checked={active}
                  onClick={() => setPublishNow(option.value)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-lg border p-3 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none",
                    active
                      ? "border-primary bg-primary/5"
                      : "hover:bg-muted/50",
                  )}
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                    <span
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className={cn(
                        "size-3 rounded-full border",
                        active ? "border-primary bg-primary" : "border-muted-foreground/50",
                      )}
                    />
                    {option.title}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {option.description}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}

            <div className="flex max-w-xs flex-col gap-2">
              <Label htmlFor="scheduledAt">Publish at</Label>
              <Input
                id="scheduledAt"
                type="datetime-local"

                aria-invalid={scheduleError !== null}

              />
              {scheduledAt && !scheduleError ? (

                </p>
              ) : null}
              {scheduleError ? <FieldError>{scheduleError}</FieldError> : null}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              The post is queued now and published by the worker within seconds.
            </p>
          )}

              {pending ? (
                <>
                  <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                  {publishNow ? "Publishing…" : "Scheduling…"}
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send aria-hidden="true" />
                  {publishNow ? "Publish Now" : "Schedule Post"}
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => router.push("/")}>
              Discard
            </Button>
            {issues.length > 0 ? (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Fix the highlighted fields to continue.
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Preview</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            An approximate preview of what will be sent to each platform.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {platforms.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Select a platform to see its preview.
            </p>
          ) : (
            PLATFORMS.filter((platform) => platforms.includes(platform.id)).map(
              (platform) => (
                <div key={platform.id} className="rounded-lg border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <PlatformChip platform={platform.id} />
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{platform.label}</span>
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-auto text-[10px]">
                      {publishNow
                        ? "Publishing now"
                        : `Scheduled ${formatCountdown(scheduledAt)}`}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  {previews.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
                      {previews
                        .slice(0, isCarousel ? 10 : 1)
                        .map((item, index) => (
                          <div
                            key={index}
                            className="h-20 w-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-md border"
                          >
                            {item.kind === "image" && item.url ? (
                              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                              <img
                                src={item.url}
                                alt=""
                                className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              <video
                                src={item.url}
                                className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                                muted
                                playsInline
                              />
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm">
                    {text.trim() || "No text yet."}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ),
            )
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

"use client";

import { CircleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";

// Route-level error boundary for the authenticated dashboard. It catches an
// unexpected server-render failure in a page (for example a backend/query
// error) so the user sees a recoverable message instead of Next's built-in 500
// page. The server forwards only a generic message plus `digest` in production;
// the digest matches the corresponding server log entry.
export default function DashboardError({
  error,
  retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-6">
      <Card className="max-w-lg">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CircleAlert className="text-destructive size-5" aria-hidden />
            This page couldn&apos;t load
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            A server error interrupted loading this page. Try again; if it keeps
            happening, give the error reference below to an administrator.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {error.digest ? (
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              Error reference:{" "}
              <code className="font-mono break-all">{error.digest}</code>
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <Button onClick={() => retry()}>Try again</Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/app-sidebar";
import { SessionUnavailable } from "@/components/session-unavailable";
import { SignOutButton } from "@/components/sign-out-button";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { SidebarInset, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import {
  SessionUnavailableError,
  getSession,
  readAccountState,
  type AdminSession,
} from "@/lib/session";

export default async function DashboardLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<"/">) {
  let session: AdminSession | null;
  try {
    session = await getSession();
  } catch (error) {
    // A failed session lookup (database unreachable, timeout, pool exhausted)
    // is an infrastructure outage, not an invalid session. Without this catch
    // it escapes the layout - which the sibling `error.tsx` cannot wrap - and
    // Next replaces the entire app with its built-in global error page. Render
    // a retryable state instead, and never treat the outage as a logout.
    if (error instanceof SessionUnavailableError) return <SessionUnavailable />;
    throw error;
  }
  if (!session) redirect("/login");

  // Server-side account lifecycle enforcement: pending and rejected users
  // (and any lingering suspended/deleted session that was not revoked by an
  // admin action) can never render the dashboard. The Super Admin passes as
  // an approved account.
  const state = readAccountState(session);
  if (state?.deleted) redirect("/login");
  if (state?.banActive) redirect("/login");
  if (state && state.approvalStatus !== "approved") redirect("/pending");

  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <AppSidebar isAdmin={state?.isAdmin ?? false} />
      <SidebarInset>
        <header className="flex h-14 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 border-b px-4">
          <SidebarTrigger />
          <Separator orientation="vertical" className="h-5" />
          <span className="hidden min-w-0 truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:inline">
            {session.user.email}
          </span>
          <div className="ml-auto shrink-0">
            <SignOutButton />
          </div>
        </header>
        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-4 sm:gap-6 sm:p-6">
          {children}
        </div>
      </SidebarInset>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/media/media-uploader.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy, FileUp, LoaderCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

// Browser fallback for remote MCP clients that cannot transfer attachment
// bytes. The published MCP spec has no client-to-server file-upload primitive,
// so Claude.ai cannot hand an attached image's binary to a remote MCP tool. A
// signed-in user uploads the file here; the response's permanent storagePath
// can then be pasted back into the Claude conversation and passed to
// social_publish (imageStoragePath) or social_schedule_media
// (media[].storagePath). The path never expires; signed URLs are never stored.

const ACCEPT = "image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,video/mp4,video/quicktime,application/pdf";

interface UploadResult {
  storagePath: string;
  kind: string;
  contentType: string;
  bytes: number;
  note?: string;
}

const KIND_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  image: "Image",
  video: "Video",
  document: "Document",
};

export function MediaUploader() {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [fileLabel, setFileLabel] = useState("");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<UploadResult | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  function onFileChange(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    setFileLabel(file?.name ?? "");
    setResult(null);
  }

  async function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const file = inputRef.current?.files?.[0];
    if (!file || pending) return;

    setPending(true);
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", file);
      const response = await fetch("/api/media/upload", { method: "POST", body: form });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as UploadResult & { error?: string };
      if (!response.ok || !body.storagePath) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Upload failed. Check the file type and size, then try again.");
        return;
      }
      setResult(body);
      setCopied(false);
      toast.success(`${file.name} uploaded to your private storage.`);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Upload failed. Check the file type and size, then try again.");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
      setFileLabel("");
    }
  }

  async function copyStoragePath() {
    if (!result?.storagePath) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(result.storagePath);
      setCopied(true);
      toast.success("Storage path copied.");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Copy failed. Select the path text and copy it manually.");
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Upload media</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Images (JPEG, PNG, GIF), videos (MP4, MOV), or PDF documents.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="media-file">File</Label>
            <Input
              id="media-file"
              ref={inputRef}
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT}
              onChange={onFileChange}
              disabled={pending}
            />
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || !fileLabel} className="w-fit">
            {pending ? (
              <>
                <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                Uploading…
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <FileUp aria-hidden="true" />
                Upload
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </form>
        {result && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-md border bg-muted/40 p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-sm">
              <span className="font-medium">
                {KIND_LABELS[result.kind] ?? result.kind} uploaded
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {(result.bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
              <code className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-all rounded bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs">
                {result.storagePath}
              </code>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={copyStoragePath}>
                {copied ? (
                  <Check aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Copy aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
              </Button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              To use it from Claude: paste this path into the conversation and
              say “Publish/schedule this image”. In the MCP tools it goes to{" "}
              <code>imageStoragePath</code> (social_publish) or{" "}
              <code>media[].storagePath</code> (social_schedule_media). The path
              is permanent — signed URLs are generated fresh at publish time and
              must never be stored.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import {

  CircleAlert,

  Users,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { PostStatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { PlatformChip } from "@/components/platform-chip";
import { PlatformLogo } from "@/components/platform-logo";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { loadTokenMetadata, scheduledPostStatus, type TokenMetadata } from "@/lib/backend";
import { requireApprovedUser } from "@/lib/session";
import { PLATFORMS } from "@/lib/admin-policy";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function OverviewPage() {
  // The Overview is the default post-login destination for every role, so it
  // must only require an approved account - not the Super Admin role. Admin
  // accounts pass this check too.
  const session = await requireApprovedUser();
  const [posts, tokens] = await Promise.all([
    scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id),
    // Display-only metadata (account name, expiry) from the stored tokens.
    // Provider APIs are not contacted here, so the page stays fast.
    loadTokenMetadata(session.user.id).catch(() => [] as TokenMetadata[]),
  ]);

  const scheduled = posts.filter((post) => post.status === "scheduled");
  const published = posts.filter((post) => post.status === "published");
  const failed = posts.filter((post) => post.status === "failed");

  const tokenByPlatform = new Map(tokens.map((t) => [t.platform, t]));
  const connected = PLATFORMS.filter(
    (platform) => tokenByPlatform.has(platform),
  );
  const expired = connected.filter(
    (platform) => tokenByPlatform.get(platform)?.expired,
  );

  const upcoming = scheduled
    .sort((a, b) => a.scheduledAt.localeCompare(b.scheduledAt))
    .slice(0, 5);

  const stats: {
    label: string;
    value: number;
    icon: typeof CalendarClock;
    tint: string;
    href: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      label: "Scheduled",
      value: scheduled.length,
      icon: CalendarClock,
      tint: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-600 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300",
      href: "/queue",
    },
    {
      label: "Published",
      value: published.length,
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      tint: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300",
      href: "/history",
    },
    {
      label: "Failed",
      value: failed.length,
      icon: CircleAlert,
      tint: "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/50 dark:text-red-300",
      href: "/history",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Overview"
        description="A summary of your accounts, upcoming posts, and publishing results."
        actions={
          <Link href="/compose" className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })}>
            <PenSquare aria-hidden="true" />
            New post
          </Link>
        }
      />

      {expired.length > 0 ? (
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/30 dark:text-amber-300">
          <strong className="font-semibold">
            {expired
              .map((platform) => PLATFORM_LABEL(platform))
              .join(", ")}{" "}
            access has expired.
          </strong>
          <Link
            href="/accounts"
            className="font-medium underline underline-offset-2 hover:underline"
          >
            Reconnect account{expired.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
          </Link>
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {stats.map((stat) => (
          <Link
            key={stat.label}
            href={stat.href}
            className="group block rounded-xl focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:outline-none"
          >
            <Card className="h-full transition-colors group-hover:bg-muted/50">
              <CardContent className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {stat.label}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                    {stat.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <span
                  className={`flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${stat.tint}`}
                >
                  <stat.icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle>Connected accounts</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {connected.length === 0
                ? "No accounts connected yet. Connect one to start publishing."
                : `${connected.length} of ${PLATFORMS.length} platforms connected.`}
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/accounts"
            className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })}
          >
            <Users aria-hidden="true" />
            Manage accounts
          </Link>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {connected.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={PenSquare}
              title="No connected accounts"
              description="Connect Facebook, Instagram, or LinkedIn from the Accounts page to start publishing."
            />
          ) : (
            <ul className="flex flex-col">
              {connected.map((platform) => {
                const token = tokenByPlatform.get(platform);
                return (
                  <li
                    key={platform}
                    className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 border-b pb-3 last:border-b-0 last:pb-0"
                  >
                    <PlatformLogo platform={platform} />
                    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                        {PLATFORM_LABEL(platform)}

                      ) : null}
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <span
                          aria-hidden="true"
                          className={`size-1.5 rounded-full ${
                            token?.expired ? "bg-amber-500" : "bg-emerald-500"
                          }`}
                        />
                        {token?.expired ? "Expired — reconnect" : "Connected"}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle>Upcoming</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              The next scheduled posts due to publish.
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/calendar"
            className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })}
          >
            <CalendarDays aria-hidden="true" />
            View calendar
          </Link>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {upcoming.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={CalendarClock}
              title="Nothing scheduled"
              description="Create a post in the Composer and pick Schedule to see it here."
            />
          ) : (
            upcoming.map((post) => (
              <div
                key={post.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b pb-3 last:border-b-0 last:pb-0"
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
                  <PlatformChip platform={post.platform} />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">
                      {post.text || `${PLATFORM_LABEL(post.platform)} post`}

                      {new Date(post.scheduledAt).toLocaleString()}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/users/[id]/account-actions.tsx

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  KeyRoundIcon,
  PauseCircleIcon,
  PlayCircleIcon,
  RotateCcwIcon,
  Trash2Icon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";

type AccountAction =
  | "suspend"
  | "reactivate"
  | "soft_delete"
  | "restore"
  | "revoke_sessions";

interface ActionResult {
  error?: string;
  sessionsRevoked?: number;
  postsHeld?: number;
  postsResumed?: number;
  postsStillHeld?: number;
}

const CONFIRM: Record<AccountAction, { title: string; description: string; label: string }> = {
  suspend: {
    title: "Suspend this account?",
    description:
      "The user loses access immediately, active sessions are revoked, and their unclaimed scheduled posts are held.",
    label: "Suspend account",
  },
  reactivate: {
    title: "Reactivate this account?",
    description:
      "Access is restored. Future held posts return to the queue; overdue held posts stay held until explicitly rescheduled.",
    label: "Reactivate account",
  },
  soft_delete: {
    title: "Soft delete this account?",
    description:
      "Access is revoked, scheduled posts are held, and audit history is preserved. The account is not permanently removed and can be restored later.",
    label: "Soft delete account",
  },
  restore: {
    title: "Restore this account?",
    description:
      "The account becomes active again if it was approved. Future held posts may return to the queue.",
    label: "Restore account",
  },
  revoke_sessions: {
    title: "Revoke all sessions?",
    description:
      "Every active session for this user is deleted. The user must sign in again.",
    label: "Revoke sessions",
  },
};

const STATUS_ACTIONS = {
  suspend: {
    label: "Suspend account",
    icon: PauseCircleIcon,
    description:
      "Temporarily block access. Sessions are revoked and unclaimed scheduled posts are held.",
  },
  reactivate: {
    label: "Reactivate account",
    icon: PlayCircleIcon,
    description:
      "Restore access for a suspended account and return future held posts to the queue.",
  },
  restore: {
    label: "Restore account",
    icon: RotateCcwIcon,
    description:
      "Undo the soft delete. The account becomes active again if it was approved.",
  },
} as const;

export function AccountActions({
  id,
  role,
  banned,
  deletedAt,
  isSelf,
}: {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  banned: boolean;
  deletedAt: string | null;
  isSelf: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [action, setAction] = useState<AccountAction | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const isDeleted = Boolean(deletedAt);
  const isProtectedAdmin = role === "admin";
  const statusAction: keyof typeof STATUS_ACTIONS = isDeleted
    ? "restore"
    : banned
      ? "reactivate"
      : "suspend";
  const statusMeta = STATUS_ACTIONS[statusAction];
  const StatusIcon = statusMeta.icon;

  const canRevokeSessions = !isDeleted && !isSelf;
  const canSoftDelete = !isDeleted && !isSelf && !isProtectedAdmin;
  const statusDisabled =
    busy || isSelf || (isProtectedAdmin && statusAction === "suspend");

  function summary(body: ActionResult): string {
    if (action === "revoke_sessions") {
      return `${body.sessionsRevoked ?? 0} session(s) revoked.`;
    }
    if (action === "suspend" || action === "soft_delete") {
      return `${body.sessionsRevoked ?? 0} session(s) revoked, ${body.postsHeld ?? 0} post(s) held.`;
    }
    if (action === "reactivate" || action === "restore") {
      const resumed = body.postsResumed ?? 0;
      const still = body.postsStillHeld ?? 0;
      return `${resumed} post(s) resumed${still ? `, ${still} still held` : ""}.`;
    }
    return "Account updated.";
  }

  async function submit() {
    if (!action) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const revoke = action === "revoke_sessions";
      const response = await fetch(
        revoke
          ? `/api/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/sessions`
          : `/api/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/account`,
        revoke
          ? { method: "DELETE" }
          : {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ action }),
          },
      );
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ActionResult;
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Could not update the account.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success(summary(body));
      setAction(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not update the account.",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Account status</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {statusMeta.description}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={statusAction === "reactivate" ? "default" : "outline"}
            disabled={statusDisabled}
            onClick={() => setAction(statusAction)}
          >
            <StatusIcon aria-hidden="true" />
            {statusMeta.label}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {canRevokeSessions ? (
        <>
          <Separator />
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Account security</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Sign this user out of every browser. They must authenticate
                again to regain access.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => setAction("revoke_sessions")}
              >
                <KeyRoundIcon aria-hidden="true" />
                Revoke sessions
              </Button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </>
      ) : null}

      {canSoftDelete ? (
        <>
          <Separator />
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Account management</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Soft delete removes access while keeping the user record, social
                connections, and publishing history for audit purposes.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="destructive"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => setAction("soft_delete")}
              >
                <Trash2Icon aria-hidden="true" />
                Soft delete account
              </Button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </>
      ) : null}

      {isSelf ? (
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          You cannot suspend, delete, or revoke sessions for your own account.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {isProtectedAdmin && !isSelf ? (
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          The Super Admin account cannot be suspended or deleted.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <AlertDialog open={action !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setAction(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>{action ? CONFIRM[action].title : ""}</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              {action ? CONFIRM[action].description : ""}
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={busy}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              variant={action === "soft_delete" ? "destructive" : "default"}
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void submit()}
            >
              {busy ? "Working…" : action ? CONFIRM[action].label : "Confirm"}
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  timeStyle: "short",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeStyle: "short",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return dateFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function formatTime(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return timeFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function dateTime(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return dateTimeFormatter.format(new Date(value));
}

function initials(name: string): string {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return "?";
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
}

function mediaLabel(mediaType: string | null): string | null {
  if (!mediaType || mediaType === "none") return null;
  return mediaType
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/^\w/, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
}

const ACCOUNT_STATUS_META: Record<

export default async function UserDetailPage(props: PageProps<"/users/[id]">) {
  const session = await requireAdminPage();

  const context = await getAdminUserContext(id);
  if (!context) notFound();
  const { detail, connections, posts } = context;

  const connectionsByPlatform = new Map(
    connections.map((connection) => [connection.platform, connection]),
  );

    connections.map((connection) => connection.platform),
  ).size;
  const failedPosts = posts.filter((post) => post.status === "failed").length;
  const expiredConnections = connections.filter(
    (connection) =>
      connection.expired ||
      connection.status === "expired" ||
      connection.status === "error",
  ).length;

  return (

      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4">

          href="/users"
          className={buttonVariants({

                  className="size-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"

            The most recent {posts.length} post{posts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}{" "}
            for this account, including publishing history and failure details.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {posts.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={CalendarClock}
              title="No scheduled posts"
              description="This user has no scheduled, published, or failed posts yet."
            />
          ) : (

              <colgroup>
                <col className="w-[25%]" />
                <col className="w-[10%]" />
                <col className="w-[13%]" />
                <col className="w-[13%]" />
                <col className="w-[11%]" />
                <col className="w-[6%]" />
                <col className="w-[15%]" />
                <col className="w-[7%]" />
              </colgroup>
              <TableHeader className="bg-muted/40">
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="h-11 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                    Post

                    Platform
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="h-11 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">

export function PostDetails({ post }: { post: AdminUserPost }) {
  // Only surface absolute HTTP(S) links from the publishing result.
  const safePublishedUrl =
    post.publishedUrl && /^https?:\/\//i.test(post.publishedUrl)
      ? post.publishedUrl
      : null;

  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger
        render={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" />}
      >
        <EyeIcon aria-hidden="true" />
        View
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Post details</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Full content and publishing history for this scheduled post.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <Detail label="Platform">
            {PLATFORM_LABELS[post.platform]}
          </Detail>
          <Detail label="Status">
            <PostStatusBadge status={post.status} />
          </Detail>
          <Detail label="Scheduled">{dateTime(post.scheduledAt)}</Detail>
          <Detail label="Published">
            {post.publishedAt ? dateTime(post.publishedAt) : "Not published"}
          </Detail>
          <Detail label="Retries">
            <span className="tabular-nums">{post.retryCount}</span>
          </Detail>
          <Detail label="Media">{mediaLabel(post.mediaType)}</Detail>
          <Detail label="Created">{dateTime(post.createdAt)}</Detail>
          <Detail label="Post ID">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs break-all">{post.id}</span>
          </Detail>
        </dl>

        <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Content
          </h3>
          <div className="max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3">
            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {post.text}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>

        {post.error ? (
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Error{post.failureStage ? ` · ${post.failureStage}` : ""}
            </h3>
            <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50/60 p-3 dark:border-red-900/50 dark:bg-red-950/30">
              <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-wrap text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                {post.error}
              </p>
            </div>
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {safePublishedUrl ? (
          <a
            href={safePublishedUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer noopener"
            className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
          >
            Open published post
            <ExternalLinkIcon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </a>
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

const ROLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: "Super Admin",
  user: "User",
};

export function UserActions({
  id,
  role,
  approvalStatus,
  isSelf,
  adminExists,
}: {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  approvalStatus: string;
  isSelf: boolean;
  adminExists: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [confirmReject, setConfirmReject] = useState(false);

  async function update(
    body: { approvalStatus?: "approved" | "rejected"; role?: "admin" | "user" },
    successMessage: string,
  ) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const data = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(data.error ?? "Could not update the user.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success(successMessage);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not update the user.",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const isApproved = approvalStatus === "approved";
  const isRejected = approvalStatus === "rejected";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Registration</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Approve this registration to grant access, or reject it to keep the
            account inactive.
          </p>
        </div>

        {isSelf ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            This is your account. You cannot change your own approval status or
            role, so you cannot lock yourself out of the console.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {!isApproved ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() =>
                  void update({ approvalStatus: "approved" }, "User approved.")
                }
              >
                <CheckIcon aria-hidden="true" />
                Approve
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {!isRejected ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="destructive"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => setConfirmReject(true)}
              >
                <XIcon aria-hidden="true" />
                Reject
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {isApproved ? (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Registration approved.
              </span>
            ) : isRejected ? (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Registration rejected.
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <Separator />

      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Role</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            The database allows exactly one Super Admin. Promoting another
            account is only possible when no admin exists.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Select
          value={role}
          disabled={isSelf || busy}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            if (!value || value === role) return;
            void update(
              { role: value as "admin" | "user" },
              `Role changed to ${ROLE_LABELS[value] ?? value}.`,
            );
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger className="w-48" aria-label="Change user role">
            <SelectValue>
              {(value) => ROLE_LABELS[value ?? role] ?? role}
            </SelectValue>
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="user">User</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="admin" disabled={adminExists && role !== "admin"}>
              Super Admin
            </SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </section>

      <AlertDialog open={confirmReject} onOpenChange={setConfirmReject}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Reject this registration?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              The account is marked inactive and cannot access the application.
              Existing records, social connections, and publishing history are
              preserved.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={busy}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              variant="destructive"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => {
                setConfirmReject(false);
                void update({ approvalStatus: "rejected" }, "User rejected.");
              }}
            >
              Reject registration
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { AdminUserSummary } from "@/lib/admin-users";

export function UserRowActions({
  id,
  approvalStatus,
  isSelf,
}: {
  id: string;
  approvalStatus: AdminUserSummary["approvalStatus"];
  isSelf: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [rejectOpen, setRejectOpen] = useState(false);

  async function setApproval(next: "approved" | "rejected") {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ approvalStatus: next }),
      });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Could not update the user.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success(
        next === "approved"
          ? "User approved. They can now sign in."
          : "User rejected. They cannot sign in.",
      );
      setRejectOpen(false);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not update the user.",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
      {!isSelf && approvalStatus !== "approved" ? (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => void setApproval("approved")}
        >
          Approve
        </Button>
      ) : null}
      {!isSelf && approvalStatus !== "rejected" ? (
        <>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => setRejectOpen(true)}
          >
            Reject
          </Button>
          <AlertDialog open={rejectOpen} onOpenChange={setRejectOpen}>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>Reject this user?</AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>
                  The account stays registered but cannot sign in. You can
                  approve it again later from this list.
                </AlertDialogDescription>
              </AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogFooter>
                <AlertDialogCancel disabled={busy}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                <AlertDialogAction
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void setApproval("rejected")}
                >
                  {busy ? "Working…" : "Reject user"}
                </AlertDialogAction>
              </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
          </AlertDialog>
        </>
      ) : null}
      <Link
        href={`/users/${id}`}
        className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
      >
        View
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/(dashboard)/users/users-filters.tsx

"use client";

import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All statuses",
  pending: "Pending",
  active: "Active",
  inactive: "Inactive",
};

const ROLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  all: "All roles",
  admin: "Super Admin",
  user: "User",
};

export function UsersFilters({
  initialQuery,
  initialStatus,
  initialRole,
}: {
  initialQuery: string;
  initialStatus: string;
  initialRole: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialStatus);
  const [role, setRole] = useState(initialRole);

  function apply(nextQuery: string, nextStatus: string, nextRole: string) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    const trimmed = nextQuery.trim();
    if (trimmed) params.set("q", trimmed);
    if (nextStatus !== "all") params.set("status", nextStatus);
    if (nextRole !== "all") params.set("role", nextRole);
    const search = params.toString();
    startTransition(() =>
      router.replace(search ? `${pathname}?${search}` : pathname),
    );
  }

  const filtersActive =
    query.trim().length > 0 || status !== "all" || role !== "all";

  function reset() {
    setQuery("");
    setStatus("all");
    setRole("all");
    apply("", "all", "all");
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
      <form
        className="flex w-full gap-2 sm:max-w-sm"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          apply(query, status, role);
        }}
      >
        <Input
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search name or email"
          aria-label="Search users by name or email"
          maxLength={100}
        />
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={pending}>
          Search
        </Button>
      </form>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Select
          value={status}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const next = value ?? "all";
            setStatus(next);
            apply(query, next, role);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger
            size="sm"
            className="w-36"
            aria-label="Filter by status"
          >
            <SelectValue>
              {(value) => STATUS_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All statuses"}
            </SelectValue>
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {Object.entries(STATUS_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
              <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                {label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        <Select
          value={role}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            const next = value ?? "all";
            setRole(next);
            apply(query, status, next);
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-36" aria-label="Filter by role">
            <SelectValue>
              {(value) => ROLE_LABELS[value ?? "all"] ?? "All roles"}
            </SelectValue>
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {Object.entries(ROLE_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
              <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                {label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        {filtersActive ? (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={reset} disabled={pending}>
            Reset
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { UserSearch } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import type { AdminUserSummary } from "@/lib/admin-users";

import { UserRowActions } from "./user-row-actions";

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

function RoleBadge({ role }: { role: AdminUserSummary["role"] }) {
  return role === "admin" ? (
    <Badge>Super Admin</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge variant="secondary">User</Badge>
  );
}

function StatusBadge({
  user,
}: {
  user: AdminUserSummary;
}) {
  const label =
    user.status === "active"
      ? "Active"
      : user.status === "inactive"
        ? "Inactive"
        : "Pending";
  const badge =
    user.status === "active" ? (
      <Badge variant="secondary">{label}</Badge>
    ) : user.status === "inactive" ? (
      <Badge variant="destructive">{label}</Badge>
    ) : (
      <Badge variant="outline">{label}</Badge>
    );

  // Inactive covers three different lifecycle states; naming the exact reason
  // keeps Suspended and Deleted apart without changing the shared buckets.
  const reason = user.deletedAt
    ? "Deleted"
    : user.banned
      ? "Suspended"
      : user.status === "inactive"
        ? "Rejected"
        : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      {badge}
      {reason ? (
        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{reason}</span>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function UsersTable({
  users,
  currentUserId,
}: {
  users: AdminUserSummary[];
  currentUserId: string;
}) {
  if (users.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={UserSearch}
        title="No users match these filters"
        description="Try a different search term, status, or role filter."
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {users.map((user) => (
          <TableRow key={user.id}>
            <TableCell className="font-medium">
              {user.name}
              {user.id === currentUserId ? (
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">(you)</span>
              ) : null}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">{user.email}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <RoleBadge role={user.role} />
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <StatusBadge user={user} />
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {dateFormatter.format(new Date(user.createdAt))}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              <UserRowActions
                id={user.id}
                approvalStatus={user.approvalStatus}
                isSelf={user.id === currentUserId}
              />
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/admin/profile/route.ts

import { z } from "zod";

import { getAdminProfile, updateAdminProfile } from "@/lib/admin-security";
import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Strict: only the display name can be changed. Role, email, approval state,
// and password are not part of this contract and are rejected if supplied.
const updateSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string(),
  })
  .strict();

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await requireAdmin();
    return Response.json(await getAdminProfile(session.user.id));
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireAdmin();
    const body = updateSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!body.success) {
      throw new ApiError(body.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid profile update.");
    }
    return Response.json(await updateAdminProfile(session.user.id, body.data.name));
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/admin/scheduler/[id]/hold/route.ts

import { z } from "zod";

import { adminHoldPost } from "@/lib/admin-scheduler";
import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const idSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(128);

export async function POST(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireAdmin();
    const parsed = idSchema.safeParse((await params).id);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError("Invalid scheduled post id.");
    return Response.json(await adminHoldPost(session.user.id, parsed.data));
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/admin/security/password/route.ts

import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { z } from "zod";

import { changeAdminPassword } from "@/lib/admin-security";
import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/session";
import { validatePasswordChange } from "@/lib/security-policy";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const bodySchema = z
  .object({
    currentPassword: z.string(),
    newPassword: z.string(),
    confirmPassword: z.string(),
  })
  .strict();

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireAdmin();
    const body = bodySchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!body.success) {
      throw new ApiError(body.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid password change.");
    }

    const parsed = validatePasswordChange(body.data);
    if (!parsed.ok) throw new ApiError(parsed.message);

    // Better Auth verifies the current password, updates the hash, revokes all
    // other sessions, and issues a replacement cookie. The helper forwards the
    // Set-Cookie header and strips the raw session token from the body.
    return await changeAdminPassword({
      headers: new Headers(await headers()),
      userId: session.user.id,
      currentSessionId: session.session.id,
      currentPassword: parsed.value.currentPassword,
      newPassword: parsed.value.newPassword,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

import { z } from "zod";

import { getUserDetail, updateUser } from "@/lib/admin-users";
import {
  MANAGEABLE_APPROVAL_STATUSES,
  USER_ROLES,
  type UserUpdate,
} from "@/lib/admin-users-policy";
import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const idSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(128);

const updateSchema = z
  .object({
    role: z.enum(USER_ROLES).optional(),
    approvalStatus: z.enum(MANAGEABLE_APPROVAL_STATUSES).optional(),
  })
  .strict()
  .refine(
    (value) => value.role !== undefined || value.approvalStatus !== undefined,
    { message: "Provide a role or approvalStatus to update." },
  );

async function targetId(params: Promise<{ id: string }>): Promise<string> {
  const parsed = idSchema.safeParse((await params).id);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError("Invalid user id.");
  return parsed.data;
}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    await requireAdmin();
    const detail = await getUserDetail(await targetId(params));
    if (!detail) throw new ApiError("User not found.", 404);
    return Response.json({ user: detail });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireAdmin();
    const id = await targetId(params);

    const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
    const parsed = updateSchema.safeParse(body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      throw new ApiError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid request.");
    }

    const updated = await updateUser(
      session.user.id,
      id,
      parsed.data as UserUpdate,
    );
    return Response.json({ user: updated });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}
