FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/credentials/route.ts
================================================================================

import { z } from "zod";

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  appCredentialStatuses,
  deleteAppCredentials,
  saveAppCredentials,
  userAppCredentialsActive,
  validateAppCredentialInput,
} from "@/lib/backend";

const providerEnum = z.enum(["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"]);

// Returns only safe metadata: the (public) client/app id for the user's own
// record and whether they are on the shared fallback. The secret is never read
// here and never leaves the database in plaintext.
export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const credentials = await appCredentialStatuses(session.user.id);
    return Response.json({ active: userAppCredentialsActive(), credentials });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

const saveSchema = z.object({
  provider: providerEnum,
  clientId: z.string(),
  // Optional so a blank field preserves the stored secret on an update.
  clientSecret: z.string().optional(),
});

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    if (!userAppCredentialsActive()) {
      throw new ApiError(
        "User-owned developer app credentials require the cloud backend (TOKEN_STORE_BACKEND=supabase).",
        409,
      );
    }
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
    const parsed = saveSchema.safeParse(body);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError("Invalid developer app credentials.");
    const { provider, clientId, clientSecret } = parsed.data;

    const issue = validateAppCredentialInput(provider, clientId, clientSecret, false);
    if (issue) throw new ApiError(issue);

    const configured = (await appCredentialStatuses(session.user.id))
      .find((entry) => entry.provider === provider)?.configured ?? false;
    if (!configured && !(clientSecret ?? "").trim()) {
      throw new ApiError("Enter the app/client secret to save this credential.");
    }

    await saveAppCredentials(session.user.id, provider, { clientId, clientSecret });
    return Response.json({ credentials: await appCredentialStatuses(session.user.id) });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    if (!userAppCredentialsActive()) {
      throw new ApiError(
        "User-owned developer app credentials require the cloud backend (TOKEN_STORE_BACKEND=supabase).",
        409,
      );
    }
    const parsed = providerEnum.safeParse(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("provider"));
    if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError("Invalid provider.");

    // Removing the app configuration never touches stored social tokens or
    // scheduled posts; the user simply falls back to the shared app.
    await deleteAppCredentials(session.user.id, parsed.data);
    return Response.json({ credentials: await appCredentialStatuses(session.user.id) });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

================================================================================
FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/mcp/oauth/authorize/route.ts
================================================================================

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  McpOAuthError,
  createMcpAuthorizationCode,
  getMcpClient,
  isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri,
  validateMcpAuthorizationRequest,
} from "@/lib/backend";

// Consent approval endpoint. The Render worker redirects the browser here with
// an already validated OAuth authorization request. This route re-validates the
// request against the registered client, binds the one-time code to the signed-in
// better-auth user, and then redirects back to the client's registered callback.

function field(form: FormData, name: string): string | undefined {
  const value = form.get(name);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
}

function sameOrigin(request: Request): boolean {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return false;
  try {
    return new URL(origin).origin === new URL(request.url).origin;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function redirectResponse(location: URL): Response {
  return new Response(null, {
    status: 303,
    headers: {
      location: location.toString(),
      "cache-control": "no-store",
    },
  });
}

function authorizationErrorRedirect(
  redirectUri: string,
  state: string | undefined,
  code: string,
  description: string,
): Response {
  const target = new URL(redirectUri);
  target.searchParams.set("error", code);
  target.searchParams.set("error_description", description);
  if (state) target.searchParams.set("state", state);
  return redirectResponse(target);
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (!sameOrigin(request)) {
    return Response.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const form = await request.formData().catch(() => null);
    if (!form) throw new ApiError("Consent must be submitted as a form.");

    const clientId = field(form, "client_id");
    const redirectUri = field(form, "redirect_uri");
    const state = field(form, "state");
    if (!clientId || !redirectUri) {
      throw new ApiError("client_id and redirect_uri are required.");
    }

    // Never redirect to an unverified URI. Check the registration before using
    // the URI in any Location header, including error responses.
    const client = await getMcpClient(clientId);
    if (!client) throw new ApiError("Unknown OAuth client.");
    if (!isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri(client, redirectUri)) {
      throw new ApiError("The redirect_uri is not registered for this client.");
    }

    const action = field(form, "action");
    if (action === "deny") {
      return authorizationErrorRedirect(
        redirectUri,
        state,
        "access_denied",
        "The user denied the authorization request.",
      );
    }
    if (action !== "approve") throw new ApiError("Invalid consent action.");

    const codeChallenge = field(form, "code_challenge");
    if (!codeChallenge) throw new ApiError("A valid PKCE code_challenge is required.");

    let validated;
    try {
      validated = await validateMcpAuthorizationRequest({
        clientId,
        redirectUri,
        ...(field(form, "response_type") !== undefined
          ? { responseType: field(form, "response_type")! }
          : {}),
        ...(field(form, "scope") !== undefined ? { scope: field(form, "scope")! } : {}),
        ...(field(form, "resource") !== undefined ? { resource: field(form, "resource")! } : {}),
        codeChallenge,
        codeChallengeMethod: field(form, "code_challenge_method") ?? "S256",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof McpOAuthError) {
        return authorizationErrorRedirect(redirectUri, state, error.code, error.message);
      }
      throw error;
    }

    const code = await createMcpAuthorizationCode({
      clientId: validated.client.clientId,
      userId: session.user.id,
      redirectUri,
      scope: validated.scope,
      resource: validated.resource,
      codeChallenge,
      codeChallengeMethod: "S256",
    });

    const target = new URL(redirectUri);
    target.searchParams.set("code", code);
    if (state) target.searchParams.set("state", state);
    return redirectResponse(target);
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

================================================================================
FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/media/upload/route.ts
================================================================================

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  config,
  createScheduledImageUrl,
  matchesMediaSignature,
  uploadScheduledDocument,
  uploadScheduledImage,
  uploadScheduledVideo,
} from "@/lib/backend";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type MediaKind = "image" | "video" | "document";

const contentTypeByExtension: Record<string, { contentType: string; kind: MediaKind }> = {
  "image/jpeg": { contentType: "image/jpeg", kind: "image" },
  "image/png": { contentType: "image/png", kind: "image" },
  "image/gif": { contentType: "image/gif", kind: "image" },
  "video/mp4": { contentType: "video/mp4", kind: "video" },
  "video/quicktime": { contentType: "video/quicktime", kind: "video" },
  "application/pdf": { contentType: "application/pdf", kind: "document" },
};

const extensionByContentType: Record<string, string> = {
  "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
  "image/png": ".png",
  "image/gif": ".gif",
  "video/mp4": ".mp4",
  "video/quicktime": ".mov",
  "application/pdf": ".pdf",
};

// Authenticated upload bridge for remote MCP clients such as Claude.ai.
//
// The published MCP spec has no client-to-server file-upload primitive, so a
// remote tool receives neither image bytes nor a browser file handle. A
// signed-in user uploads the image/video/PDF here. The file is validated,
// stored under a per-user prefix in the private Supabase bucket, and the
// response contains the *permanent* object path (`storagePath`). Scheduling
// tools persist that path; the worker downloads the object with server-side
// credentials at publish time and only then creates a short-lived signed URL
// for platforms that require one. A `url` is also returned for immediate use,
// but it is never the durable reference.
//
// The Supabase service-role key is read only on the server. It is never placed
// in the response, a client bundle, or a NEXT_PUBLIC_* variable.
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    if (!config.supabaseUrl || !config.supabaseServiceRoleKey) {
      throw new ApiError(
        "Media upload is not configured on this deployment. Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on the server.",
        503,
      );
    }

    const form = await request.formData().catch(() => null);
    if (!form) throw new ApiError("Upload must be multipart/form-data with a 'file' field.");
    const file = form.get("file");
    if (!(file instanceof File) || file.size === 0) {
      throw new ApiError("Attach a non-empty file in the 'file' field.");
    }

    const mediaType = contentTypeByExtension[file.type];
    const extension = extensionByContentType[file.type];
    if (!mediaType || !extension) {
      throw new ApiError("Only JPEG, PNG, or GIF images, MP4 or MOV videos, and PDF documents are supported.");
    }

    const maxBytes = mediaType.kind === "image"
      ? config.scheduleImageMaxBytes
      : mediaType.kind === "video"
        ? config.scheduleVideoMaxBytes
        : config.scheduleDocumentMaxBytes;
    if (file.size > maxBytes) {
      throw new ApiError(`File exceeds the ${maxBytes}-byte limit for ${mediaType.kind} uploads.`, 413);
    }

    const bytes = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    if (!matchesMediaSignature(bytes, mediaType.contentType)) {
      throw new ApiError("File contents do not match the declared content type.");
    }

    // Namespaced by the authenticated user so one account can never reference
    // another account's object. The scheduler re-validates ownership too.
    const storagePath = mediaType.kind === "image"
      ? await uploadScheduledImage(bytes, mediaType.contentType, extension, session.user.id)
      : mediaType.kind === "video"
        ? await uploadScheduledVideo(bytes, mediaType.contentType, extension, session.user.id)
        : await uploadScheduledDocument(bytes, mediaType.contentType, extension, session.user.id);
    const url = await createScheduledImageUrl(storagePath);

    return Response.json(
      {
        // Permanent reference: pass this as imageStoragePath, media[].storagePath,
        // or documentStoragePath. It never expires.
        storagePath,
        kind: mediaType.kind,
        contentType: mediaType.contentType,
        bytes: bytes.byteLength,
        // Convenience URL for an immediate publish; do not store it for later.
        url,
        expiresInSeconds: config.scheduleSignedUrlTtlSeconds,
        note: "Use storagePath (permanent) when scheduling. The signed url expires and is only for immediate use.",
      },
      { status: 201 },
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/platforms/route.ts
================================================================================

import { apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  linkedinConnectionStatus,
  loadTokenMetadata,
  metaConnectionStatus,
} from "@/lib/backend";

type PlatformId = "facebook" | "instagram" | "linkedin";

async function check(
  ownerId: string,
  platform: PlatformId,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown> & { platform: PlatformId }> {
  try {
    const status =
      platform === "linkedin"
        ? await linkedinConnectionStatus(ownerId)
        : await metaConnectionStatus(ownerId, platform);
    return { platform, ...status };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      platform,
      connected: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Status check failed.",
    };
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const [platforms, metadata] = await Promise.all([
      Promise.all(
        (["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"] as const).map((platform) =>
          check(session.user.id, platform),
        ),
      ),
      // Display-only fields (account name, token expiry). Token material is
      // decrypted in memory by the token store and is never put in the response.
      loadTokenMetadata(session.user.id).catch(() => []),
    ]);

    const byPlatform = new Map(metadata.map((entry) => [entry.platform, entry]));
    const merged = platforms.map((status) => {
      const meta = byPlatform.get(status.platform);
      if (!meta) return status;
      return {
        ...status,
        // Provider status checks win when they report these fields; metadata
        // fills the gaps (Facebook/Instagram status does not return a name/expiry).
        accountName: status.accountName ?? meta.accountName ?? undefined,
        expiresAt:
          typeof status.expiresAt === "number" ? status.expiresAt : meta.expiresAt ?? undefined,
        tokenExpired:
          typeof status.tokenExpired === "boolean" ? status.tokenExpired : meta.expired,
        connectedAt: meta.connectedAt,
        // A token record is written only after a completed OAuth consent and
        // is never deleted, so its existence proves a previous connection even
        // when the token is expired or revoked. Saved developer credentials
        // live in a separate table and must never be treated as history.
        previouslyConnected: true,
      };
    });

    return Response.json({ platforms: merged });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/posts/[id]/cancel/route.ts

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  canCancelScheduledPost,
  cancelScheduledPost,
  scheduledPostStatus,
} from "@/lib/backend";

export async function POST(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const { id } = await params;

    const post = (await scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id)).find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!post) throw new ApiError("That post was not found.", 404);
    if (!canCancelScheduledPost(post.status)) {
      throw new ApiError("Only scheduled or held posts can be cancelled.");
    }

    const cancelled = await cancelScheduledPost(session.user.id, id);
    return Response.json({ cancelled });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

import { z } from "zod";

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  canRescheduleScheduledPost,
  rescheduleScheduledPost,
  scheduledPostStatus,
} from "@/lib/backend";

const bodySchema = z.object({
  scheduledAt: z.string().min(1, "Choose a new date and time."),
});

export async function POST(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const { id } = await params;

    const json = await request.json().catch(() => null);
    const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(json);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      throw new ApiError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Choose a new date and time.");
    }

    const post = (await scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id)).find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!post) throw new ApiError("That post was not found.", 404);
    if (!canRescheduleScheduledPost(post.status)) {
      throw new ApiError(
        `Only scheduled or held posts can be rescheduled; this post is ${post.status}.`,
      );
    }

    const rescheduled = await rescheduleScheduledPost(session.user.id, id, parsed.data.scheduledAt);
    return Response.json({ rescheduled });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  canSafelyRetryScheduledPost,
  retryScheduledPost,
  scheduledPostStatus,
} from "@/lib/backend";

export async function POST(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const { id } = await params;

    const post = (await scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id)).find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!post) throw new ApiError("That post was not found.", 404);
    if (!canSafelyRetryScheduledPost(post.status, post.failureStage)) {
      throw new ApiError(
        "This post cannot be retried. Schedule it again from the Composer.",
      );
    }

    const retry = await retryScheduledPost(session.user.id, id);
    return Response.json({ retry });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/posts/route.ts

import path from "node:path";

import { after } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";

import { ApiError, apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  processDueJobs,
  scheduleMediaPosts,
  scheduledPostStatus,
  type NewScheduledMedia,
} from "@/lib/backend";

const platformEnum = z.enum(["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"]);

const imageTypes = new Set(["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/gif"]);
const videoTypes = new Set(["video/mp4", "video/quicktime"]);

const fallbackExtension: Record<string, string> = {
  "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
  "image/png": ".png",
  "image/gif": ".gif",
  "video/mp4": ".mp4",
  "video/quicktime": ".mov",
};

async function fileToMedia(file: File): Promise<NewScheduledMedia> {
  const contentType = file.type;
  const hasDotExtension = path.extname(file.name).toLowerCase();
  const extension = hasDotExtension || fallbackExtension[contentType] || "";

  let kind: "image" | "video";
  if (imageTypes.has(contentType)) kind = "image";
  else if (videoTypes.has(contentType)) kind = "video";
  else {
    throw new ApiError(
      `Unsupported media type "${contentType || "unknown"}". Use JPEG, PNG, GIF, MP4, or MOV.`,
    );
  }

  return {
    kind,
    bytes: Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer()),
    contentType,
    extension,
  };
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const posts = await scheduledPostStatus(session.user.id);
    return Response.json({ posts });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();

    const form = await request.formData();

    const platforms = form
      .getAll("platforms")
      .map((value) => String(value).toLowerCase());
    const parsed = z
      .object({
        platforms: z.array(platformEnum).min(1, "Select at least one platform."),
        scheduledAt: z.string().optional(),
        publishNow: z.enum(["true", "false"]).optional(),
        text: z.string().min(1, "Post text is required."),
      })
      .safeParse({
        platforms,
        scheduledAt: form.get("scheduledAt") ? String(form.get("scheduledAt")) : undefined,
        publishNow: form.get("publishNow") ? String(form.get("publishNow")) : "false",
        text: String(form.get("text") ?? ""),
      });

    if (!parsed.success) {
      throw new ApiError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid request.");
    }

    const { publishNow, text } = parsed.data;
    const files = form
      .getAll("media")
      .filter((value): value is File => value instanceof File && value.size > 0);

    const media: NewScheduledMedia[] = [];
    for (const file of files) media.push(await fileToMedia(file));

    const scheduledAt =
      publishNow === "true"
        ? new Date(Date.now() + 5_000).toISOString()
        : parsed.data.scheduledAt;

    if (!scheduledAt) throw new ApiError("Choose a schedule time.");

    let scheduled: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scheduleMediaPosts>>;
    try {
      scheduled = await scheduleMediaPosts(
        session.user.id,
        parsed.data.platforms.map((platform) => ({ platform, scheduledAt, text })),
        media,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ApiError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not schedule the post.",
      );
    }

    if (publishNow === "true") {
      after(async () => {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 6_000));
        try {
          await processDueJobs();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("[api] immediate publish failed:", error);
        }
      });
    }

    return Response.json({ scheduled }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/api/worker/run/route.ts

import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity";
import { apiErrorResponse, requireApiSession } from "@/lib/api";
import { processDueJobs } from "@/lib/backend";
import { tryAcquireWorkerSlot } from "@/lib/worker-throttle";

// Security review (Phase 3): this endpoint is available to any approved user
// because it only asks the shared worker to claim globally due jobs. It never
// returns another user's post data, and the claim query itself enforces each
// owner's account state (`social_media_account_is_active`). A short per-user
// cooldown prevents request flooding; real duplicate protection remains the
// database FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim. Every trigger is audited.
export async function POST() {
  try {
    const session = await requireApiSession();
    const slot = tryAcquireWorkerSlot(session.user.id);
    if (!slot.allowed) {
      return Response.json(
        { error: "The publishing worker was triggered moments ago. Try again shortly." },
        {
          status: 429,
          headers: { "retry-after": String(Math.ceil(slot.retryAfterMs / 1000)) },
        },
      );
    }

    let processed = 0;
    try {
      processed = await processDueJobs();
    } catch (error) {
      await logActivity({
        actorUserId: session.user.id,
        targetUserId: session.user.id,
        action: "worker_run_failed",
        resourceType: "worker",
        metadata: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown" },
      });
      throw error;
    }

    await logActivity({
      actorUserId: session.user.id,
      targetUserId: session.user.id,
      action: "worker_run_requested",
      resourceType: "worker",
      metadata: { processed },
    });
    return Response.json({ processed });
  } catch (error) {
    return apiErrorResponse(error);
  }
}

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

// Last-resort error boundary for failures in the root layout or in a layout
// that no route-level `error.tsx` can wrap (for example the dashboard layout).
// Without this file Next.js renders its built-in unstyled global error page,
// which hides the retry path and the error reference. `global-error` replaces
// the root layout, so it must provide its own document, styles, and fonts.
const styles = {
  body: {
    minHeight: "100vh",
    margin: 0,
    display: "flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    padding: "24px",
    background: "#fafafa",
    color: "#18181b",
    fontFamily:
      'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif',
  },
  card: {
    width: "100%",
    maxWidth: "32rem",
    border: "1px solid #e4e4e7",
    borderRadius: "12px",
    background: "#ffffff",
    padding: "24px",
    boxShadow: "0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)",
  },
  title: {
    display: "flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: "8px",
    margin: "0 0 8px",
    fontSize: "18px",
    fontWeight: 600,
  },
  message: {
    margin: "0 0 16px",
    fontSize: "14px",
    lineHeight: 1.5,
    color: "#52525b",
  },
  reference: {
    margin: "0 0 16px",
    fontSize: "12px",
    color: "#71717a",
  },
  code: {
    fontFamily:
      'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace',
    wordBreak: "break-all",
  },
  actions: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px" },
  button: {
    appearance: "none",
    border: "1px solid #18181b",
    borderRadius: "8px",
    background: "#18181b",
    color: "#ffffff",
    padding: "8px 16px",
    fontSize: "14px",
    fontWeight: 500,
    cursor: "pointer",
  },
  link: {
    display: "inline-flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    border: "1px solid #e4e4e7",
    borderRadius: "8px",
    padding: "8px 16px",
    fontSize: "14px",
    fontWeight: 500,
    color: "#18181b",
    textDecoration: "none",
  },
} as const;

export default function GlobalError({
  error,
  retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body style={styles.body}>
        <title>Social Console</title>
        <div style={styles.card} role="alert">
          <h1 style={styles.title}>
            <span aria-hidden style={{ color: "#dc2626" }}>
              &#9888;
            </span>
            This page couldn&apos;t load
          </h1>
          <p style={styles.message}>
            A server error interrupted loading this page. Your sign-in has not
            been changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, give the error
            reference below to an administrator.
          </p>
          {error.digest ? (
            <p style={styles.reference}>
              Error reference: <code style={styles.code}>{error.digest}</code>
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <div style={styles.actions}>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => retry()} style={styles.button}>
              Try again
            </button>
            <a href="/login" style={styles.link}>
              Back to sign in
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/app/mcp/authorize/page.tsx

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  McpOAuthError,
  getMcpClient,
  isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri,
  validateMcpAuthorizationRequest,
} from "@/lib/backend";
import { getSession } from "@/lib/session";

const oauthFields = [
  "client_id",
  "redirect_uri",
  "response_type",
  "state",
  "code_challenge",
  "code_challenge_method",
  "scope",
  "resource",
] as const;

type OAuthField = (typeof oauthFields)[number];

function single(value: string | string[] | undefined): string | undefined {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
}

function ErrorCard({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-svh flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-muted/40 p-6">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Authorization request rejected</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            This request could not be verified, so no access was granted.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{message}</p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </main>
  );
}

export default async function McpAuthorizePage({
  searchParams,
}: PageProps<"/mcp/authorize">) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const values = Object.fromEntries(
    oauthFields.map((field) => [field, single(params[field])]),
  ) as Record<OAuthField, string | undefined>;

  const session = await getSession();
  if (!session) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const field of oauthFields) {
      const value = values[field];
      if (value) query.set(field, value);
    }
    redirect(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/mcp/authorize?${query.toString()}`)}`);
  }

  const clientId = values.client_id;
  const redirectUri = values.redirect_uri;
  if (!clientId || !redirectUri) {
    return <ErrorCard message="The request is missing client_id or redirect_uri." />;
  }

  let client;
  try {
    client = await getMcpClient(clientId);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[mcp-consent] failed to load OAuth client:", error);
    return <ErrorCard message="The authorization server is temporarily unavailable." />;
  }
  if (!client) return <ErrorCard message="Unknown OAuth client." />;
  if (!isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri(client, redirectUri)) {
    return <ErrorCard message="The redirect_uri is not registered for this client." />;
  }

  const codeChallenge = values.code_challenge;
  if (!codeChallenge) {
    return <ErrorCard message="A valid PKCE code_challenge is required." />;
  }

  let scope: string;
  let resource: string;
  try {
    const validated = await validateMcpAuthorizationRequest({
      clientId,
      redirectUri,
      ...(values.response_type !== undefined ? { responseType: values.response_type } : {}),
      ...(values.scope !== undefined ? { scope: values.scope } : {}),
      ...(values.resource !== undefined ? { resource: values.resource } : {}),
      codeChallenge,
      codeChallengeMethod: values.code_challenge_method ?? "S256",
    });
    scope = validated.scope;
    resource = validated.resource;
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof McpOAuthError ? error.message : "The authorization request is invalid.";
    return <ErrorCard message={message} />;
  }

  const clientName = client.clientName ?? "Claude";
  let redirectHost = redirectUri;
  try {
    redirectHost = new URL(redirectUri).host;
  } catch {
    // isRegisteredMcpRedirectUri already parsed it; keep the raw value as a
    // defensive fallback for display only.
  }

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-svh flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-muted/40 p-6">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Connect {clientName} to Social Media</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Signed in as {session.user.email}. {clientName} is requesting access to
            your social media console.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4 text-sm">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="font-medium">Requested access</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">
              Create, schedule, publish, reschedule, retry, and cancel posts, and
              read connection status for the Instagram, Facebook Page, and LinkedIn
              accounts you have connected in this console.
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="font-medium">Scope</span>
            <code className="rounded bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs">{scope}</code>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="font-medium">Callback host</span>
            <code className="break-all rounded bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs">
              {redirectHost}
            </code>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="font-medium">MCP resource</span>
            <code className="break-all rounded bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs">
              {resource}
            </code>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            Only approve if you started this connection from {clientName}. This
            grants access to your account only; it does not share your password,
            provider tokens, or other users&apos; accounts.
          </p>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter>
          <form
            action="/api/mcp/oauth/authorize"
            method="post"
            className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row-reverse"
          >
            {oauthFields.map((field) => {
              const value = values[field];
              return value ? (
                <input key={field} type="hidden" name={field} value={value} />
              ) : null;
            })}
            <Button className="flex-1" type="submit" name="action" value="approve">
              Approve
            </Button>
            <Button
              className="flex-1"
              type="submit"

              value="deny"

FILE: social-media-web/src/components/admin/admin-pagination.tsx

"use client";

import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function AdminPagination({
  page,
  pageSize,
  total,
}: {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));

  function go(nextPage: number) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
    params.set("page", String(nextPage));
    startTransition(() => router.push(`${pathname}?${params.toString()}`));
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      <span>
        {total === 0
          ? "No results"
          : `Showing ${(page - 1) * pageSize + 1}–${Math.min(page * pageSize, total)} of ${total}`}
      </span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          disabled={pending || page <= 1}
          onClick={() => go(page - 1)}
        >
          Previous
        </Button>
        <span>
          Page {page} of {totalPages}
        </span>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          disabled={pending || page >= totalPages}
          onClick={() => go(page + 1)}
        >
          Next
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/components/admin/date-range-filter.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

function day(value: string): string {
  return value.slice(0, 10);
}

export function DateRangeFilter({
  fromIso,
  toIso,
  defaultDays,
}: {
  fromIso: string;
  toIso: string;
  defaultDays: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(day(fromIso));
  const [to, setTo] = useState(day(toIso));

  function apply(nextFrom: string, nextTo: string) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
    if (nextFrom) params.set("from", nextFrom);
    else params.delete("from");
    if (nextTo) params.set("to", nextTo);
    else params.delete("to");
    params.delete("page");
    startTransition(() => router.push(`${pathname}?${params.toString()}`));
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const defaultFrom = new Date(now.getTime() - (defaultDays - 1) * 86_400_000)
    .toISOString()
    .slice(0, 10);
  const defaultTo = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  return (
    <form
      className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-end"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        apply(from, to);
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1.5 sm:w-40">
        <Label
          htmlFor="admin-range-from"
          className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
        >
          From
        </Label>
        <Input
          id="admin-range-from"
          type="date"
          value={from}
          max={to || undefined}
          onChange={(event) => setFrom(event.target.value)}
          className="w-full"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1.5 sm:w-40">
        <Label
          htmlFor="admin-range-to"
          className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
        >
          To
        </Label>
        <Input
          id="admin-range-to"
          type="date"
          value={to}
          min={from || undefined}
          onChange={(event) => setTo(event.target.value)}
          className="w-full"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          Apply
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"
          disabled={pending}
          onClick={() => {
            setFrom(defaultFrom);
            setTo(defaultTo);
            apply(defaultFrom, defaultTo);
          }}
        >
          Last {defaultDays} days
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function isActive(href: string, pathname: string, exact: boolean): boolean {
  if (exact) return pathname === href;
  if (href === "/") return pathname === "/";
  return pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
}

export function AppSidebar({ isAdmin }: { isAdmin: boolean }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // admin navigation out of the regular-user interface.

              tooltip="Social Console"

                SC
              </div>
              <div className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 text-left text-sm leading-tight group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden">

              </div>
            </SidebarMenuButton>
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarHeader>
      <SidebarContent>
        {/* Super Admins see Administration first; regular users only ever get

        {isAdmin ? (
          <SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroupLabel>Administration</SidebarGroupLabel>
            <SidebarGroupContent>
              <SidebarMenu>
                {ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => (

        ) : null}

        <SidebarGroup>
          <SidebarGroupLabel>Workspace</SidebarGroupLabel>

              {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => (

// Shared platform identity chip. One visual for Facebook / Instagram /
// LinkedIn everywhere (admin tables, workspace lists, calendar, overview).

import { cn } from "cn";

import { PLATFORM_META } from "@/lib/platform-meta";
import type { AdminPlatform } from "@/lib/admin-policy";

export function PlatformChip({
  platform,
  showLabel = false,
  size = "sm",
  className,
}: {
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  showLabel?: boolean;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  className?: string;
}) {

  const chip = (
    <span
      aria-hidden={showLabel ? undefined : "true"}
      title={showLabel ? undefined : meta.label}
      className={cn(
        "flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-semibold lowercase ring-1",
        size === "sm" ? "size-[18px] text-[8px]" : "size-6 text-[9px]",
        meta.className,
        className,
      )}
    >
      {meta.short}
    </span>
  );

  if (!showLabel) return chip;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
      {chip}
      <span className="truncate">{meta.label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

export interface ScheduledPostSummary {
  id: string;
  platform: "facebook" | "instagram" | "linkedin";
  text: string;
  scheduledAt: string;
  status: "scheduled" | "publishing" | "published" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "held";
  publishedAt?: string;
  error?: string;
  retryCount: number;
  mediaType: "none" | "image" | "video" | "carousel" | "document";
  failureStage?: "token_validation" | "image_validation" | "document_validation" | "publishing";
}

const PLATFORM_LABELS: Record<ScheduledPostSummary["platform"], string> = {
  facebook: "Facebook",
  instagram: "Instagram",
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<ScheduledPostSummary["status"], string> = {
  scheduled: "Scheduled",
  publishing: "Publishing",
  published: "Published",
  failed: "Failed",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
  held: "Held",
};

const MEDIA_LABELS: Record<ScheduledPostSummary["mediaType"], string> = {
  none: "Text only",
  image: "Image",
  video: "Video",
  carousel: "Carousel",
  document: "Document",
};

const PLATFORM_ORDER: ScheduledPostSummary["platform"][] = [
  "facebook",
  "instagram",
  "linkedin",
];

type StatusFilter = "all" | ScheduledPostSummary["status"];
type PlatformFilter = "all" | ScheduledPostSummary["platform"];

function canRetry(post: ScheduledPostSummary): boolean {
  return (
    post.status === "failed" &&
    post.failureStage !== undefined &&
    post.failureStage !== "publishing"
  );
}

function canReschedule(post: ScheduledPostSummary): boolean {
  // Held posts can be rescheduled to a future time (which also returns them to
  // `scheduled`), matching the backend scheduler rules.
  return post.status === "scheduled" || post.status === "held";
}

function canCancel(post: ScheduledPostSummary): boolean {
  return post.status === "scheduled" || post.status === "held";
}

export function PostsList({
  statuses,
  showWorkerButton = false,
  showFilters = false,
  variant = "queue",
  emptyTitle = "No posts to show",
  emptyDescription,
}: {
  statuses: ScheduledPostSummary["status"][];
  showWorkerButton?: boolean;
  showFilters?: boolean;
  /** Selects the empty-state icon inside this client component (icons cannot
   * be passed from server pages to client components). */
  variant?: "queue" | "history";
  emptyTitle?: string;
  emptyDescription?: string;
}) {
  const EmptyIcon = variant === "history" ? History : ListChecks;
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<ScheduledPostSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rescheduling, setRescheduling] = useState<ScheduledPostSummary | null>(null);
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState<ScheduledPostSummary | null>(null);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>("all");
  const [platformFilter, setPlatformFilter] = useState<PlatformFilter>("all");

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    return fetch("/api/posts", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then(async (response) => {
        const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
          posts?: ScheduledPostSummary[];
          error?: string;
        };
        if (!response.ok) {
          setLoadError(body.error ?? "Could not load posts. Try again.");
          return;
        }
        setLoadError(null);
        setPosts(body.posts ?? []);
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        setLoadError(
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load posts. Try again.",
        );
      });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const visible = (posts ?? []).filter((post) => statuses.includes(post.status));
  const filtered = visible.filter(
    (post) =>
      (statusFilter === "all" || post.status === statusFilter) &&
      (platformFilter === "all" || post.platform === platformFilter),
  );
  const filtersActive = statusFilter !== "all" || platformFilter !== "all";

  function resetFilters() {
    setStatusFilter("all");
    setPlatformFilter("all");
  }

  async function runAction(
    id: string,
    path: string,
    successMessage: string,
  ) {
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(path, { method: "POST" });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Action failed.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success(successMessage);
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Action failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function runWorker() {
    setBusyId("worker");
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/worker/run", { method: "POST" });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        processed?: number;
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Could not check due posts.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success(
        body.processed
          ? `Published ${body.processed} due post${body.processed === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`
          : "No posts were due right now.",
      );
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not check due posts.");
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function cancelPost() {
    if (!cancelling) return;
    const post = cancelling;
    setCancelling(null);
    await runAction(post.id, `/api/posts/${post.id}/cancel`, "Post cancelled. It will not be published.");
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <CardTitle>Posts</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Live status from the publishing scheduler.</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {showWorkerButton ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={runWorker}
                disabled={busyId !== null}
              >
                {busyId === "worker" ? (
                  <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : null}
                Check due posts
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={load} disabled={busyId !== null}>
              Refresh
            </Button>
          </div>
          {showWorkerButton ? (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              The worker also runs automatically.
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {showFilters && posts !== null ? (
          <div className="mb-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <Select
                value={statusFilter}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setStatusFilter((value ?? "all") as StatusFilter)
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger
                  size="sm"
                  className="w-full sm:w-44"
                  aria-label="Filter by status"
                >
                  <SelectValue>
                    {(value) =>
                      value === "all" || value == null
                        ? "All Statuses"
                        : STATUS_LABELS[value as ScheduledPostSummary["status"]]
                    }
                  </SelectValue>
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
                  {statuses.map((status) => (
                    <SelectItem key={status} value={status}>
                      {STATUS_LABELS[status]}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>

              <Select
                value={platformFilter}
                onValueChange={(value) => setPlatformFilter((value ?? "all") as PlatformFilter)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger
                  size="sm"
                  className="w-full sm:w-40"
                  aria-label="Filter by platform"
                >
                  <SelectValue>
                    {(value) =>
                      value === "all" || value == null
                        ? "All Platforms"
                        : PLATFORM_LABELS[value as ScheduledPostSummary["platform"]]
                    }
                  </SelectValue>
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Platforms</SelectItem>
                  {PLATFORM_ORDER.map((platform) => (
                    <SelectItem key={platform} value={platform}>
                      {PLATFORM_LABELS[platform]}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Showing {filtered.length} of {visible.length}
              </span>
              {filtersActive ? (
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={resetFilters}>
                  Reset
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {loadError !== null ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={CircleAlert}
            title="Could not load posts"
            description={loadError}
            action={
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={load}>
                Try again
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : posts === null ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
          </div>
        ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={EmptyIcon}
            title={emptyTitle}
            description={
              emptyDescription ??
              "When you create a post it appears here with its current publishing status."
            }
          />
        ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={EmptyIcon}
            title="No posts match the selected filters"
            description="Try a different status or platform, or reset the filters."
            action={
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={resetFilters}>
                Reset filters
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <Table className="min-w-[640px]">
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Platform</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Post</TableHead>
                <TableHead>When</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Media</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {filtered.map((post) => (
                <TableRow key={post.id}>
                  <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap">
                    <PlatformChip platform={post.platform} showLabel />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="max-w-[24rem]">
                    <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm">
                      {post.text || "—"}
                    </span>
                    {post.error ? (
                      <span className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1 text-xs text-destructive">
                        <CircleAlert className="mt-0.5 size-3 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                        {post.error}
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-sm tabular-nums">
                    {new Date(post.publishedAt ?? post.scheduledAt).toLocaleString()}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="hidden whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                    {MEDIA_LABELS[post.mediaType]}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <PostStatusBadge status={post.status} />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                      {canRetry(post) ? (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          disabled={busyId !== null}
                          onClick={() =>
                            void runAction(
                              post.id,
                              `/api/posts/${post.id}/retry`,
                              "Retrying publishing now.",
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          Retry Publishing
                        </Button>
                      ) : null}
                      {canReschedule(post) ? (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          disabled={busyId !== null}
                          onClick={() => setRescheduling(post)}
                        >
                          Reschedule
                        </Button>
                      ) : null}
                      {canCancel(post) ? (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          disabled={busyId !== null}
                          onClick={() => setCancelling(post)}
                        >
                          Cancel
                        </Button>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      {/* Cancel is destructive: it stops a scheduled post from ever publishing. */}
      <AlertDialog
        open={cancelling !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setCancelling(null);
        }}
      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Cancel this post?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              {cancelling
                ? `The scheduled ${PLATFORM_LABELS[cancelling.platform]} post will not be published. This cannot be undone, but you can always create a new post.`
                : ""}
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={busyId !== null}>
              Keep post
            </AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              disabled={busyId !== null}
              onClick={() => void cancelPost()}
            >
              Cancel post
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>

      {rescheduling ? (
        <RescheduleDialog
          key={rescheduling.id}
          post={rescheduling}
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open) setRescheduling(null);
          }}
          onRescheduled={load}
        />
      ) : null}
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/components/reschedule-dialog.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import type { ScheduledPostSummary } from "@/components/posts-list";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

const PLATFORM_LABELS: Record<ScheduledPostSummary["platform"], string> = {
  facebook: "Facebook",
  instagram: "Instagram",
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
};

function pad(value: number): string {
  return String(value).padStart(2, "0");
}

function toLocalInputValue(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

function minLocalInputValue(): string {
  const date = new Date(Date.now() + 60_000);
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

export function RescheduleDialog({
  post,
  onOpenChange,
  onRescheduled,
}: {
  post: ScheduledPostSummary;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onRescheduled: () => void | Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [scheduledAt, setScheduledAt] = useState(() => toLocalInputValue(post.scheduledAt));
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const parsed = new Date(scheduledAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      toast.error("Choose a valid date and time.");
      return;
    }
    if (parsed.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      toast.error("The new schedule time must be in the future.");
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/posts/${post.id}/reschedule`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ scheduledAt: parsed.toISOString() }),
      });
      const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
      if (!response.ok) {
        toast.error(body.error ?? "Could not reschedule the post.");
        return;
      }
      toast.success("Post rescheduled.");
      onOpenChange(false);
      await onRescheduled();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not reschedule the post.",
      );
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Reschedule post</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Update when this {PLATFORM_LABELS[post.platform]} post is published.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form className="flex flex-col gap-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Platform</span>
              <Badge variant="secondary">{PLATFORM_LABELS[post.platform]}</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Caption</span>
              <span className="line-clamp-3">{post.text || "—"}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Currently scheduled</span>
              <span>{new Date(post.scheduledAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Only the {PLATFORM_LABELS[post.platform]} scheduled post is updated. Other platforms
            keep their current schedule.
          </p>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Label htmlFor="reschedule-at">New date and time</Label>
            <Input
              id="reschedule-at"
              type="datetime-local"
              value={scheduledAt}
              min={minLocalInputValue()}
              onChange={(event) => setScheduledAt(event.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || !scheduledAt}>
              {pending ? "Saving..." : "Save Changes"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import { CircleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";

// Shown when the dashboard layout cannot verify the session because the
// database/authentication service is unreachable. This is deliberately not a
// redirect to /login: an outage must never look like a signed-out user.
export function SessionUnavailable() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-6">
      {/* w-full keeps the card a consistent, comfortable width: as a flex
          item it would otherwise shrink-wrap to its (narrow) content. */}
      <Card className="w-full max-w-xl">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CircleAlert className="text-destructive size-5" aria-hidden />
            Can&apos;t verify your session
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            We couldn&apos;t reach the authentication service to confirm your
            sign-in. This is usually a temporary database problem, so your session
            has not been signed out. Try again in a moment.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Button
            onClick={() => startTransition(() => router.refresh())}
            disabled={pending}
          >
            {pending ? "Retrying..." : "Try again"}
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

export function SignOutButton() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function onSignOut() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      await authClient.signOut();
      router.replace("/login");
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onSignOut} disabled={pending}>
      {pending ? "Signing out..." : "Sign out"}
    </Button>
  );
}

// Shared post status badge for both the admin panel and the user workspace.
// Distinct, low-saturation colours keep every status readable at a glance
// without competing with the primary action colours in the tables.
// (src/components/admin/status-badge.tsx re-exports from here so existing
// admin imports keep working with a single implementation.)

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import type { AdminPostStatus, SocialAccountStatus } from "@/lib/admin-policy";

const POST_LABELS: Record<AdminPostStatus, string> = {
  scheduled: "Scheduled",
  publishing: "Publishing",
  published: "Published",
  failed: "Failed",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
  held: "Held",
};

const POST_CLASSES: Record<AdminPostStatus, string> = {
  scheduled:
    "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:border-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-300",
  publishing:
    "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300",
  published:

    >
      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-current"
      />
      {POST_LABELS[status]}
    </Badge>
  );
}

const SOCIAL_LABELS: Record<SocialAccountStatus, string> = {
  connected: "Connected",
  expired: "Expired",
  error: "Error",
  disconnected: "Disconnected",
};

// Semantic tint per connection state: green is healthy, amber needs
// reconnection, red is a live error, neutral is simply not connected.
const SOCIAL_CLASSES: Record<SocialAccountStatus, string> = {
  connected:
    "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300",
  expired:
    "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300",
  error:
    "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300",
  disconnected:
    "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/60 dark:text-slate-300",
};

export function SocialStatusBadge({ status }: { status: SocialAccountStatus }) {
  return (
    <Badge
      variant="outline"
      className={`px-1.5 text-[11px] ${SOCIAL_CLASSES[status]}`}
    >
      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-current"
      />
      {SOCIAL_LABELS[status]}
    </Badge>
  );
}

const USER_STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  approved: "Active",
  pending: "Pending",
  rejected: "Inactive",
  suspended: "Inactive",
  deleted: "Inactive",
};

export function UserStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label = USER_STATUS_LABELS[status] ?? status;
  if (status === "approved" || status === "connected") {
    return <Badge variant="secondary">{label}</Badge>;
  }
  if (status === "rejected" || status === "suspended" || status === "deleted") {
    return <Badge variant="destructive">{label}</Badge>;
  }
  return <Badge variant="outline">{label}</Badge>;
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/alert-dialog"
import { cn } from "cn"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

function AlertDialog({ ...props }: AlertDialogPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="alert-dialog" {...props} />
}

function AlertDialogTrigger({ ...props }: AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger.Props) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger" {...props} />
  )
}

function AlertDialogPortal({ ...props }: AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal.Props) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="alert-dialog-portal" {...props} />
  )
}

function AlertDialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: AlertDialogPrimitive.Backdrop.Props) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Backdrop
      data-slot="alert-dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 isolate z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogContent({
  className,
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: AlertDialogPrimitive.Popup.Props & {
  size?: "default" | "sm"
}) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPortal>
      <AlertDialogOverlay />
      <AlertDialogPrimitive.Popup
        data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
        data-size={size}
        className={cn(
          "group/alert-dialog-content fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none data-[size=default]:max-w-xs data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs data-[size=default]:sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </AlertDialogPortal>
  )
}

function AlertDialogHeader({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-header"
      className={cn(

import { mergeProps } from "@base-ui/react/merge-props"
import { useRender } from "@base-ui/react/use-render"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "cn"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  render,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"span"> & VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>) {
  return useRender({
    defaultTagName: "span",
    props: mergeProps<"span">(
      {
        className: cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className),
      },
      props
    ),
    render,
    state: {
      slot: "badge",
      variant,
    },
  })
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants }

function Breadcrumb({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"nav">) {

      className={cn(className)}
      {...props}

      data-slot="breadcrumb-list"

      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )

      {...props}
    />
  )
}

  className,
  render,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"a">) {

function CalendarDayButton({
  className,
  day,
  modifiers,
  locale,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DayButton> & { locale?: Partial<Locale> }) {
  const defaultClassNames = getDefaultClassNames()

  const ref = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (modifiers.focused) ref.current?.focus()
  }, [modifiers.focused])

  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      data-day={day.date.toLocaleDateString(locale?.code)}
      data-selected-single={
        modifiers.selected &&
        !modifiers.range_start &&
        !modifiers.range_end &&
        !modifiers.range_middle
      }
      data-range-start={modifiers.range_start}
      data-range-end={modifiers.range_end}
      data-range-middle={modifiers.range_middle}
      className={cn(
        "relative isolate z-10 flex aspect-square size-auto w-full min-w-(--cell-size) flex-col gap-1 border-0 leading-none font-normal group-data-[focused=true]/day:relative group-data-[focused=true]/day:z-10 group-data-[focused=true]/day:border-ring group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-[3px] group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-ring/50 data-[range-end=true]:rounded-(--cell-radius) data-[range-end=true]:rounded-r-(--cell-radius) data-[range-end=true]:bg-primary data-[range-end=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[range-middle=true]:rounded-none data-[range-middle=true]:bg-muted data-[range-middle=true]:text-foreground data-[range-start=true]:rounded-(--cell-radius) data-[range-start=true]:rounded-l-(--cell-radius) data-[range-start=true]:bg-primary data-[range-start=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[selected-single=true]:bg-primary data-[selected-single=true]:text-primary-foreground dark:hover:text-foreground [&>span]:text-xs [&>span]:opacity-70",
        defaultClassNames.day,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/dialog"
import { cn } from "cn"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Dialog({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />
}

function DialogTrigger({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Trigger.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...props} />
}

function DialogPortal({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Portal.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function DialogClose({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Close.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" {...props} />
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Backdrop.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Backdrop
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 isolate z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Popup.Props & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal>
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Popup
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            render={
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                className="absolute top-2 right-2"
                size="icon-sm"
              />
            }
          >
            <XIcon
            />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Popup>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "-mx-4 -mb-4 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
          Close
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Title.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-none font-medium",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Description.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-sm text-muted-foreground *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}
