FILE: social-media-web/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx
================================================================================

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { mergeProps } from "@base-ui/react/merge-props"
import { useRender } from "@base-ui/react/use-render"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "cn"

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"
import { PanelLeftIcon } from "lucide-react"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

type SidebarContextProps = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  open: boolean
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  openMobile: boolean
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  isMobile: boolean
  toggleSidebar: () => void
}

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContextProps | null>(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  const open = openProp ?? _open
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState)
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState)
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  )

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      isMobile,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
  )

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
        style={
          {
            "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
            "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
            ...style,
          } as React.CSSProperties
        }
        className={cn(
          "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  )
}

function Sidebar({
  side = "left",
  variant = "sidebar",
  collapsible = "offcanvas",
  className,
  children,
  dir,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  side?: "left" | "right"
  variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
  collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
}) {
  const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

  if (collapsible === "none") {
    return (
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar"
        className={cn(
          "flex h-full w-(--sidebar-width) flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
        <SheetContent
          dir={dir}
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar"
          data-mobile="true"
          className="w-(--sidebar-width) bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:hidden"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          side={side}
        >
          <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
            <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
            <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
          </SheetHeader>
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="group peer hidden text-sidebar-foreground md:block"
      data-state={state}
      data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-side={side}
      data-slot="sidebar"
    >
      {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-gap"
        className={cn(
          "relative w-(--sidebar-width) bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
          "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
          "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4)))]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)"
        )}
      />
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-container"
        data-side={side}
        className={cn(
          "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-(--sidebar-width) transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear data-[side=left]:left-0 data-[side=left]:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)] data-[side=right]:right-0 data-[side=right]:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)] md:flex",
          // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4))+2px)]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon) group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar-inner"
          className="flex size-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow-sm group-data-[variant=floating]:ring-1 group-data-[variant=floating]:ring-sidebar-border"
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function SidebarTrigger({
  className,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <Button
      data-sidebar="trigger"
      data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon-sm"
      className={cn(className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event)
        toggleSidebar()
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeftIcon />
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle Sidebar</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

function SidebarRail({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"button">) {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <button
      data-sidebar="rail"
      data-slot="sidebar-rail"
      aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
      tabIndex={-1}
      onClick={toggleSidebar}
      title="Toggle Sidebar"
      className={cn(
        "absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 transition-all ease-linear group-data-[side=left]:-right-4 group-data-[side=right]:left-0 after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:start-1/2 after:w-[2px] hover:after:bg-sidebar-border sm:flex ltr:-translate-x-1/2 rtl:-translate-x-1/2",

const sidebarMenuButtonVariants = cva(
  "peer/menu-button group/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md p-2 text-left text-sm ring-sidebar-ring outline-hidden transition-[width,height,padding] group-has-data-[sidebar=menu-action]/menu-item:pr-8 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:size-8! group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-2! hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-sidebar-accent active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 data-open:hover:bg-sidebar-accent data-open:hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-active:bg-sidebar-accent data-active:font-medium data-active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&>span:last-child]:truncate",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        outline:
          "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--sidebar-border)] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--sidebar-accent)]",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-8 text-sm",
        sm: "h-7 text-xs",
        lg: "h-12 text-sm group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-0!",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function SidebarMenuButton({
  render,
  isActive = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  tooltip,
  className,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
    isActive?: boolean
    tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
  } & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
  const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()
  const comp = useRender({
    defaultTagName: "button",
    props: mergeProps<"button">(
      {
        className: cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className),
      },
      props
    ),
    render: !tooltip ? render : <TooltipTrigger render={render} />,
    state: {
      slot: "sidebar-menu-button",
      sidebar: "menu-button",
      size,
      active: isActive,
    },
  })

  if (!tooltip) {
    return comp
  }

  if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
    tooltip = {
      children: tooltip,
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tooltip disabled={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}>
      {comp}
      <TooltipContent
        side="right"
        align="center"
        {...tooltip}
      />
    </Tooltip>
  )
}

function SidebarMenuAction({
  className,
  render,
  showOnHover = false,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
    showOnHover?: boolean
  }) {
  return useRender({
    defaultTagName: "button",
    props: mergeProps<"button">(
      {
        className: cn(
          "absolute top-1.5 right-1 flex aspect-square w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-0 text-sidebar-foreground ring-sidebar-ring outline-hidden transition-transform group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden peer-hover/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground peer-data-[size=default]/menu-button:top-1.5 peer-data-[size=lg]/menu-button:top-2.5 peer-data-[size=sm]/menu-button:top-1 after:absolute after:-inset-2 hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 md:after:hidden [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
          showOnHover &&
            "group-focus-within/menu-item:opacity-100 group-hover/menu-item:opacity-100 peer-data-active/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground aria-expanded:opacity-100 md:opacity-0",
          className
        ),
      },
      props
    ),
    render,
    state: {
      slot: "sidebar-menu-action",
      sidebar: "menu-action",
    },
  })
}

function SidebarMenuSkeleton({
  className,
  showIcon = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showIcon?: boolean
}) {
  // Random width between 50 to 90%.
  const [width] = React.useState(() => {
    return `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 50}%`
  })

  return (
    <div
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-skeleton"
      data-sidebar="menu-skeleton"
      className={cn("flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {showIcon && (
        <Skeleton
          className="size-4 rounded-md"
          data-sidebar="menu-skeleton-icon"
        />
      )}
      <Skeleton
        className="h-4 max-w-(--skeleton-width) flex-1"
        data-sidebar="menu-skeleton-text"
        style={
          {
            "--skeleton-width": width,
          } as React.CSSProperties
        }
      />
    </div>
  )
}

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768
const QUERY = `(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`

function subscribe(callback: () => void) {
  const mql = window.matchMedia(QUERY)
  mql.addEventListener("change", callback)
  return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", callback)
}

function getSnapshot() {
  return window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT
}

function getServerSnapshot() {
  return false
}

export function useIsMobile() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot)
}

// Pure connection-state derivation shared by the Accounts UI and its tests.
// The card border is driven only by the live OAuth connection status, never by
// whether developer app credentials have been saved.

export interface PlatformConnectionLike {
  connected?: boolean;
  tokenExpired?: boolean;
}

export type AccountConnectionState = "connected" | "expired" | "disconnected";

export function accountConnectionState(
  status?: PlatformConnectionLike | null,
): AccountConnectionState {
  if (!status?.connected) return "disconnected";
  if (status.tokenExpired) return "expired";
  return "connected";
}

export type ConnectionAction = "connect" | "reconnect";

// Truth table for the Accounts card action button:
// - "connected"          -> Reconnect (management action on a live connection)
// - previously connected -> Reconnect (expired, revoked, or disconnected
//                            token record still proves an earlier consent)
// - never connected      -> Connect (also when developer app credentials are
//                            saved: credentials are not connection history)
export function connectionAction(
  state: AccountConnectionState,
  previouslyConnected?: boolean,
): ConnectionAction {
  if (state === "connected" || previouslyConnected === true) return "reconnect";
  return "connect";
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/lib/activity.ts

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";

// Accepts either the main db handle or a Drizzle transaction client passed
// from callers that must log inside the same commit as the action itself.
export type ActivityLogClient
  = typeof db
    | Parameters<Parameters<(typeof db)["transaction"]>[0]>[0];

export interface ActivityLogEntry {
  /** Who performed the action (admin user id, or the user themself). */
  actorUserId?: string | undefined;
  /** Whose application data was affected, when the actor is an admin. */
  targetUserId?: string | undefined;
  action: string;
  resourceType: string;
  resourceId?: string | undefined;
  /** Non-sensitive context only. Never passwords, tokens, secrets, or keys. */
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
}

// Defense-in-depth for activity logging: every caller passes non-sensitive
// metadata, but a stray credential-bearing object must never reach the log.
const FORBIDDEN_META_KEYS
  = /^(passw(or)?d|token|access_?token|refresh_?token|secret|client_?secret|encryption_?key|api_?key|authorization)$/i;

export function sanitizeActivityMetadata(value: unknown, depth = 0): unknown {
  if (depth > 4) return "[truncated]";
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.slice(0, 20).map((item) => sanitizeActivityMetadata(item, depth + 1));
  }
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    const output: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (FORBIDDEN_META_KEYS.test(key)) continue;
      output[key] = sanitizeActivityMetadata(item, depth + 1);
    }
    return output;
  }
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.length > 2000) return value.slice(0, 2000);
  return value;
}

// Best-effort audit write. The optional `client` parameter accepts a Drizzle
// transaction so critical admin operations can log inside the same commit.
// Activity logging never throws and never aborts the operation it describes;
// failures are reported to the server logs only.
export async function logActivity(
  entry: ActivityLogEntry,
  client: ActivityLogClient = db,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await client.insert(activityLog).values({
      actorUserId: entry.actorUserId ?? null,
      targetUserId: entry.targetUserId ?? null,
      action: entry.action,
      resourceType: entry.resourceType,
      resourceId: entry.resourceId ?? null,
      // Pass the object through: the column is jsonb, so Drizzle serialises it
      // exactly once. Pre-stringifying would store a JSON string literal.
      metadata: sanitizeActivityMetadata(entry.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[activity] failed to write activity log entry:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/lib/admin-accounts.ts

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity";
import {
  ACCOUNT_ACTIONS,
  type AccountAction,
  validateAccountAction,
} from "@/lib/admin-policy";
import {
  getUserDetail as getAdminUserDetail,
  type AdminUserDetail,
} from "@/lib/admin-users";
import {
  listUserScheduledPosts,
  type AdminUserPost,
} from "@/lib/admin-scheduler";
import {
  listUserSocialAccounts,
  type AdminSocialConnectionRow,
} from "@/lib/admin-social-accounts";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  holdScheduledPostsForUser,
  resumeScheduledPostsForUser,
} from "@/lib/backend";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { session, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export interface AccountActionResult {
  id: string;
  action: AccountAction;
  banned: boolean;
  deletedAt: string | null;
  sessionsRevoked: number;
  postsHeld: number;
  postsResumed: number;
  postsStillHeld: number;
}

const ACTION_LABELS: Record<AccountAction, string> = {
  suspend: "user_suspended",
  reactivate: "user_reactivated",
  soft_delete: "user_soft_deleted",
  restore: "user_restored",
  revoke_sessions: "user_sessions_revoked",
};

function cleanReason(reason: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const trimmed = reason?.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed.slice(0, 300) : undefined;
}

/**
 * Account lifecycle change for the Super Admin.
 *
 * The user row update, session revocation, and audit entry commit in one
 * database transaction. Post hold/resume runs immediately afterwards through
 * the scheduler module; if it fails, logging only reports the partial state and
 * the database-level `social_media_account_is_active` guard still prevents any
 * suspended/deleted account from being claimed by the worker.
 */
export async function performAccountAction(
  actorId: string,
  targetId: string,
  action: AccountAction,
  reason?: string,
): Promise<AccountActionResult> {
  if (!(ACCOUNT_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(action)) {
    throw new ApiError("Unknown account action.", 400);
  }

  const cleanedReason = cleanReason(reason);
  let sessionsRevoked = 0;
  let previous: { banned: boolean; deletedAt: Date | null; approvalStatus: string } | undefined;

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx
      .select({
        id: user.id,
        role: user.role,
        approvalStatus: user.approvalStatus,
        banned: user.banned,
        deletedAt: user.deletedAt,
      })
      .from(user)
      .where(eq(user.id, targetId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!row) throw new ApiError("User not found.", 404);
    const violation = validateAccountAction({ action, actorId, target: row });
    if (violation) throw new ApiError(violation.message, violation.status);
    previous = {
      banned: row.banned,
      deletedAt: row.deletedAt,
      approvalStatus: row.approvalStatus,
    };

    const patch: Partial<typeof user.$inferInsert> = { updatedAt: new Date() };
    if (action === "suspend") {
      patch.banned = true;
      patch.banReason = cleanedReason ?? "Suspended by the administrator.";
      patch.banExpires = null;
    } else if (action === "reactivate") {
      patch.banned = false;
      patch.banReason = null;
      patch.banExpires = null;
    } else if (action === "soft_delete") {
      patch.deletedAt = new Date();
    } else if (action === "restore") {
      patch.deletedAt = null;
    }

    if (action !== "revoke_sessions") {
      await tx.update(user).set(patch).where(eq(user.id, targetId));
    }

    if (action === "suspend" || action === "soft_delete" || action === "revoke_sessions") {
      const revoked = await tx
        .delete(session)
        .where(eq(session.userId, targetId))
        .returning({ id: session.id });
      sessionsRevoked = revoked.length;
    }

    await logActivity(
      {
        actorUserId: actorId,
        targetUserId: targetId,
        action: ACTION_LABELS[action],
        resourceType: "user",
        resourceId: targetId,
        metadata: {
          reason: cleanedReason,
          previousBanned: row.banned,
          previousDeletedAt: row.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          previousApprovalStatus: row.approvalStatus,
          sessionsRevoked,
        },
      },
      tx,
    );
  });

  let postsHeld = 0;
  let postsResumed = 0;
  let postsStillHeld = 0;
  try {
    if (action === "suspend" || action === "soft_delete") {
      const held = await holdScheduledPostsForUser(targetId, {
        actorUserId: actorId,
        reason: cleanedReason
          ?? (action === "suspend"
            ? "Held: the account was suspended by the administrator."
            : "Held: the account was deleted by the administrator."),
      });
      postsHeld = held.length;
    } else if (action === "reactivate" || action === "restore") {
      const canPublish = previous?.approvalStatus === "approved" && !previous.banned;
      if (canPublish) {
        const resumed = await resumeScheduledPostsForUser(targetId, undefined, {
          actorUserId: actorId,
        });
        postsResumed = resumed.resumed.length;
        postsStillHeld = resumed.stillHeld.length;
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "[admin] account action succeeded but post hold/resume failed:",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : error,
    );
  }

  return {
    id: targetId,
    action,
    banned: action === "suspend"
      ? true
      : action === "reactivate"
        ? false
        : previous?.banned ?? false,
    deletedAt: action === "soft_delete"
      ? new Date().toISOString()
      : action === "restore"
        ? null
        : previous?.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    sessionsRevoked,
    postsHeld,
    postsResumed,
    postsStillHeld,
  };
}

export interface AdminUserContext {
  detail: AdminUserDetail;
  connections: AdminSocialConnectionRow[];
  posts: AdminUserPost[];
}

export async function getAdminUserContext(
  id: string,
): Promise<AdminUserContext | null> {
  const detail = await getAdminUserDetail(id);
  if (!detail) return null;
  const [connections, posts] = await Promise.all([
    listUserSocialAccounts(id),
    listUserScheduledPosts(id),
  ]);
  return { detail, connections, posts };
}

// Pure Super Admin overview statistics policy. Kept free of database imports so
// the counting rules can be unit-tested without a connection, matching the
// existing `admin-users-policy.ts` / `admin-policy.ts` pattern.

import { classifyUserStatus } from "@/lib/admin-user-status";

/**
 * User statistics shown on the Admin Overview.
 *
 * `approval_status` is the registration lifecycle: every signup starts as
 * `pending`, and the administrator moves the account to `approved` or
 * `rejected`. Suspension (`banned`) and soft deletion (`deleted_at`) are
 * separate lifecycle flags, not approval states. `classifyUserStatus` collapses
 * all of that into the three console-facing buckets so an account is counted
 * exactly once.
 */
export interface AdminUserStats {
  total: number;
  pending: number;
  active: number;
  inactive: number;
}

export interface UserStatsRow {
  approvalStatus: string;
  banned: boolean;
  deleted: boolean;
  total: number;
}

/**
 * Pure aggregation over grouped user rows.
 *
 * Every row contributes to `total` and to exactly one of `pending`, `active`,
 * or `inactive`. The classification rule is shared with the Users directory
 * filters through `classifyUserStatus` / `userStatusCondition`, so the cards and
 * the filtered lists can never disagree.
 */
export function summarizeUserStats(rows: UserStatsRow[]): AdminUserStats {
  const summary: AdminUserStats = {
    total: 0,
    pending: 0,
    active: 0,
    inactive: 0,
  };

  for (const row of rows) {
    summary.total += row.total;
    summary[classifyUserStatus(row)] += row.total;
  }

  return summary;
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/lib/admin-overview.ts

import { count, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { nonAdminCondition } from "@/lib/admin-user-filters";
import {
  summarizeUserStats,
  type AdminUserStats,
} from "@/lib/admin-overview-policy";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export type { AdminUserStats } from "@/lib/admin-overview-policy";

/**
 * Count normal users with one grouped aggregate query. Grouping by approval
 * status, the banned flag, and the deleted-at boolean yields at most twelve
 * rows regardless of the user-table size; no user records are loaded into
 * application memory.
 *
 * Super Admin rows (`role = 'admin'`) are excluded before grouping so they can
 * never inflate any of the four statistics, regardless of approval status.
 */
export async function getAdminUserStats(): Promise<AdminUserStats> {
  const deleted = sql<boolean>`${user.deletedAt} is not null`;

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      approvalStatus: user.approvalStatus,
      banned: user.banned,
      deleted,
      total: count(),
    })
    .from(user)
    .where(nonAdminCondition())
    .groupBy(user.approvalStatus, user.banned, deleted);

  return summarizeUserStats(
    rows.map((row) => ({
      approvalStatus: row.approvalStatus,
      banned: row.banned,
      deleted: row.deleted,
      total: Number(row.total),
    })),
  );
}

// Pure Phase 3 administration policy: pagination/date parsing, list filters,
// and the account-lifecycle guard. Kept free of database imports so it can be
// unit-tested without a connection and reused by API routes and server pages.

export const PLATFORMS = ["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"] as const;
export type AdminPlatform = (typeof PLATFORMS)[number];

export const ADMIN_POST_STATUSES = [
  "scheduled",
  "publishing",
  "published",
  "failed",
  "cancelled",
  "held",
] as const;
export type AdminPostStatus = (typeof ADMIN_POST_STATUSES)[number];

export const SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_STATUSES = [
  "connected",
  "expired",
  "error",
  "disconnected",
] as const;
export type SocialAccountStatus = (typeof SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_STATUSES)[number];

export const ACCOUNT_ACTIONS = [
  "suspend",
  "reactivate",
  "soft_delete",
  "restore",
  "revoke_sessions",
] as const;
export type AccountAction = (typeof ACCOUNT_ACTIONS)[number];

export type FilterAll<T extends string> = T | "all";

export interface Pagination {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  offset: number;
}

export interface DateRange {
  /** Inclusive lower bound (start of day when a date-only value is supplied). */
  from: Date;
  /** Inclusive upper bound (end of day when a date-only value is supplied). */
  to: Date;
  days: number;
  fromIso: string;
  toIso: string;
}

export interface PostFilters extends Pagination {
  query: string;
  status: FilterAll<AdminPostStatus>;
  platform: FilterAll<AdminPlatform>;
  range: DateRange;
}

export interface SocialAccountFilters extends Pagination {
  query: string;
  platform: FilterAll<AdminPlatform>;
  status: FilterAll<SocialAccountStatus>;
}

export interface AccountTarget {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  approvalStatus: string;
  banned: boolean;
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface PolicyViolation {
  message: string;
  status: number;
}

const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function readParam(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
  key: string,
): string {
  if (!input) return "";
  if (typeof (input as URLSearchParams).get === "function") {
    return (input as URLSearchParams).get(key) ?? "";
  }
  const value = (input as Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>)[key];
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value[0] ?? "";
  return value ?? "";
}

function positiveInteger(value: string, fallback: number): number {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) return fallback;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
}

/** Normalise page/pageSize and cap the page size. */
export function parsePagination(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
  options: { defaultPageSize?: number; maxPageSize?: number } = {},
): Pagination {
  const defaultPageSize = options.defaultPageSize ?? 25;
  const maxPageSize = options.maxPageSize ?? 100;
  const page = positiveInteger(readParam(input, "page"), 1);
  const pageSize = Math.min(
    positiveInteger(readParam(input, "pageSize"), defaultPageSize),
    maxPageSize,
  );
  return { page, pageSize, offset: (page - 1) * pageSize };
}

function parseBoundary(value: string, endOfDay: boolean): Date | null {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  const dateOnly = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(trimmed);
  const date = new Date(dateOnly ? `${trimmed}T00:00:00.000Z` : trimmed);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
  if (dateOnly && endOfDay) date.setUTCHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  return date;
}

/**
 * Parse an inclusive `from`/`to` range. Missing values default to the last
 * `defaultDays` days. Ranges are clamped to `maxDays` and to a sane order so a
 * malicious query string cannot request an unbounded scan.
 */
export function parseDateRange(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
  options: { defaultDays?: number; maxDays?: number; now?: number } = {},
): DateRange {
  const defaultDays = options.defaultDays ?? 30;
  const maxDays = options.maxDays ?? 366;
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now();
  const nowDate = new Date(now);

  const parsedFrom = parseBoundary(readParam(input, "from"), false);
  const parsedTo = parseBoundary(readParam(input, "to"), true);

  let to = parsedTo ?? nowDate;
  if (to.getTime() > now) to = nowDate;
  let from = parsedFrom ?? new Date(to.getTime() - (defaultDays - 1) * DAY_MS);
  from.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  if (from.getTime() > to.getTime()) {
    const swap = new Date(from);
    from = new Date(to);
    from.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    to = swap;
  }

  const spanDays = Math.floor((to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / DAY_MS) + 1;
  if (spanDays > maxDays) {
    from = new Date(to.getTime() - (maxDays - 1) * DAY_MS);
    from.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  }

  const days = Math.max(1, Math.floor((to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / DAY_MS) + 1);
  return {
    from,
    to,
    days,
    fromIso: from.toISOString(),
    toIso: to.toISOString(),
  };
}

export function parsePostFilters(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
): PostFilters {
  const statusRaw = readParam(input, "status").trim().toLowerCase();
  const platformRaw = readParam(input, "platform").trim().toLowerCase();
  return {
    ...parsePagination(input),
    query: readParam(input, "q").trim().slice(0, MAX_QUERY_LENGTH),
    status: (ADMIN_POST_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(statusRaw)
      ? (statusRaw as AdminPostStatus)
      : "all",
    platform: (PLATFORMS as readonly string[]).includes(platformRaw)
      ? (platformRaw as AdminPlatform)
      : "all",
    range: parseDateRange(input, { defaultDays: 30, maxDays: 366 }),
  };
}

export function parseSocialAccountFilters(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
): SocialAccountFilters {
  const platformRaw = readParam(input, "platform").trim().toLowerCase();
  const statusRaw = readParam(input, "status").trim().toLowerCase();
  return {
    ...parsePagination(input, { defaultPageSize: 50 }),
    query: readParam(input, "q").trim().slice(0, MAX_QUERY_LENGTH),
    platform: (PLATFORMS as readonly string[]).includes(platformRaw)
      ? (platformRaw as AdminPlatform)
      : "all",
    status: (SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(statusRaw)
      ? (statusRaw as SocialAccountStatus)
      : "all",
  };
}

/**
 * Server-side guard for every account-lifecycle action. `actorId` always comes
 * from the verified admin session.
 *
 * The rules are deliberately conservative:
 *  - the acting Super Admin can never suspend, delete, or revoke their own
 *    sessions (no self-lockout);
 *  - the single Super Admin account can never be suspended or deleted by any
 *    actor;
 *  - lifecycle actions are idempotent errors rather than silent no-ops.
 */
export function validateAccountAction(params: {
  action: AccountAction;
  actorId: string;
  target: AccountTarget;
}): PolicyViolation | null {
  const { action, actorId, target } = params;

  if (!(ACCOUNT_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(action)) {
    return { message: "Unknown account action.", status: 400 };
  }

  if (target.id === actorId) {
    if (action === "suspend" || action === "soft_delete") {
      return {
        message: "You cannot suspend or delete your own account.",
        status: 409,
      };
    }
    if (action === "revoke_sessions") {
      return {
        message: "You cannot revoke your own sessions from the admin console.",
        status: 409,
      };
    }
  }

  if (target.role === "admin" && (action === "suspend" || action === "soft_delete")) {
    return {
      message: "The Super Admin account cannot be suspended or deleted.",
      status: 409,
    };
  }

  if (action === "suspend") {
    if (target.deletedAt) {
      return { message: "Restore this account before suspending it.", status: 409 };
    }
    if (target.banned) return { message: "This account is already suspended.", status: 409 };
  }

  if (action === "reactivate") {
    if (target.deletedAt) {
      return { message: "Restore this account before reactivating it.", status: 409 };
    }
    if (!target.banned) return { message: "This account is not suspended.", status: 409 };
  }

  if (action === "soft_delete") {
    if (target.deletedAt) return { message: "This account is already deleted.", status: 409 };
  }

  if (action === "restore") {
    if (!target.deletedAt) return { message: "This account is not deleted.", status: 409 };
  }

  if (action === "revoke_sessions" && target.deletedAt) {
    return { message: "This account is deleted and has no active access.", status: 409 };
  }

  return null;
}

import { asc, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

import {
  ADMIN_POST_STATUSES,
  type AdminPlatform,
  type AdminPostStatus,
  type PostFilters,
} from "@/lib/admin-policy";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  holdScheduledPostForUser,
  resumeScheduledPostsForUser,
} from "@/lib/backend";
import { db, pool } from "@/lib/db";
import { user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export interface AdminScheduledPost {
  id: string;
  ownerId: string;
  ownerName: string;
  ownerEmail: string;
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  scheduledAt: string;
  status: AdminPostStatus;
  /** Short, single-purpose preview for the table. */
  textPreview: string;
  /** Full post text, used by the admin details dialog. */
  text: string;
  mediaType: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  publishedAt: string | null;
  publishedUrl: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  retryCount: number;
  failureStage: string | null;
}

export interface AdminSchedulerResult {
  posts: AdminScheduledPost[];
  counts: Record<AdminPostStatus, number>;
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  range: { fromIso: string; toIso: string; days: number };
}

interface PostRow {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  scheduled_at: Date;
  text: string;
  status: AdminPostStatus;
  media_type: string | null;
  created_at: Date;
  published_at: Date | null;
  result: { url?: string } | null;
  error: string | null;
  retry_count: number;
  failure_stage: string | null;
}

function escapeLike(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (character) => `\\${character}`);
}

function emptyCounts(): Record<AdminPostStatus, number> {
  return {
    scheduled: 0,
    publishing: 0,
    published: 0,
    failed: 0,
    cancelled: 0,
    held: 0,
  };
}

export async function listScheduledPosts(
  filters: PostFilters,
): Promise<AdminSchedulerResult> {
  // No scheduler tables (stdio-only install): return an empty, well-formed page
  // rather than breaking the admin navigation.
  try {
    const queryPattern = filters.query ? `%${escapeLike(filters.query)}%` : null;
    const status = filters.status === "all" ? null : filters.status;
    const platform = filters.platform === "all" ? null : filters.platform;

    const countsResult = await pool.query<{ status: AdminPostStatus; total: string }>(
      `SELECT post.status, COUNT(*)::text AS total
         FROM public.scheduled_posts AS post
         LEFT JOIN "user" AS owner ON owner.id = post.user_id
        WHERE post.scheduled_at >= $1 AND post.scheduled_at <= $2
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR post.platform = $3)
          AND ($4::text IS NULL OR post.text ILIKE $4 OR owner.name ILIKE $4 OR owner.email ILIKE $4)
        GROUP BY post.status`,
      [filters.range.from, filters.range.to, platform, queryPattern],
    );

    const counts = emptyCounts();
    for (const row of countsResult.rows) {
      if (row.status in counts) counts[row.status] = Number(row.total);
    }

    const total = status === null
      ? Object.values(counts).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)
      : counts[status];

    const { rows } = await pool.query<PostRow>(
      `SELECT post.id, post.user_id, post.platform, post.scheduled_at, post.text,
              post.status, post.media_type, post.created_at, post.published_at,
              post.result, post.error, post.retry_count, post.failure_stage
         FROM public.scheduled_posts AS post
         LEFT JOIN "user" AS owner ON owner.id = post.user_id
        WHERE post.scheduled_at >= $1 AND post.scheduled_at <= $2
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR post.status = $3)
          AND ($4::text IS NULL OR post.platform = $4)
          AND ($5::text IS NULL OR post.text ILIKE $5 OR owner.name ILIKE $5 OR owner.email ILIKE $5)
        ORDER BY post.scheduled_at DESC, post.created_at DESC
        LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7`,
      [
        filters.range.from,
        filters.range.to,
        status,
        platform,
        queryPattern,
        filters.pageSize,
        filters.offset,
      ],
    );

    const ownerIds = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.user_id))];
    const owners = ownerIds.length
      ? await db
        .select({ id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email })
        .from(user)
        .where(inArray(user.id, ownerIds))
        .orderBy(asc(user.email))
      : [];
    const ownersById = new Map(owners.map((owner) => [owner.id, owner]));

    return {
      posts: rows.map((row) => {
        const owner = ownersById.get(row.user_id);
        return {
          id: row.id,
          ownerId: row.user_id,
          ownerName: owner?.name ?? "Unknown user",
          ownerEmail: owner?.email ?? row.user_id,
          platform: row.platform,
          scheduledAt: row.scheduled_at.toISOString(),
          status: row.status,
          textPreview: row.text.length > 140 ? `${row.text.slice(0, 140)}…` : row.text,
          text: row.text,
          mediaType: row.media_type,
          createdAt: row.created_at.toISOString(),
          publishedAt: row.published_at ? row.published_at.toISOString() : null,
          publishedUrl: typeof row.result?.url === "string" ? row.result.url : null,
          error: row.error,
          retryCount: row.retry_count,
          failureStage: row.failure_stage,
        };
      }),
      counts,
      total,
      page: filters.page,
      pageSize: filters.pageSize,
      range: {
        fromIso: filters.range.fromIso,
        toIso: filters.range.toIso,
        days: filters.range.days,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      posts: [],
      counts: emptyCounts(),
      total: 0,
      page: filters.page,
      pageSize: filters.pageSize,
      range: {
        fromIso: filters.range.fromIso,
        toIso: filters.range.toIso,
        days: filters.range.days,
      },
    };
  }
}

export interface AdminUserPost {
  id: string;
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  status: AdminPostStatus;
  scheduledAt: string;
  publishedAt: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  retryCount: number;
  textPreview: string;
  /** Full post text, used by the admin details dialog. */
  text: string;
  mediaType: string | null;
  failureStage: string | null;
  publishedUrl: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

/** Recent posts for one owner, used by the admin user detail page. */
export async function listUserScheduledPosts(
  userId: string,
  limit = 20,
): Promise<AdminUserPost[]> {
  try {
    const { rows } = await pool.query<{
      id: string;
      platform: AdminPlatform;
      status: AdminPostStatus;
      scheduled_at: Date;
      published_at: Date | null;
      error: string | null;
      retry_count: number;
      text: string;
      media_type: string | null;
      failure_stage: string | null;
      result: { url?: string } | null;
      created_at: Date;
    }>(
      `SELECT id, platform, status, scheduled_at, published_at, error,
              retry_count, text, media_type, failure_stage, result, created_at
         FROM public.scheduled_posts
        WHERE user_id = $1
        ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC
        LIMIT $2`,
      [userId, Math.min(Math.max(limit, 1), 100)],
    );
    return rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      platform: row.platform,
      status: row.status,
      scheduledAt: row.scheduled_at.toISOString(),
      publishedAt: row.published_at ? row.published_at.toISOString() : null,
      error: row.error,
      retryCount: row.retry_count,
      textPreview: row.text.length > 100 ? `${row.text.slice(0, 100)}…` : row.text,
      text: row.text,
      mediaType: row.media_type,
      failureStage: row.failure_stage,
      publishedUrl: typeof row.result?.url === "string" ? row.result.url : null,
      createdAt: row.created_at.toISOString(),
    }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

async function postOwner(postId: string): Promise<{ ownerId: string; status: AdminPostStatus }> {
  try {
    const { rows } = await pool.query<{ user_id: string; status: AdminPostStatus }>(
      "SELECT user_id, status FROM public.scheduled_posts WHERE id = $1",
      [postId],
    );
    if (!rows[0]) throw new ApiError("Scheduled post not found.", 404);
    return { ownerId: rows[0].user_id, status: rows[0].status };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) throw error;
    throw new ApiError("The scheduler store is unavailable.", 503);
  }
}

/** Admin-only hold: atomic `scheduled -> held`, never touches publishing rows. */
export async function adminHoldPost(
  actorId: string,
  postId: string,
): Promise<{ id: string; status: "held" }> {
  const { ownerId, status } = await postOwner(postId);
  if (!(ADMIN_POST_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(status)) {
    throw new ApiError("This post has an unknown status.", 409);
  }
  if (status !== "scheduled") {
    throw new ApiError(`Only scheduled posts can be held; this post is ${status}.`, 409);
  }
  try {
    const held = await holdScheduledPostForUser(ownerId, postId, {
      actorUserId: actorId,
      reason: "Held by the administrator before publishing.",
    });
    return { id: held.id, status: "held" };
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ApiError(
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not hold the scheduled post.",
      409,
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Admin-only resume. Future scheduled posts return to the queue; overdue held
 * posts stay held until an explicit reschedule, so a resume never triggers an
 * immediate duplicate/backlog publish.
 */
export async function adminResumePost(
  actorId: string,
  postId: string,
): Promise<{ id: string; status: "scheduled" | "held"; message: string }> {
  const { ownerId, status } = await postOwner(postId);
  if (status !== "held") {
    throw new ApiError(`Only held posts can be resumed; this post is ${status}.`, 409);
  }
  try {
    const result = await resumeScheduledPostsForUser(ownerId, postId, { actorUserId: actorId });
    if (result.resumed.length) {
      return {
        id: result.resumed[0]!.id,
        status: "scheduled",
        message: "Post resumed at its original scheduled time.",
      };
    }
    if (result.stillHeld.length) {
      return {
        id: result.stillHeld[0]!.id,
        status: "held",
        message:
          "The original schedule time has passed. The post stays held; reschedule it explicitly to publish.",
      };
    }
    throw new ApiError("The post could not be resumed.", 409);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) throw error;
    throw new ApiError(
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not resume the scheduled post.",
      409,
    );
  }
}

import { and, eq, gt } from "drizzle-orm";

import { logActivity } from "@/lib/activity";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { session, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { validateDisplayName } from "@/lib/security-policy";

export interface AdminProfile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  emailVerified: boolean;
  role: string;
  approvalStatus: string;
}

function mapAuthError(error: unknown, fallback: string): ApiError {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) return error;
  const code = (error as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code
    ?? (error as { body?: { code?: unknown } } | null)?.body?.code;
  const status = (error as { statusCode?: unknown } | null)?.statusCode
    ?? (error as { status?: unknown } | null)?.status;

  if (code === "INVALID_PASSWORD") {
    return new ApiError("Current password is incorrect.", 400);
  }
  if (code === "PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT" || code === "PASSWORD_TOO_LONG") {
    return new ApiError("The new password does not meet the length requirements.", 400);
  }
  if (code === "CREDENTIAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND") {
    return new ApiError("This account does not have a password set.", 400);
  }
  if (status === 401) {
    return new ApiError("Your session has expired. Sign in again.", 401);
  }
  if (status === 403) {
    return new ApiError("This action is not allowed.", 403);
  }
  if (status === 429) {
    return new ApiError("Too many requests. Try again later.", 429);
  }
  return new ApiError(fallback, 400);
}

export async function getAdminProfile(userId: string): Promise<AdminProfile> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      email: user.email,
      emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      role: user.role,
      approvalStatus: user.approvalStatus,
    })
    .from(user)
    .where(eq(user.id, userId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!row) throw new ApiError("Administrator account not found.", 404);
  return row;
}

/**
 * Updates only the display name. Role, email, approval state, and password are
 * deliberately absent from this path; a profile payload cannot escalate
 * privileges or move the recovery channel.
 */
export async function updateAdminProfile(
  userId: string,
  rawName: unknown,
): Promise<AdminProfile> {
  const parsed = validateDisplayName(rawName);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new ApiError(parsed.message);

  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [existing] = await tx
      .select({
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
        role: user.role,
        approvalStatus: user.approvalStatus,
      })
      .from(user)
      .where(eq(user.id, userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!existing) throw new ApiError("Administrator account not found.", 404);

    if (existing.name !== parsed.value) {
      await tx
        .update(user)
        .set({ name: parsed.value, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(user.id, userId));

      await logActivity(
        {
          actorUserId: userId,
          targetUserId: userId,
          action: "admin_profile_updated",
          resourceType: "user",
          resourceId: userId,
          metadata: { field: "name", previousName: existing.name, name: parsed.value },
        },
        tx,
      );
    }

    return { ...existing, name: parsed.value };
  });
}

async function countOtherSessions(
  userId: string,
  currentSessionId: string,
): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: session.id })
    .from(session)
    .where(and(eq(session.userId, userId), gt(session.expiresAt, new Date())));
  return rows.filter((row) => row.id !== currentSessionId).length;
}

export interface ChangeAdminPasswordInput {
  headers: Headers;
  userId: string;
  currentSessionId: string;
  currentPassword: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

/**
 * Changes the password through Better Auth with `revokeOtherSessions: true`.
 * Better Auth performs the password update and session rotation in one
 * transaction and returns the new session cookie in `Set-Cookie`. That header
 * is forwarded so the current browser stays signed in; the response body is
 * replaced because Better Auth's body contains the new raw session token.
 */
export async function changeAdminPassword(
  input: ChangeAdminPasswordInput,
): Promise<Response> {
  const otherSessions = await countOtherSessions(
    input.userId,
    input.currentSessionId,
  );

  let authResponse: Response;
  try {
    authResponse = await auth.api.changePassword({
      headers: input.headers,
      body: {
        currentPassword: input.currentPassword,
        newPassword: input.newPassword,
        revokeOtherSessions: true,
      },
      asResponse: true,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw mapAuthError(error, "Unable to change password.");
  }

  if (!authResponse.ok) {
    const body = (await authResponse.json().catch(() => null)) as {
      code?: string;
      message?: string;
    } | null;
    throw mapAuthError(body, "Unable to change password.");
  }

  await logActivity({
    actorUserId: input.userId,
    targetUserId: input.userId,
    action: "admin_password_changed",
    resourceType: "user",
    resourceId: input.userId,
    metadata: { otherSessionsRevoked: otherSessions },
  });

  const responseHeaders = new Headers();
  for (const cookie of authResponse.headers.getSetCookie()) {
    responseHeaders.append("set-cookie", cookie);
  }
  responseHeaders.set("content-type", "application/json");
  responseHeaders.set("cache-control", "no-store");

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({ success: true, otherSessionsRevoked: otherSessions }),
    { status: 200, headers: responseHeaders },
  );
}

import { and, asc, ilike, or } from "drizzle-orm";

import type {
  AdminPlatform,
  SocialAccountFilters,
  SocialAccountStatus,
} from "@/lib/admin-policy";
import {
  groupConnectionsByOwner,
  type AdminSocialConnectionRow,
  type AdminSocialOwnerRow,
} from "@/lib/admin-social-grouping";
import { loadTokenMetadata } from "@/lib/backend";
import { db, pool } from "@/lib/db";
import { user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export { groupConnectionsByOwner };
export type { AdminSocialConnectionRow, AdminSocialOwnerRow };

export interface AdminSocialAccountsResult {
  /** One entry per unique owner for the current page. */
  rows: AdminSocialOwnerRow[];
  totalConnections: number;
  filteredConnections: number;
  totalUsers: number;
  /** Unique owners remaining after platform/status filters; drives pagination. */
  filteredUsers: number;
  counts: Record<SocialAccountStatus, number>;
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
}

interface AuthSessionRow {
  user_id: string;
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  status: string;
  error: string | null;
  created_at: Date;
  completed_at: Date | null;
}

function escapeLike(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (character) => `\\${character}`);
}

function userStatus(row: {
  approvalStatus: string;
  banned: boolean;
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}): AdminSocialConnectionRow["userStatus"] {
  if (row.deletedAt) return "deleted";
  if (row.banned) return "suspended";
  if (row.approvalStatus === "approved" || row.approvalStatus === "rejected") {
    return row.approvalStatus;
  }
  return "pending";
}

async function latestAuthorizationSessions(
  userIds: string[],
): Promise<Map<string, AuthSessionRow>> {
  const sessions = new Map<string, AuthSessionRow>();
  if (!userIds.length) return sessions;
  try {
    const { rows } = await pool.query<AuthSessionRow>(
      `SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, platform)
              user_id, platform, status, error, created_at, completed_at
         FROM public.oauth_authorization_sessions
        WHERE user_id = ANY($1::text[])
        ORDER BY user_id, platform, created_at DESC`,
      [userIds],
    );
    for (const row of rows) sessions.set(`${row.user_id}:${row.platform}`, row);
  } catch {
    // The OAuth session table is optional (legacy local deployments).
  }
  return sessions;
}

/** Cross-account connection monitoring. Never returns or logs token material. */
export async function listSocialAccounts(
  filters: SocialAccountFilters,
): Promise<AdminSocialAccountsResult> {
  const conditions = [];
  if (filters.query) {
    const pattern = `%${escapeLike(filters.query)}%`;
    conditions.push(or(ilike(user.name, pattern), ilike(user.email, pattern))!);
  }

  const users = await db
    .select({
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      email: user.email,
      approvalStatus: user.approvalStatus,
      banned: user.banned,
      deletedAt: user.deletedAt,
    })
    .from(user)
    .where(conditions.length ? and(...conditions) : undefined)
    .orderBy(asc(user.email), asc(user.name));

  const sessions = await latestAuthorizationSessions(users.map((row) => row.id));

  const allRows: AdminSocialConnectionRow[] = [];
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    users.map(async (row) => ({
      user: row,
      tokens: await loadTokenMetadata(row.id),
    })),
  );

  for (const item of settled) {
    if (item.status !== "fulfilled") continue;
    const { user: owner, tokens } = item.value;
    const ownerStatus = userStatus(owner);
    for (const token of tokens) {
      const session = sessions.get(`${owner.id}:${token.platform}`);
      const sessionError = session && session.status !== "connected" ? session.error : null;
      const status: SocialAccountStatus = token.expired ? "expired" : "connected";
      allRows.push({
        userId: owner.id,
        userName: owner.name,
        userEmail: owner.email,
        userStatus: ownerStatus,
        platform: token.platform as AdminPlatform,
        status,
        accountName: token.accountName,
        accountId: token.accountId,
        expiresAt: token.expiresAt === null ? null : new Date(token.expiresAt).toISOString(),
        expired: token.expired,
        scopes: token.scopes,
        pageCount: token.pageCount,
        connectedAt: token.connectedAt,
        lastSyncAt: token.updatedAt,
        lastError: sessionError,
        lastErrorAt: sessionError && session ? session.created_at.toISOString() : null,
      });
    }

    // Surface a failed authorization attempt even when no token was stored.
    for (const platform of ["facebook", "instagram", "linkedin"] as const) {
      const hasToken = tokens.some((token) => token.platform === platform);
      if (hasToken) continue;
      const session = sessions.get(`${owner.id}:${platform}`);
      if (!session || session.status === "connected" || session.status === "pending") continue;
      allRows.push({
        userId: owner.id,
        userName: owner.name,
        userEmail: owner.email,
        userStatus: ownerStatus,
        platform,
        status: "error",
        accountName: null,
        accountId: null,
        expiresAt: null,
        expired: false,
        scopes: [],
        pageCount: 0,
        connectedAt: null,
        lastSyncAt: session.completed_at?.toISOString() ?? session.created_at.toISOString(),
        lastError: session.error ?? `Authorization ${session.status}.`,
        lastErrorAt: (session.completed_at ?? session.created_at).toISOString(),
      });
    }
  }

  allRows.sort((left, right) => {
    const byEmail = left.userEmail.localeCompare(right.userEmail);
    if (byEmail !== 0) return byEmail;
    return left.platform.localeCompare(right.platform);
  });

  const counts: Record<SocialAccountStatus, number> = {
    connected: 0,
    expired: 0,
    error: 0,
    disconnected: 0,
  };
  for (const row of allRows) counts[row.status] += 1;

  const filtered = allRows.filter((row) => {
    if (filters.platform !== "all" && row.platform !== filters.platform) return false;
    if (filters.status !== "all" && row.status !== filters.status) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Filtering happens per connection, then the surviving connections are
  // grouped by owner. Pagination is applied to owners so a user's platforms
  // are never split across pages.
  const ownerRows = groupConnectionsByOwner(filtered);

  // Connection monitoring must cover every registered user, so owners without
  // any social connection are appended as empty rows (the table renders one
  // row per owner with a "Not connected" placeholder per platform). Platform
  // and status filters select real connections, so while a filter is active a
  // user with no matching connection has nothing to show and stays excluded.
  if (filters.platform === "all" && filters.status === "all") {
    const withConnections = new Set(ownerRows.map((row) => row.userId));
    for (const owner of users) {
      if (withConnections.has(owner.id)) continue;
      ownerRows.push({
        userId: owner.id,
        userName: owner.name,
        userEmail: owner.email,
        userStatus: userStatus(owner),
        connections: [],
      });
    }
    // Preserve the deterministic owner ordering of the connection rows.
    ownerRows.sort(
      (left, right) =>
        left.userEmail.localeCompare(right.userEmail) ||
        left.userName.localeCompare(right.userName),
    );
  }

  return {
    rows: ownerRows.slice(filters.offset, filters.offset + filters.pageSize),
    totalConnections: allRows.length,
    filteredConnections: filtered.length,
    totalUsers: users.length,
    filteredUsers: ownerRows.length,
    counts,
    page: filters.page,
    pageSize: filters.pageSize,
  };
}

/**
 * Connection summary for a single user detail page. Reuses the same safe
 * metadata helper but avoids the global pagination query.
 */
export async function listUserSocialAccounts(userId: string): Promise<AdminSocialConnectionRow[]> {
  const tokens = await loadTokenMetadata(userId);
  return tokens.map((token) => ({
    userId,
    userName: "",
    userEmail: "",
    userStatus: "approved",
    platform: token.platform as AdminPlatform,
    status: token.expired ? "expired" : "connected",
    accountName: token.accountName,
    accountId: token.accountId,
    expiresAt: token.expiresAt === null ? null : new Date(token.expiresAt).toISOString(),
    expired: token.expired,
    scopes: token.scopes,
    pageCount: token.pageCount,
    connectedAt: token.connectedAt,
    lastSyncAt: token.updatedAt,
    lastError: null,
    lastErrorAt: null,
  }));
}

import type { AdminPlatform, SocialAccountStatus } from "@/lib/admin-policy";

export interface AdminSocialConnectionRow {
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  userEmail: string;
  userStatus: "pending" | "approved" | "rejected" | "suspended" | "deleted";
  platform: AdminPlatform;
  status: SocialAccountStatus;
  accountName: string | null;
  accountId: string | null;
  expiresAt: string | null;
  expired: boolean;
  scopes: string[];
  pageCount: number;
  connectedAt: string | null;
  lastSyncAt: string | null;
  lastError: string | null;
  lastErrorAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * One owner with every matching platform connection attached. Grouping is
 * keyed on the immutable user id so two people with the same display name or
 * email are never merged.
 */
export interface AdminSocialOwnerRow {
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  userEmail: string;
  userStatus: AdminSocialConnectionRow["userStatus"];
  /** Connections for this owner, ordered Facebook → Instagram → LinkedIn. */
  connections: AdminSocialConnectionRow[];
}

const PLATFORM_ORDER: Record<AdminPlatform, number> = {
  facebook: 0,
  instagram: 1,
  linkedin: 2,
};

/**
 * Groups flat connection rows by owner id without dropping or merging any
 * connection. Pure so the grouping behaviour can be tested without a database
 * connection; owner order follows the first appearance of each user id.
 */
export function groupConnectionsByOwner(
  rows: AdminSocialConnectionRow[],
): AdminSocialOwnerRow[] {
  const owners = new Map<string, AdminSocialOwnerRow>();

  for (const connection of rows) {
    const existing = owners.get(connection.userId);
    if (existing) {
      existing.connections.push(connection);
      continue;
    }
    owners.set(connection.userId, {
      userId: connection.userId,
      userName: connection.userName,
      userEmail: connection.userEmail,
      userStatus: connection.userStatus,
      connections: [connection],
    });
  }

  for (const owner of owners.values()) {
    owner.connections.sort(
      (left, right) =>
        PLATFORM_ORDER[left.platform] - PLATFORM_ORDER[right.platform],
    );
  }

  return [...owners.values()];
}

FILE: social-media-web/src/lib/admin-user-filters.ts

import { and, eq, isNotNull, isNull, ne, or, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { UserStatus } from "@/lib/admin-user-status";
import { user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

/**
 * Database-side condition that excludes Super Admin accounts.
 *
 * `role` is the authoritative marker for the Super Admin (`role = 'admin'`),
 * matching the admin plugin's `adminRoles` configuration. This deliberately
 * uses the role column rather than a user id, email, or name, and leaves every
 * other role untouched. It is shared by the dashboard aggregates and the
 * default Users directory so the cards and the list apply the same rule.
 */
export function nonAdminCondition(): SQL {
  return ne(user.role, "admin");
}

/**
 * Database-side condition for one console-facing user status.
 *
 * Mirrors `classifyUserStatus` exactly, so a status-filtered directory list
 * contains the same accounts that the matching dashboard card counts:
 *
 * - `pending`  → approval pending AND not banned AND not deleted
 * - `active`   → approval approved AND not banned AND not deleted
 * - `inactive` → rejected OR banned OR soft-deleted
 *
 * The conditions are mutually exclusive and cover every row, so the three
 * buckets partition the user table without double counting.
 */
export function userStatusCondition(status: UserStatus): SQL {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return and(
        eq(user.approvalStatus, "pending"),
        eq(user.banned, false),
        isNull(user.deletedAt),
      )!;
    case "active":
      return and(
        eq(user.approvalStatus, "approved"),
        eq(user.banned, false),
        isNull(user.deletedAt),
      )!;
    case "inactive":
      return or(
        eq(user.approvalStatus, "rejected"),
        eq(user.banned, true),
        isNotNull(user.deletedAt),
      )!;
  }
}

// Pure user-facing status policy shared by the dashboard statistics, the Users
// directory filters, and the UI badges. Kept free of database imports so the
// classification rules can be unit-tested without a connection.

/**
 * The three statuses shown to the Super Admin.
 *
 * Internally the database still stores `approval_status` (`pending`,
 * `approved`, `rejected`), `banned`, and `deleted_at`. Those are implementation
 * details; the console presents one unambiguous status per account:
 *
 * - `pending`  – waiting for an administrator decision.
 * - `active`   – approved and not suspended or soft-deleted.
 * - `inactive` – rejected, suspended, or soft-deleted.
 *
 * A pending account that is suspended or soft-deleted is `inactive`, not
 * `pending`: lifecycle flags take precedence so every account lands in exactly
 * one bucket and nothing is double-counted.
 */
export const USER_STATUSES = ["pending", "active", "inactive"] as const;
export type UserStatus = (typeof USER_STATUSES)[number];

export interface UserStatusRow {
  approvalStatus: string;
  banned: boolean;
  deleted: boolean;
}

/** True when the account is not suspended and not soft-deleted. */
export function isActiveAccount(row: Pick<UserStatusRow, "banned" | "deleted">): boolean {
  return !row.banned && !row.deleted;
}

/**
 * Map an internal user row to the single status shown in the console.
 *
 * Precedence is deliberate: rejected, suspended, and deleted accounts are all
 * `inactive` even when their `approval_status` is `pending` or `approved`.
 */
export function classifyUserStatus(row: UserStatusRow): UserStatus {
  if (!isActiveAccount(row) || row.approvalStatus === "rejected") {
    return "inactive";
  }
  if (row.approvalStatus === "pending") {
    return "pending";
  }
  return "active";
}

// Pure user-management policy: constants, filter parsing, and the update
// guard. Kept free of database imports so it can be unit-tested without a
// connection and reused by both the API routes and server pages.

import {
  USER_STATUSES,
  type UserStatus,
} from "@/lib/admin-user-status";

export const USER_ROLES = ["admin", "user"] as const;
export type UserRole = (typeof USER_ROLES)[number];

export const APPROVAL_STATUSES = ["pending", "approved", "rejected"] as const;
export type ApprovalStatus = (typeof APPROVAL_STATUSES)[number];

// Only these two targets can be set through the management API. "pending" is
// the signup default and is never an admin-selectable action.
export const MANAGEABLE_APPROVAL_STATUSES = ["approved", "rejected"] as const;
export type ManageableApprovalStatus = (typeof MANAGEABLE_APPROVAL_STATUSES)[number];

export type FilterValue<T extends string> = T | "all";

export interface UserFilters {
  query: string;
  status: FilterValue<UserStatus>;
  role: FilterValue<UserRole>;
}

export interface UserUpdate {
  role?: UserRole;
  approvalStatus?: ManageableApprovalStatus;
}

export interface GuardTarget {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  approvalStatus: string;
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface UserUpdateViolation {
  message: string;
  status: number;
}

const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100;

function readParam(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
  key: string,
): string {
  if (!input) return "";
  if (typeof (input as URLSearchParams).get === "function") {
    return (input as URLSearchParams).get(key) ?? "";
  }
  const value = (input as Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>)[key];
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value[0] ?? "";
  return value ?? "";
}

// Older dashboard links used `approval=approved|rejected`. Keep accepting
// them (mapped to the new console-facing terms) so bookmarks and any external
// links keep working.
const LEGACY_STATUS_PARAMS: Record<string, UserStatus> = {
  approved: "active",
  rejected: "inactive",
};

/** Normalise and whitelist the list filters coming from a URL. */
export function parseUserFilters(
  input: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | null | undefined,
): UserFilters {
  const query = readParam(input, "q").trim().slice(0, MAX_QUERY_LENGTH);
  const statusRaw = readParam(input, "status").trim().toLowerCase();
  const legacyStatusRaw = readParam(input, "approval").trim().toLowerCase();
  const statusCandidate = LEGACY_STATUS_PARAMS[statusRaw || legacyStatusRaw]
    ?? (statusRaw || legacyStatusRaw);
  const roleRaw = readParam(input, "role").trim().toLowerCase();

  return {
    query,
    status: (USER_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(statusCandidate)
      ? (statusCandidate as UserStatus)
      : "all",
    role: (USER_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(roleRaw)
      ? (roleRaw as UserRole)
      : "all",
  };
}

/**
 * Server-side invariant check for every user update. Returns a safe,
 * user-facing violation, or null when the update is allowed.
 *
 * `adminCount` is the number of rows with role='admin' including the target.
 * The database also enforces "at most one admin" with a partial unique index;
 * this guard exists so the API returns a clear message and so the actor can
 * never lock themself out.
 */
export function validateUserUpdate(params: {
  actorId: string;
  target: GuardTarget;
  update: UserUpdate;
  adminCount: number;
}): UserUpdateViolation | null {
  const { actorId, target, update, adminCount } = params;

  if (!update.role && !update.approvalStatus) {
    return { message: "No changes were provided.", status: 400 };
  }

  if (target.deletedAt) {
    return {
      message: "This account has been deleted and can no longer be managed.",
      status: 409,
    };
  }

  if (update.approvalStatus) {
    if (target.id === actorId) {
      return { message: "You cannot change your own approval status.", status: 409 };
    }
    if (update.approvalStatus === target.approvalStatus) {
      return {
        message: `This account is already ${target.approvalStatus}.`,
        status: 409,
      };
    }
  }

  if (update.role) {
    if (target.id === actorId) {
      // Covers both demotion and promotion of the acting Super Admin.
      return { message: "You cannot change your own role.", status: 409 };
    }
    if (update.role === target.role) {
      return {
        message: `This account already has the ${target.role} role.`,
        status: 409,
      };
    }
    if (update.role === "admin" && target.role !== "admin" && adminCount > 0) {
      return {
        message:
          "A Super Admin already exists. The application supports exactly one admin account.",
        status: 409,
      };
    }
    if (update.role === "user" && target.role === "admin" && adminCount <= 1) {
      return {
        message: "You cannot remove the only Super Admin.",
        status: 409,
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}
