import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

import { PgDialect } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { nonAdminCondition, userStatusCondition } from "@/lib/admin-user-filters";
import {
  parseUserFilters,
  validateUserUpdate,
  type GuardTarget,
} from "@/lib/admin-users-policy";
import { isUniqueViolation } from "@/lib/db-errors";

const readFile = (relative: string) => readFileSync(relative, "utf8");

function target(overrides: Partial<GuardTarget> = {}): GuardTarget {
  return {
    id: "user-2",
    role: "user",
    approvalStatus: "pending",
    deletedAt: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("parseUserFilters", () => {
  it("trims and caps the search query", () => {
    const filters = parseUserFilters({ q: `  ${"a".repeat(300)}  ` });
    expect(filters.query).toHaveLength(100);
  });

  it("whitelists status and role filters", () => {
    expect(parseUserFilters({ status: "ACTIVE", role: "ADMIN" })).toEqual({
      query: "",
      status: "active",
      role: "admin",
    });
    expect(parseUserFilters({ status: "bogus", role: "bogus" })).toEqual({
      query: "",
      status: "all",
      role: "all",
    });
  });

  it("maps legacy approval links to the new status terms", () => {
    expect(parseUserFilters({ approval: "approved" })).toMatchObject({
      status: "active",
    });
    expect(parseUserFilters({ approval: "rejected" })).toMatchObject({
      status: "inactive",
    });
    expect(parseUserFilters({ approval: "pending" })).toMatchObject({
      status: "pending",
    });
  });

  it("reads URLSearchParams and array values", () => {
    expect(
      parseUserFilters(new URLSearchParams({ q: "dinesh", status: "inactive" })),
    ).toMatchObject({ query: "dinesh", status: "inactive" });
    expect(parseUserFilters({ q: ["first", "second"] }).query).toBe("first");
  });
});

describe("userStatusCondition", () => {
  const dialect = new PgDialect();

  it("filters pending users to active pending accounts in PostgreSQL", () => {
    const query = dialect.sqlToQuery(userStatusCondition("pending"));

    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."approval_status" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."banned" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."deleted_at" is null');
    expect(query.sql).toMatch(/ and /);
    expect(query.params).toEqual(["pending", false]);
  });

  it("filters active users to approved, unbanned, non-deleted accounts", () => {
    const query = dialect.sqlToQuery(userStatusCondition("active"));

    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."approval_status" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."banned" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."deleted_at" is null');
    expect(query.sql).toMatch(/ and /);
    expect(query.params).toEqual(["approved", false]);
  });

  it("filters inactive users to rejected, banned, or soft-deleted accounts", () => {
    const query = dialect.sqlToQuery(userStatusCondition("inactive"));

    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."approval_status" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."banned" =');
    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."deleted_at" is not null');
    expect(query.sql).toMatch(/ or /);
    expect(query.params).toEqual(["rejected", true]);
  });
});

describe("nonAdminCondition", () => {
  const dialect = new PgDialect();

  it("excludes the Super Admin role in PostgreSQL", () => {
    const query = dialect.sqlToQuery(nonAdminCondition());

    expect(query.sql).toContain('"user"."role" <>');
    expect(query.params).toEqual(["admin"]);
  });
});

describe("validateUserUpdate", () => {
  it("rejects an empty update", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({ actorId: "admin-1", target: target(), update: {}, adminCount: 1 }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 400 });
  });

  it("refuses to manage a deleted account", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ deletedAt: new Date() }),
        update: { approvalStatus: "approved" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
  });

  it("allows approving and rejecting another account", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ approvalStatus: "pending" }),
        update: { approvalStatus: "approved" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ approvalStatus: "pending" }),
        update: { approvalStatus: "rejected" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
  });

  it("treats a redundant approval change as a conflict", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ approvalStatus: "approved" }),
        update: { approvalStatus: "approved" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
  });

  it("prevents the acting admin from changing their own approval or role", () => {
    const self = target({ id: "admin-1", role: "admin", approvalStatus: "approved" });
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: self,
        update: { approvalStatus: "rejected" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: self,
        update: { role: "user" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
  });

  it("prevents creating a second admin while one exists", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ role: "user" }),
        update: { role: "admin" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
  });

  it("allows promotion only when no admin exists", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ role: "user" }),
        update: { role: "admin" },
        adminCount: 0,
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
  });

  it("protects the only admin from demotion", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "someone-else",
        target: target({ role: "admin", approvalStatus: "approved" }),
        update: { role: "user" },
        adminCount: 1,
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
  });

  it("allows demoting a non-final admin", () => {
    expect(
      validateUserUpdate({
        actorId: "actor",
        target: target({ role: "admin", approvalStatus: "approved" }),
        update: { role: "user" },
        adminCount: 2,
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("isUniqueViolation", () => {
  it("detects a direct PostgreSQL unique violation", () => {
    expect(isUniqueViolation({ code: "23505" })).toBe(true);
  });

  it("detects a unique violation wrapped by Drizzle", () => {
    const wrapped = new Error("Failed query", {
      cause: Object.assign(new Error("duplicate key"), { code: "23505" }),
    });
    expect(isUniqueViolation(wrapped)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("ignores unrelated errors, nulls, and cyclic causes", () => {
    expect(isUniqueViolation(new Error("boom"))).toBe(false);
    expect(isUniqueViolation(null)).toBe(false);
    expect(isUniqueViolation("23505")).toBe(false);
    const cyclic: { cause?: unknown } = {};
    cyclic.cause = cyclic;
    expect(isUniqueViolation(cyclic)).toBe(false);
  });
});

// --- Route-handler regression tests -----------------------------------------
// The handlers import the real policy module (pure) but everything that would
// touch the database or Better Auth is mocked.

const requireAdminMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
const listUsersMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
const getUserDetailMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
const updateUserMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());

vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ requireAdmin: requireAdminMock }));
vi.mock("@/lib/admin-users", () => ({
  listUsers: listUsersMock,
  getUserDetail: getUserDetailMock,
  updateUser: updateUserMock,
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/api", () => {
  class ApiError extends Error {
    readonly status: number;
    constructor(message: string, status = 400) {
      super(message);
      this.name = "ApiError";
      this.status = status;
    }
  }
  return {
    ApiError,
    apiErrorResponse: (error: unknown) => {
      if (error instanceof ApiError) {
        return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: error.status });
      }
      if (
        typeof error === "object" &&
        error !== null &&
        "status" in error &&
        typeof (error as { status?: unknown }).status === "number"
      ) {
        return Response.json(
          { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Forbidden." },
          { status: (error as { status: number }).status },
        );
      }
      return Response.json({ error: "Unexpected error." }, { status: 500 });
    },
  };
});

import { GET as listUsersRoute } from "@/app/api/admin/users/route";
import {
  GET as getUserRoute,
  PATCH as updateUserRoute,
} from "@/app/api/admin/users/[id]/route";

const adminSession = {
  session: { id: "sess-admin" },
  user: { id: "admin-1" },
} as never;

function params(id: string) {
  return { params: Promise.resolve({ id }) };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  requireAdminMock.mockReset();
  listUsersMock.mockReset();
  getUserDetailMock.mockReset();
  updateUserMock.mockReset();
});

describe("admin user API authorization", () => {
  it("lists users for an admin", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    listUsersMock.mockResolvedValue({
      users: [{ id: "u-1" }],
      counts: { total: 1, pending: 0, active: 1, inactive: 0 },
    });

    const response = await listUsersRoute(
      new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users?status=active"),
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await response.json()).toMatchObject({ counts: { total: 1 } });
    expect(listUsersMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      query: "",
      status: "active",
      role: "all",
    });
  });

  it("returns 403 for a non-admin list request", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockRejectedValue(
      Object.assign(new Error("This account was not approved."), { status: 403 }),
    );

    const response = await listUsersRoute(
      new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users"),
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(listUsersMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns 404 for a missing user detail", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    getUserDetailMock.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const response = await getUserRoute(
      new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users/missing"),
      params("missing"),
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it("rejects unknown or empty patch bodies", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);

    for (const body of [{}, { foo: "bar" }, { role: "owner" }, { approvalStatus: "pending" }]) {
      const response = await updateUserRoute(
        new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users/u-2", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify(body),
        }),
        params("u-2"),
      );
      expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    }
    expect(updateUserMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("updates a user for an admin", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    updateUserMock.mockResolvedValue({ id: "u-2", approvalStatus: "approved" });

    const response = await updateUserRoute(
      new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users/u-2", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ approvalStatus: "approved" }),
      }),
      params("u-2"),
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(updateUserMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith("admin-1", "u-2", {
      approvalStatus: "approved",
    });
  });

  it("does not update anything for a non-admin", async () => {
    requireAdminMock.mockRejectedValue(
      Object.assign(new Error("This account was not approved."), { status: 403 }),
    );

    const response = await updateUserRoute(
      new Request("https://example.test/api/admin/users/u-2", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ approvalStatus: "approved" }),
      }),
      params("u-2"),
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    expect(updateUserMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

FILE: social-media-web/tests/auth-schema.test.ts
================================================================================

import { getTableColumns } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { PgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { getAuthTables } from "better-auth/db";
import { admin } from "better-auth/plugins/admin";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { session, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";

// Mirrors the schema Better Auth 1.7.9 builds from the admin plugin. The
// Drizzle adapter introspects Drizzle *property keys* (not SQL column names),
// so a session field declared as `impersonated_by: text("impersonated_by")`
// still fails with "Missing columns: session.impersonatedBy". This test locks
// in the camelCase property name that the plugin expects.
const authTables = getAuthTables({
  plugins: [admin({ adminRoles: ["admin"] })],
});

function expectedColumnNames(model: "user" | "session"): string[] {
  const table = authTables[model];
  return Object.entries(table.fields).map(
    ([key, field]) => (field as { fieldName?: string }).fieldName ?? key,
  );
}

const columns = {
  user: getTableColumns(user),
  session: getTableColumns(session),
} satisfies Record<"user" | "session", Record<string, PgColumn>>;

describe("Better Auth Drizzle schema parity", () => {
  it.each(["user", "session"] as const)(
    "declares every Better Auth column on the %s table",
    (model) => {
      for (const name of expectedColumnNames(model)) {
        expect(columns[model], `${model}.${name} is missing`).toHaveProperty(name);
      }
    },
  );

  it("maps session.impersonatedBy to a nullable snake_case column", () => {
    const column = columns.session.impersonatedBy;
    expect(column, "session.impersonatedBy is missing").toBeDefined();
    expect(column.name).toBe("impersonated_by");
    expect(column.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(column.columnType).toBe("PgText");
  });

  it("keeps the admin-plugin user columns nullable/defaulted", () => {
    expect(columns.user.role.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(columns.user.role.default).toBe("user");
    expect(columns.user.banned.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(columns.user.banned.default).toBe(false);
    expect(columns.user.banReason.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(columns.user.banExpires.notNull).toBe(false);
  });
});

FILE: social-media-web/tests/db-pool-recovery.test.ts
================================================================================

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

// Integration test against the real database: proves that
// ensureDatabaseConnection() deterministically recovers a pool holding dead
// idle clients (the production failure mode for frozen serverless instances
// whose idle TCP connections are closed by Supabase/Supavisor).
//
// Skipped when no database URL is available (pure-CI environments).
let databaseUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL?.trim() || "";
if (!databaseUrl) {
  try {
    for (const line of readFileSync(
      path.resolve(__dirname, "../../social-media-mcp/.env"),
      "utf8",
    ).split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const match = /^DATABASE_URL=(.*)$/.exec(line);
      if (match?.[1]) {
        databaseUrl = match[1].trim();
        process.env.DATABASE_URL ??= databaseUrl;
        break;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // No local env file: the test skips.
  }
}

const { isConnectionError, ensureDatabaseConnection, pool } = await import("@/lib/db");
const { Pool } = await import("pg");

describe.skipIf(!databaseUrl)("database pool zombie recovery", () => {
  it(
    "classifies connection errors without misclassifying query failures",
    () => {
      const reset = Object.assign(new Error("Connection terminated unexpectedly"), {
        code: "ECONNRESET",
      });
      expect(isConnectionError(reset)).toBe(true);
      expect(isConnectionError(new Error("FATAL: sorry, too many clients already"))).toBe(true);
      expect(isConnectionError(new Error('column "x" does not exist'))).toBe(false);
      expect(isConnectionError(new Error("syntax error at or near \"FROM\""))).toBe(false);
    },
  );

  it(
    "drains server-terminated idle clients and restores the pool",
    { timeout: 60000 },
    async () => {
      // Fill the pool with idle clients, kill their backends from a separate
      // connection (exactly what a provider does to a frozen instance's idle
      // sockets), then return them to the pool as idle zombies.
      const held: Array<{ processID?: number; release: (err?: Error | null) => void }> = [];
      try {
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
          const client = await pool.connect();
          held.push(client as unknown as { processID?: number; release: (err?: Error | null) => void });
        }
        const pids = held.map((client) => client.processID).filter((pid) => pid !== undefined);
        expect(pids).toHaveLength(3);

        const adminPool = new Pool({ connectionString: databaseUrl, max: 2 });
        try {
          await adminPool.query(
            `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM unnest($1::int[]) AS pid`,
            [pids],
          );
        } finally {
          await adminPool.end();
        }
      } finally {
        // Release regardless of failures so the pool is left in a state where
        // the zombies (or their replacements) are idle, as after a serverless
        // freeze.
        for (const client of held) {
          try {
            client.release();
          } catch {
            // Already removed by the failure path.
          }
        }
      }

      // The recovery helper drains every dead client it is handed and ends
      // with a verified-healthy pooled connection.
      expect(await ensureDatabaseConnection()).toBe(true);

      // And the pool serves queries again.
      const after = await pool.query("SELECT 1 AS ok");
      expect(after.rows[0]?.ok).toBe(1);
    },
  );
});

import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";

// The authorization helpers read the verified session through
// auth.api.getSession; the mock below stands in for Better Auth itself.
const getSessionMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());

vi.mock("@/lib/auth", () => ({
  auth: { api: { getSession: getSessionMock } },
  ADMIN_ROLE: "admin",
}));

vi.mock("next/headers", () => ({
  headers: () => new Headers(),
}));

import {
  ApprovalRequiredError,
  readAccountState,
  requireAdmin,
  requireApprovedUser,
  requireAuthenticatedUser,
  requireResourceOwnership,
  UnauthorizedError,
} from "@/lib/session";

function sessionWith(fields: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return {
    session: { id: "sess-1", token: "tok" },
    user: { id: "u-1", name: "U", email: "u@example.com", ...fields },
  };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  getSessionMock.mockReset();
});

describe("readAccountState", () => {
  it("classifies an approved regular user", () => {
    const state = readAccountState(sessionWith({ role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }) as never);
    expect(state).toMatchObject({ role: "user", isAdmin: false, approvalStatus: "approved", deleted: false, banActive: false });
  });

  it("detects the admin role in comma-joined role strings", () => {
    const state = readAccountState(sessionWith({ role: "admin,other", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }) as never);
    expect(state?.isAdmin).toBe(true);
  });

  it("defaults unknown approval values to pending", () => {
    const state = readAccountState(sessionWith({ role: "user" }) as never);
    expect(state?.approvalStatus).toBe("pending");
  });
});

describe("requireAuthenticatedUser", () => {
  it("returns the session when one exists", async () => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith({ approvalStatus: "approved" }));
    const session = await requireAuthenticatedUser();
    expect(session.user.id).toBe("u-1");
  });

  it("throws UnauthorizedError without a session", async () => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(requireAuthenticatedUser()).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedError);
  });
});

describe("requireApprovedUser", () => {
  it("allows approved users and the approved admin", async () => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith({ role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }));
    await expect(requireApprovedUser()).resolves.toBeTruthy();

    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith({ role: "admin", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }));
    await expect(requireApprovedUser()).resolves.toBeTruthy();
  });

  it.each([
    ["pending accounts", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "pending", banned: false }, "pending"],
    ["rejected accounts", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "rejected", banned: false }, "rejected"],
    ["not-yet-expired suspensions", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: true, banExpires: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000) }, "suspended"],
    ["permanent suspensions", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: true }, "suspended"],
    ["soft-deleted accounts", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false, deletedAt: new Date() }, "deleted"],
  ])("denies %s", async (_label, fields, expectedCode) => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith(fields));
    const error = await requireApprovedUser().catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ApprovalRequiredError);
    expect((error as ApprovalRequiredError).code).toBe(expectedCode);
  });

  it("treats an expired suspension as no longer banned", async () => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(
      sessionWith({ role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: true, banExpires: new Date(Date.now() - 1000) }),
    );
    await expect(requireApprovedUser()).resolves.toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe("requireAdmin", () => {
  it("allows the approved Super Admin", async () => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith({ role: "admin", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }));
    await expect(requireAdmin()).resolves.toBeTruthy();
  });

  it.each([
    ["regular users", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "approved", banned: false }],
    ["pending users", { role: "user", approvalStatus: "pending" }],
    ["unapproved admins (cannot be created, defense in depth)", { role: "admin", approvalStatus: "pending" }],
  ])("denies %s", async (_label, fields) => {
    getSessionMock.mockResolvedValue(sessionWith(fields));
    await expect(requireAdmin()).rejects.toBeTruthy();
  });
});

describe("requireResourceOwnership", () => {
  it("rejects a client-supplied user id that differs from the session", async () => {
    expect(() => requireResourceOwnership(sessionWith({}) as never, "u-2")).toThrow();
    expect(() => requireResourceOwnership(sessionWith({}) as never, "u-1")).not.toThrow();
  });
});

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const readFile = (relative: string) => readFileSync(relative, "utf8");

describe("database migration 0002 (admin multi-tenant foundation)", () => {
  const migration = readFile("migrations/0002_admin_multitenant.sql");

  it("adds the Better Auth admin plugin columns", () => {
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "role" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user'/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "banned" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "ban_reason" text/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "ban_expires" timestamp with time zone/i);
  });

  it("adds approval_status and deleted_at with case-correct defaults", () => {
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "approval_status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved'/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/SET DEFAULT 'pending'/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_at" timestamp with time zone/i);
  });

  it("explicitly marks existing users as approved", () => {
    expect(migration).toMatch(/UPDATE "user" SET "approval_status" = 'approved'/i);
  });

  it("enforces the single-Super-Admin invariant at the database level", () => {
    expect(migration).toMatch(/CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "user_single_admin_idx"/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/WHERE "role" = 'admin'/i);
  });

  it("does not drop or reset any existing data", () => {
    expect(migration).not.toMatch(/DROP\s+(TABLE|COLUMN)/i);
    expect(migration).not.toMatch(/DELETE\s+FROM/i);
    expect(migration).not.toMatch(/TRUNCATE/i);
  });

  it("creates the shared activity log table without secrets-handling columns", () => {
    expect(migration).toMatch(/CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_log"/i);
    expect(migration).toMatch(/"metadata" jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '\{\}'::jsonb/i);
  });
});

describe("Better Auth integration (src/lib/auth.ts)", () => {
  const auth = readFile("src/lib/auth.ts");

  it("integrates the Better Auth 1.7.9 admin plugin with the confirmed roles", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/import \{ admin \} from "better-auth\/plugins\/admin"/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/admin\(\{\s*adminRoles: \["admin"\],\s*defaultRole: "user",/);
  });

  it("forces every signup to a pending regular user regardless of payload", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/before: async \(user\) => \(\{[\s\S]*data: \{[\s\S]*\.\.\.user,[\s\S]*role: "user",[\s\S]*approvalStatus: "pending",[\s\S]*banned: false,/);
  });

  it("makes approval status server-managed (input: false)", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/approvalStatus: \{[^}]*?input: false,/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/deletedAt: \{[^}]*?input: false,/);
  });

  it("blocks session creation for soft-deleted and banned accounts", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/if \(user\?\.deletedAt\) return false;/);

import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  parseDateRange,
  parsePagination,
  parsePostFilters,
  parseSocialAccountFilters,
  validateAccountAction,
  type AccountTarget,
} from "@/lib/admin-policy";
import {
  resetWorkerThrottleForTests,
  tryAcquireWorkerSlot,
  WORKER_THROTTLE_WINDOW_MS,
} from "@/lib/worker-throttle";

const readFile = (relative: string) =>
  readFileSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), relative), "utf8");

function walk(relative: string): string[] {
  const root = path.resolve(process.cwd(), relative);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const entry of readdirSync(root)) {
    const full = path.join(root, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(path.relative(process.cwd(), full)));
    else out.push(path.relative(process.cwd(), full));
  }
  return out;
}

function target(overrides: Partial<AccountTarget> = {}): AccountTarget {
  return {
    id: "user-2",
    role: "user",
    approvalStatus: "approved",
    banned: false,
    deletedAt: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("admin pagination and filters", () => {
  it("normalises page and page size and caps the page size", () => {
    expect(parsePagination({})).toEqual({ page: 1, pageSize: 25, offset: 0 });
    expect(parsePagination({ page: "3", pageSize: "10" })).toEqual({
      page: 3,
      pageSize: 10,
      offset: 20,
    });
    expect(parsePagination({ pageSize: "5000" }).pageSize).toBe(100);
    expect(parsePagination({ page: "-1", pageSize: "abc" })).toEqual({
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 25,
      offset: 0,
    });
    expect(parsePagination(new URLSearchParams("page=2&pageSize=5"))).toEqual({
      page: 2,
      pageSize: 5,
      offset: 5,
    });
  });

  it("builds an inclusive date range and prevents unbounded scans", () => {
    const now = Date.UTC(2026, 5, 15, 12, 0, 0);
    const defaults = parseDateRange({}, { now, defaultDays: 30 });
    expect(defaults.days).toBe(30);
    expect(defaults.toIso).toBe(new Date(now).toISOString());

    const explicit = parseDateRange(
      { from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-01-31" },
      { now, maxDays: 366 },
    );
    expect(explicit.days).toBe(31);
    expect(explicit.fromIso).toBe("2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(explicit.toIso).toBe("2026-01-31T23:59:59.999Z");

    const clamped = parseDateRange(
      { from: "2020-01-01", to: "2026-01-01" },
      { now, maxDays: 31 },
    );
    expect(clamped.days).toBe(31);

    const reversed = parseDateRange(
      { from: "2026-02-01", to: "2026-01-01" },
      { now },
    );
    expect(new Date(reversed.fromIso).getTime()).toBeLessThan(
      new Date(reversed.toIso).getTime(),
    );
  });

  it("whitelists post filters and trims queries", () => {
    const filters = parsePostFilters({
      q: `  ${"a".repeat(300)}  `,
      status: "HELD",
      platform: "LINKEDIN",
    });
    expect(filters.query).toHaveLength(100);
    expect(filters.status).toBe("held");
    expect(filters.platform).toBe("linkedin");

    const invalid = parsePostFilters({ status: "bogus", platform: "bogus" });
    expect(invalid.status).toBe("all");
    expect(invalid.platform).toBe("all");
  });

  it("whitelists social-account filters", () => {
    const social = parseSocialAccountFilters({
      platform: "FACEBOOK",
      status: "EXPIRED",
    });
    expect(social.platform).toBe("facebook");
    expect(social.status).toBe("expired");
    expect(social.pageSize).toBe(50);
  });
});

describe("account lifecycle policy", () => {
  it("blocks self-lockout for suspension, deletion, and session revocation", () => {
    const self = target({ id: "admin-1", role: "admin" });
    for (const action of ["suspend", "soft_delete", "revoke_sessions"] as const) {
      const violation = validateAccountAction({
        action,
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: self,
      });
      expect(violation?.status).toBe(409);
    }
  });

  it("protects the Super Admin from suspension and deletion", () => {
    for (const action of ["suspend", "soft_delete"] as const) {
      expect(
        validateAccountAction({
          action,
          actorId: "admin-1",
          target: target({ role: "admin" }),
        })?.status,
      ).toBe(409);
    }
  });

  it("rejects invalid transitions and accepts valid ones", () => {
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "suspend",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ banned: true }),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "suspend",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ deletedAt: new Date() }),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "reactivate",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target(),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "reactivate",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ banned: true }),
      }),
    ).toBeNull();

    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "soft_delete",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target(),
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "soft_delete",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ deletedAt: new Date() }),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "restore",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target(),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "restore",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ deletedAt: new Date() }),
      }),
    ).toBeNull();

    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "revoke_sessions",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target(),
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "revoke_sessions",
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target({ deletedAt: new Date() }),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(409);
  });

  it("rejects an unknown action", () => {
    expect(
      validateAccountAction({
        action: "destroy" as never,
        actorId: "admin-1",
        target: target(),
      })?.status,
    ).toBe(400);
  });
});

describe("worker trigger throttle", () => {
  it("allows one run per user per window and resets after the window", () => {
    resetWorkerThrottleForTests();
    const now = 1_000_000;
    expect(tryAcquireWorkerSlot("u-1", now).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(tryAcquireWorkerSlot("u-1", now + 1).allowed).toBe(false);
    expect(tryAcquireWorkerSlot("u-2", now + 1).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(
      tryAcquireWorkerSlot("u-1", now + WORKER_THROTTLE_WINDOW_MS).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  class UnauthorizedError extends Error {}
  class ApprovalRequiredError extends Error {
    code = "rejected";
  }
  class ApiError extends Error {
    status: number;
    constructor(message: string, status = 400) {
      super(message);
      this.status = status;
    }
  }
  return {
    requireAdmin: vi.fn(),
    getAdminUserStats: vi.fn(),
    listSocialAccounts: vi.fn(),
    listScheduledPosts: vi.fn(),
    adminHoldPost: vi.fn(),
    adminResumePost: vi.fn(),
    performAccountAction: vi.fn(),
    UnauthorizedError,
    ApprovalRequiredError,
    ApiError,
  };
});

vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({
  requireAdmin: mocks.requireAdmin,
  UnauthorizedError: mocks.UnauthorizedError,
  ApprovalRequiredError: mocks.ApprovalRequiredError,
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/api", () => ({
  ApiError: mocks.ApiError,
  apiErrorResponse: (error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof mocks.ApiError) {
      return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: error.status });
    }
    if (error instanceof mocks.UnauthorizedError) {
      return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 401 });
    }
    if (error instanceof mocks.ApprovalRequiredError) {
      return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 403 });
    }
    return Response.json({ error: "Unexpected error." }, { status: 500 });
  },
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/admin-overview", () => ({
  getAdminUserStats: mocks.getAdminUserStats,
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/admin-social-accounts", () => ({

describe("admin API authorization", () => {
  it("returns 401 when there is no session", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValue(new mocks.UnauthorizedError("Authentication required."));
    const response = await overviewGET();
    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it("returns 403 for a signed-in regular user", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValue(
      new mocks.ApprovalRequiredError("Admin access required."),
    );
    for (const response of [
      await overviewGET(),
      await socialGET(url("/api/admin/social-accounts")),
      await schedulerGET(url("/api/admin/scheduler")),
    ]) {
      expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    }
  });

  it("serves data to the Super Admin", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.getAdminUserStats.mockResolvedValue({
      total: 4,
      pending: 1,
      active: 2,
      inactive: 1,
    });
    const response = await overviewGET();
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({
      total: 4,
      pending: 1,
      active: 2,
      inactive: 1,
    });
    expect(mocks.getAdminUserStats).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it("checks the admin guard before doing any data work", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValue(new mocks.UnauthorizedError("Authentication required."));
    await schedulerGET(url("/api/admin/scheduler"));
    expect(mocks.listScheduledPosts).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await socialGET(url("/api/admin/social-accounts"));
    expect(mocks.listSocialAccounts).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("scheduler hold/resume APIs", () => {
  it("passes the verified admin id and post id to the hold helper", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.adminHoldPost.mockResolvedValue({ id: "post-1", status: "held" });
    const response = await holdPOST(url("/api/admin/scheduler/post-1/hold"), {
      params: Promise.resolve({ id: "post-1" }),
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mocks.adminHoldPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith("admin-1", "post-1");
  });

  it("resumes only through the resume helper", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.adminResumePost.mockResolvedValue({
      id: "post-1",
      status: "held",
      message: "still held",
    });
    const response = await resumePOST(url("/api/admin/scheduler/post-1/resume"), {
      params: Promise.resolve({ id: "post-1" }),
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mocks.adminResumePost).toHaveBeenCalledWith("admin-1", "post-1");
  });

  it("rejects an empty post id", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    const response = await holdPOST(url("/api/admin/scheduler/empty/hold"), {

    });

    expect(mocks.adminHoldPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

describe("account control APIs", () => {
  it("uses the session actor id, not client-supplied data", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.performAccountAction.mockResolvedValue({
      id: "user-2",
      action: "suspend",
      banned: true,
      deletedAt: null,
      sessionsRevoked: 2,
      postsHeld: 3,
      postsResumed: 0,
      postsStillHeld: 0,
    });
    const response = await accountPOST(
      new Request("http://localhost/api/admin/users/user-2/account", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: "suspend", actorId: "attacker" }),
      }),
      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: "user-2" }) },
    );
    // Unknown/strict body keys are rejected rather than trusted.
    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    expect(mocks.performAccountAction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("performs a valid suspension", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.performAccountAction.mockResolvedValue({
      id: "user-2",
      action: "suspend",
      banned: true,
      deletedAt: null,
      sessionsRevoked: 2,
      postsHeld: 3,
      postsResumed: 0,
      postsStillHeld: 0,
    });
    const response = await accountPOST(
      new Request("http://localhost/api/admin/users/user-2/account", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: "suspend", reason: "abuse report" }),
      }),
      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: "user-2" }) },
    );
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mocks.performAccountAction).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "admin-1",
      "user-2",
      "suspend",
      "abuse report",
    );
  });

  it("revokes sessions through the dedicated endpoint", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.performAccountAction.mockResolvedValue({
      id: "user-2",
      action: "revoke_sessions",
      banned: false,
      deletedAt: null,
      sessionsRevoked: 4,
      postsHeld: 0,
      postsResumed: 0,
      postsStillHeld: 0,
    });
    const response = await sessionsDELETE(url("/api/admin/users/user-2/sessions"), {
      params: Promise.resolve({ id: "user-2" }),
    });
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mocks.performAccountAction).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "admin-1",
      "user-2",
      "revoke_sessions",
    );
  });

  it("returns the self-lockout violation from the server policy", async () => {
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue(adminSession);
    mocks.performAccountAction.mockRejectedValue(
      new mocks.ApiError("You cannot suspend or delete your own account.", 409),
    );
    const response = await accountPOST(
      new Request("http://localhost/api/admin/users/admin-1/account", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: "suspend" }),
      }),
      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: "admin-1" }) },
    );
    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
  });
});

  return new Request(`http://localhost${pathname}`, {

    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),

describe("profile name policy", () => {
  it("trims and collapses whitespace", () => {
    expect(validateDisplayName("  Ada   Lovelace  ")).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      value: "Ada Lovelace",
    });
  });

  it("rejects blank, too-short, and too-long names", () => {
    expect(validateDisplayName(" ").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateDisplayName("A").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateDisplayName("A".repeat(81)).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  it("rejects markup, control characters, and non-text values", () => {
    expect(validateDisplayName("<script>alert(1)</script>").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateDisplayName("Ada\u0000Lovelace").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateDisplayName(42).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateDisplayName(null).ok).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("password policy", () => {
  it("requires at least 12 characters and three character classes", () => {
    expect(validatePasswordStrength("short1!A").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validatePasswordStrength("alllowercase1").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validatePasswordStrength(STRONG_PASSWORD)).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      value: STRONG_PASSWORD,
    });
  });

  it("reports each requirement for live UI feedback", () => {
    const requirements = passwordRequirements(STRONG_PASSWORD);
    expect(requirements.length).toBe(true);
    expect(requirements.lowercase).toBe(true);
    expect(requirements.uppercase).toBe(true);
    expect(requirements.digit).toBe(true);
    expect(requirements.symbol).toBe(true);
  });

  it("requires the current password and a matching confirmation", () => {
    expect(
      validatePasswordChange({ newPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD, confirmPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD }).ok,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      validatePasswordChange({
        currentPassword: "old-password",
        newPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: "different",
      }).ok,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      validatePasswordChange({
        currentPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
        newPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
      }).ok,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      validatePasswordChange({
        currentPassword: "old-password",
        newPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD,
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      value: { currentPassword: "old-password", newPassword: STRONG_PASSWORD },
    });
  });

  it("pins the advertised minimum length", () => {
    expect(PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12);
  });
});

describe("OTP and email policy", () => {
  it("accepts only six digits", () => {
    expect(validateOtp(" 123456 ")).toEqual({ ok: true, value: "123456" });
    expect(validateOtp("12345").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateOtp("1234567").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateOtp("12a456").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(validateOtp(123456).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  it("normalizes a valid email and rejects malformed input", () => {
    expect(normalizeEmail(" Admin@Example.COM ")).toBe("admin@example.com");
    expect(normalizeEmail("not-an-email")).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeEmail("a@b")).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeEmail(7)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("matches the configured OTP lifecycle", () => {
    expect(OTP_LENGTH).toBe(6);
    expect(OTP_EXPIRES_IN_SECONDS).toBe(300);
    expect(OTP_ALLOWED_ATTEMPTS).toBe(3);
    expect(OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS).toBe(60);
  });
});

const readFile = (relative: string) =>
  readFileSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), relative), "utf8");

function walk(relative: string): string[] {
  const root = path.resolve(process.cwd(), relative);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const entry of readdirSync(root)) {
    const full = path.join(root, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(path.relative(process.cwd(), full)));
    else out.push(path.relative(process.cwd(), full));
  }
  return out;
}

describe("Better Auth recovery configuration", () => {
  const auth = readFile("src/lib/auth.ts");

  it("registers the email OTP plugin with hardened storage and limits", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/emailOTP\(/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/storeOTP:\s*"hashed"/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/expiresIn:\s*OTP_EXPIRES_IN_SECONDS/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/allowedAttempts:\s*OTP_ALLOWED_ATTEMPTS/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/resendStrategy:\s*"rotate"/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/rateLimit:\s*\{/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/disableSignUp:\s*true/);
  });

  it("revokes sessions on reset and audits without sensitive values", () => {
    expect(auth).toMatch(/revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset:\s*true/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/onPasswordReset/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/afterEmailVerification/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/\/email-otp\/request-password-reset/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/logActivity\(/);
    expect(auth).not.toMatch(/metadata:\s*\{[^}]*\botp\s*:/i);
  });

    expect(auth).toMatch(/sendSecurityEmail/);
    expect(auth).toMatch(/otpEmailContent/);
  });
});

describe("email delivery", () => {
  const email = readFile("src/lib/email.ts");
  const consoleLines = email
    .split("\n")

    expect(login).toMatch(/autoComplete="current-password"/);
  });

  it("keeps the password reset page reachable without a session", () => {

    expect(page).toMatch(/getAdminProfile/);
    expect(client).toMatch(/Change password/);
  });
});

FILE: social-media-web/tests/posts-routes.test.ts

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

// The Queue previously hid `held` posts and the cancel route rejected them,
// even though the scheduler's cancel/reschedule rules accept `scheduled` and
// `held`. These tests pin the aligned behaviour at the route and UI level.

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  class UnauthorizedError extends Error {}
  class ApiError extends Error {
    status: number;
    constructor(message: string, status = 400) {
      super(message);
      this.status = status;
    }
  }
  return {
    requireApiSession: vi.fn(),
    scheduledPostStatus: vi.fn(),
    cancelScheduledPost: vi.fn(),
    // Mirror the real scheduler helpers so the route test checks the exact
    // status set without touching the built MCP package.
    canCancelScheduledPost: (status: string) =>
      status === "scheduled" || status === "held",
    UnauthorizedError,
    ApiError,
  };
});

vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({
  UnauthorizedError: mocks.UnauthorizedError,
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/api", () => ({
  ApiError: mocks.ApiError,
  requireApiSession: mocks.requireApiSession,
  apiErrorResponse: (error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof mocks.ApiError) {
      return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: error.status });
    }
    if (error instanceof mocks.UnauthorizedError) {
      return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 401 });
    }
    return Response.json({ error: "Unexpected error." }, { status: 500 });
  },
}));

vi.mock("@/lib/backend", () => ({
  scheduledPostStatus: mocks.scheduledPostStatus,
  cancelScheduledPost: mocks.cancelScheduledPost,
  canCancelScheduledPost: mocks.canCancelScheduledPost,
}));

import { POST as cancelPOST } from "@/app/api/posts/[id]/cancel/route";

function source(path: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path, "utf8");
}

const session = { user: { id: "user-1" } };

function params(id: string) {
  return { params: Promise.resolve({ id }) };
}

beforeEach(() => {
  mocks.requireApiSession.mockReset();
  mocks.scheduledPostStatus.mockReset();
  mocks.cancelScheduledPost.mockReset();
});

describe("POST /api/posts/[id]/cancel", () => {
  it("requires an approved session", async () => {
    mocks.requireApiSession.mockRejectedValue(
      new mocks.UnauthorizedError("Authentication required."),
    );

    const response = await cancelPOST(new Request("http://localhost"), params("post-1"));

    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    expect(mocks.cancelScheduledPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns 404 for a post the user does not own", async () => {
    mocks.requireApiSession.mockResolvedValue(session);
    mocks.scheduledPostStatus.mockResolvedValue([]);

    const response = await cancelPOST(new Request("http://localhost"), params("post-1"));

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
    expect(mocks.cancelScheduledPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("cancels a held post as well as a scheduled one", async () => {
    mocks.requireApiSession.mockResolvedValue(session);

    for (const status of ["scheduled", "held"] as const) {
      mocks.scheduledPostStatus.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: "post-1", status, platform: "facebook" },
      ]);
      mocks.cancelScheduledPost.mockResolvedValue({ id: "post-1", status: "cancelled" });

      const response = await cancelPOST(new Request("http://localhost"), params("post-1"));

      expect(response.status).toBe(200);
      expect(await response.json()).toEqual({
        cancelled: { id: "post-1", status: "cancelled" },
      });
    }

    expect(mocks.cancelScheduledPost).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mocks.cancelScheduledPost).toHaveBeenCalledWith("user-1", "post-1");
  });

  it("rejects posts that are already publishing or finished", async () => {
    mocks.requireApiSession.mockResolvedValue(session);

    for (const status of ["publishing", "published", "failed", "cancelled"] as const) {
      mocks.scheduledPostStatus.mockResolvedValue([
        { id: "post-1", status, platform: "facebook" },
      ]);

      const response = await cancelPOST(new Request("http://localhost"), params("post-1"));

      expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    }

    expect(mocks.cancelScheduledPost).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("Queue and posts list expose held posts", () => {
  const queue = source("src/app/(dashboard)/queue/page.tsx");
  const postsList = source("src/components/posts-list.tsx");

  it("includes held posts in the Queue filter", () => {
    expect(queue).toMatch(/statuses=\{\["scheduled", "publishing", "held"\]\}/);
  });

  it("offers reschedule and cancel for held posts", () => {
    expect(postsList).toMatch(
      /post\.status === "scheduled" \|\| post\.status === "held"/,
    );
    expect(postsList).toMatch(/canCancel\(post\)/);
  });
});

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { GEOM, measureText, parseGuidePdf } from "../scripts/generate-security-guide.mjs";

// The security guide is a version-controlled, pre-generated static PDF asset
// (produced by scripts/generate-security-guide.mjs) linked from the Admin
// Settings reference section. These tests pin both halves of the feature: the
// document itself, the settings-page integration, and the layout quality of
// every generated page (bounds, wrapping, overlaps, callouts, references).

const readFile = (relativePath: string): string =>
  readFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname, "..", relativePath), "utf8");

const PDF_PATH = "public/Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf";

// Shared parsed artifact for the layout tests below.
const pdfBuffer = readFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname, "..", PDF_PATH));
const pdfText = pdfBuffer.toString("latin1");
const parsed = parseGuidePdf(pdfText);
const runsWithWidth = parsed.pages.map((page) =>
  page.runs.map((run) => ({
    ...run,
    width: measureText(run.text, run.font, run.size, run.tc),
  })),
);

const SECTION_TITLES = [
  "Account Security",
  "Authentication & Password Protection",
  "Session Management",
  "Social Account & OAuth Security",
  "Publishing Safety",
  "Data Protection & Privacy",
  "Administrative Responsibilities",
];

describe("security guide PDF asset", () => {
  it("exists as a real, version-controlled PDF document", () => {
    expect(pdfBuffer.subarray(0, 5).toString()).toBe("%PDF-");
    expect(pdfText.trimEnd().endsWith("%%EOF")).toBe(true);
    expect(pdfBuffer.byteLength).toBeGreaterThan(10_000);
  });

  it("is a well-formed PDF with a catalog, pages, and A4 media box", () => {
    expect(pdfText).toContain("/Type /Catalog");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("/Type /Pages");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("/MediaBox [0 0 595.28 841.89]");
    // Cover + contents + 7 section pages, at minimum.
    const pageCount = (pdfText.match(/\/Type \/Page[^s]/g) ?? []).length;
    expect(pageCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(9);
  });

  it("has a valid xref table pointing at every object", () => {
    const start = Number(/startxref\s+(\d+)/.exec(pdfText)?.[1]);
    expect(pdfText.slice(start, start + 4)).toBe("xref");
    const rows = pdfText.slice(start).split("\n");
    const count = Number(rows[1].split(" ")[1]);
    let bad = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < count; i++) {
      const offset = Number(rows[2 + i].slice(0, 10));
      const want = `${i} 0 obj`;
      if (pdfText.slice(offset, offset + want.length) !== want) bad++;
    }
    expect(bad).toBe(0);
  });

  it("contains the full title, subtitle, and a table of contents", () => {
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Security & Account");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Protection Guide");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Understanding how your account, data, authentication");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Contents");
  });

  it("contains all seven required sections, each starting on a fresh page", () => {
    SECTION_TITLES.forEach((title, index) => {
      expect(pdfText).toContain(`SECTION ${index + 1}`);
      expect(pdfText).toContain(`(${title})`);
      // Every section begins at the very top of its own page.
      const sectionPage = parsed.pages.findIndex(
        (page) =>
          page.runs.some((run) => run.text === `SECTION ${index + 1}`) &&
          page.runs.some((run) => run.text === title),
      );
      expect(sectionPage).toBeGreaterThan(1);
      const contentRuns = parsed.pages[sectionPage].runs.filter(
        (run) => run.y < GEOM.HEADER_BASELINE - 2,
      );
      const topBaseline = Math.max(...contentRuns.map((run) => run.y));
      expect(topBaseline).toBeCloseTo(GEOM.TOP, 1);
    });
  });

  it("labels enforced behavior separately from recommended practices", () => {
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Enforced by the application");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Recommended practice - not enforced");
  });

  it("carries page numbering and running header/footer", () => {
    expect(pdfText).toMatch(/Page \d+ of \d+/);
    expect(pdfText).toContain("SOCIAL CONSOLE");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf");
  });

  it("carries document metadata and outline bookmarks", () => {
    expect(pdfText).toContain("/Title (Social Console - Security & Account Protection Guide)");
    expect(pdfText).toContain("/Type /Outlines");
    expect((pdfText.match(/\/Dest /g) ?? []).length).toBe(7);
  });

  it("contains no secrets, credentials, or private account data", () => {
    const forbidden = [
      "RESEND_API_KEY",
      "EMAIL_DELIVERY_TOKEN",
      "BETTER_AUTH_SECRET",
      "DATABASE_URL",
      "TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY",
      "CLOUD_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY",
      "APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY",
      "sk-",
      "sbp_",
      "@gmail.com",
      "@social-media.local",
      "session_token",
      "PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH =",
    ];
    for (const needle of forbidden) {
      expect(pdfText).not.toContain(needle);
    }
  });

  it("is the only PDF served from public/", () => {
    const files = readdirSync(path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "public"));
    expect(files.filter((file) => file.endsWith(".pdf"))).toEqual([
      "Social-Console-Security-Guide.pdf",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("pdf layout validation", () => {
  const { PAGE_W, MARGIN, TOP, BOTTOM, HEADER_BASELINE, FOOTER_BASELINE } = GEOM;
  const RIGHT = PAGE_W - MARGIN;

  it("keeps every text run inside the horizontal content margins", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      for (const run of runs) {
        if (run.x < MARGIN - 0.75) {
          offenders.push(`page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" starts left of the margin at x=${run.x}`);
        }
        if (run.x + run.width > RIGHT + 0.75) {
          offenders.push(
            `page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" ends at x=${(run.x + run.width).toFixed(2)}, past the right margin ${RIGHT.toFixed(2)}`,
          );
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps content text between the header rule and the footer rule", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      for (const run of runs) {
        const isFrameRun = run.y >= HEADER_BASELINE - 2 || run.y <= FOOTER_BASELINE + 2;
        if (isFrameRun) continue;
        if (run.y > TOP + 2 || run.y < BOTTOM - 1) {
          offenders.push(
            `page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" baseline y=${run.y} outside content band [${BOTTOM}, ${TOP}]`,
          );
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("never overlaps text runs on the same page", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      const sorted = [...runs].sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y || a.x - b.x);
      for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < sorted.length; j++) {
          const a = sorted[i];
          const b = sorted[j];
          if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) >= 0.75 * Math.min(a.size, b.size)) break; // sorted by y desc
          const overlapX = a.x < b.x + b.width && b.x < a.x + a.width;
          if (overlapX) {
            offenders.push(
              `page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${a.text}" and "${b.text}" overlap near y=${a.y}`,
            );
          }
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("flows wrapped paragraphs without vertical collisions between lines", () => {
    // Line spacing must be at least ~1.15x the font size everywhere.
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      const content = runs
        .filter((run) => run.y < HEADER_BASELINE - 2 && run.y > FOOTER_BASELINE + 2)
        .sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y);
      for (let i = 1; i < content.length; i++) {
        const gap = content[i - 1].y - content[i].y;
        // gap === 0 means a side-by-side run (e.g. a right-aligned page
        // number); horizontal collisions are covered by the overlap test.
        if (gap <= 0.5) continue;
        const minGap = 0.9 * Math.max(content[i - 1].size, content[i].size);
        if (gap < minGap) {
          offenders.push(
            `page ${pageIndex + 1}: lines "${content[i - 1].text}" and "${content[i].text}" are ${gap.toFixed(1)}pt apart`,
          );
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps subheadings with at least one following content line", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      for (const run of runs) {
        if (run.font !== "F2" || run.size !== 13) continue; // h2 subheadings only
        const follower = runs.find(
          // h2 leaves a (15 + 6)pt step before the following baseline
          (other) =>
            other !== run && Math.abs(run.y - 21 - other.y) < 1.5 && other.x >= run.x,
        );
        if (!follower) {
          offenders.push(`page ${pageIndex + 1}: subheading "${run.text}" has no content line below it on the same page`);
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("contains every callout's text inside its box", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    let boxCount = 0;
    runsWithWidth.forEach((runs, pageIndex) => {
      const boxes = parsed.pages[pageIndex].rects.filter(
        (rect) => rect.w > GEOM.PAGE_W - 2 * GEOM.MARGIN - 1 && rect.h > 20,
      );
      boxCount += boxes.length;
      for (const box of boxes) {
        const inside = runs.filter(
          (run) =>
            run.x >= box.x - 1 &&
            run.x < box.x + box.w &&
            run.y >= box.y - 1 &&
            run.y <= box.y + box.h + 1,
        );
        expect(inside.length, `page ${pageIndex + 1}: callout box has text`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
        for (const run of inside) {
          if (run.x + run.width > box.x + box.w - 6) {
            offenders.push(
              `page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" pokes out of its callout box on the right`,
            );
          }
          if (run.y - run.size * 0.212 < box.y - 0.5) {
            offenders.push(`page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" pokes out of its callout box at the bottom`);
          }
          if (run.y + run.size * 0.75 > box.y + box.h + 0.5) {
            offenders.push(`page ${pageIndex + 1}: "${run.text}" pokes out of its callout box at the top`);
          }
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
    expect(boxCount).toBe(7); // one callout per section
  });

  it("numbers pages sequentially and consistently", () => {
    const total = parsed.pages.length;
    parsed.pages.forEach((page, pageIndex) => {
      const match = /Page (\d+) of (\d+)/.exec(page.raw);
      if (pageIndex === 0) {
        expect(match).toBeNull(); // cover carries no footer
        return;
      }
      expect(match, `page ${pageIndex + 1} has a footer`).not.toBeNull();
      expect(Number(match?.[1])).toBe(pageIndex + 1);
      expect(Number(match?.[2])).toBe(total);
    });
  });

  it("matches the table of contents page numbers to actual section pages", () => {
    const toc = parsed.pages[1];
    const entries: Array<{ num: number; title: string; page: number }> = [];
    const titleRuns = toc.runs.filter((run) => run.size === 11 && run.font === "F1" && /^\d\. {2}/.test(run.text));
    const numberRuns = toc.runs.filter((run) => run.size === 11 && run.font === "F1" && /^\d+$/.test(run.text) && run.x > GEOM.PAGE_W / 2);
    expect(titleRuns.length).toBe(7);
    expect(numberRuns.length).toBe(7);
    titleRuns.forEach((run, index) => {
      const num = Number(/^(\d)\./.exec(run.text)?.[1]);
      entries.push({
        num,
        title: run.text.replace(/^\d\.\s+/, ""),
        page: Number(numberRuns[index].text),
      });
    });

    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      const actualPage = parsed.pages.findIndex(
        (page, index) =>
          index >= 2 &&
          page.runs.some((run) => run.text === `SECTION ${entry.num}`) &&
          page.runs.some((run) => run.text === entry.title),
      );
      expect(actualPage, `section ${entry.num} (${entry.title})`).toBeGreaterThan(1);
      expect(entry.page).toBe(actualPage + 1);
    });
  });

  it("points every outline bookmark at its section's first page", () => {
    const dests = [...pdfText.matchAll(/\/Dest \[(\d+) 0 R \/XYZ/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
    expect(dests.length).toBe(7);
    // Page objects are serialized in page order.
    const pageObjNums = [...pdfText.matchAll(/(\d+) 0 obj\n<< \/Type \/Page \/Parent/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
    dests.forEach((destObj, index) => {
      const pageIndex = pageObjNums.indexOf(destObj);
      expect(pageIndex, `bookmark ${index + 1}`).toBeGreaterThan(1);
      const page = parsed.pages[pageIndex];
      expect(page.runs.some((run) => run.text === `SECTION ${index + 1}`)).toBe(true);
      expect(page.runs.some((run) => run.text === SECTION_TITLES[index])).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it("keeps bullet markers aligned with their first text line", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    parsed.pages.forEach((page, pageIndex) => {
      const markers = page.rects.filter(
        (rect) => Math.abs(rect.x - (GEOM.MARGIN + 1.5)) < 0.5 && Math.abs(rect.w - 3) < 0.5,
      );
      const bulletTexts = page.runs.filter((run) => Math.abs(run.x - (GEOM.MARGIN + 16)) < 0.5);
      for (const marker of markers) {
        // The marker square sits on the cap band of the bullet's first line:
        // text baseline = marker.y - 2.2 (see bullet() in the generator).
        const aligned = bulletTexts.some(
          (run) => Math.abs(run.y - marker.y + 2.2) < 1.2,
        );
        if (!aligned) {
          offenders.push(`page ${pageIndex + 1}: bullet marker at y=${marker.y} has no aligned text line`);
        }
      }
    });
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });
});
